articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上展示。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。我们的知名品牌包括用于液压运动控制和稳定系统的 Power-Packer；用于操作员信息和人机界面系统的 CrossControl 和 maximatecc； Elliott Manufacturing 和 Weasler Engineering 通过柔性和刚性传动系统进行动力和力传输； Gits Manufacturing 提供高性能发动机热和排放控制解决方案；和 Carlisle Brake & Friction，为非公路制动和传动产品提供材料和机电一体化解决方案。如需了解有关 CentroMotion 的更多信息，请访问 www.centromotion.com。

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 4 月 7 日至 13 日在慕尼黑举行的 bauma 展会上参展的五个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位 A2, 402。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于建筑市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
paras.zh: 分享其行业领先的制动、变速箱/离合器和运动控制系统的产品亮点。

paras.en: Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
paras.zh: 展示显示和机载计算平台。

paras.en: Featuring the latest solutions in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, exhaust recirculation valves and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas, and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用最新的热管理解决方案，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、排气再循环阀和排气背压阀。

paras.en: Demonstrating micro-controller-based platforms for instrumentation and HMI.
paras.zh: 演示基于微控制器的仪器仪表和 HMI 平台。

paras.en: Exhibiting new electro-hydraulic actuators with a design focus on efficiency, perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications.
paras.zh: 展示新型电动液压执行器，其设计注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。

articles.title: Visit Us @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: CarlisleCBF is one of seven CentroMotion brands exhibiting at Agritechnica, November 9 - 15, 2025, in Hanover, Germany, stand No. B35, hall 17.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information, and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. The display will also feature both the EPD and N680 advanced friction technologies, built to optimize performance and reliability in high-torque applications. Together, these products represent a century of engineering excellence and a future-focused commitment to solving the toughest challenges in agricultural mobility.
paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.
paras.zh: 呈现最新的解决方案，帮助操作员感知、看到和了解更多。展会与会者将发现广泛的产品组合，包括用于在要求苛刻的应用中监控车辆和设备的显示器、仪表组和传感器。这些显示器基于微控制器架构构建，可提供精益性能以及对快速启动（通常大约一秒即可即时访问机器数据）等关键功能的固有支持。 Agritechnica 的参观者可以亲身体验从 1.3 英寸到 4.3 英寸的显示屏范围，并通过演示展示通用 I/O、CAN 通道支持和应用示例。这些显示器可以共享多个信息屏幕，并具有直观的导航功能，包括诊断代码和机器状态。该平台提供的设备具有坚固而紧凑的外壳，适合承受最恶劣的环境，并可轻松安装 52 或 86 毫米 SAE 外壳尺寸，使新的和现有的驾驶室的安装变得简单。

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. All products are designed with a focus on efficiency and perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications. Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精度，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。

articles.title: NABC, Open Road Collision Donate Recycled Ride to New Mexico Mom
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Friday, Oct. 2, an Albuquerque, N.M., woman received a donated refurbished vehicle through the NABC Recycled Rides program, with the vehicle provided by Farmers Insurance and repairs completed by Open Road Collision.
paras.zh: 10 月 2 日星期五，新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基市的一名妇女收到了一辆通过 NABC Recycled Rides 计划捐赠的翻新车辆，该车辆由 Farmers Insurance 提供，并由 Open Road Collision 完成维修。

paras.en: The presentation was made at Open Road Collision in Albuquerque. The recipient was nominated by the Somos Unidos Foundation, the official 501(c)(3) nonprofit arm of the professional USL club New Mexico United.
paras.zh: 该演讲是在阿尔伯克基的开放道路碰撞大会上进行的。获奖者由 Somos Unidos 基金会提名，该基金会是职业 USL 俱乐部新墨西哥联队的官方 501(c)(3) 非营利机构。

paras.en: A 2017 Honda CR-V, donated by Farmers and refurbished by technicians at Open Road Collision, was presented to Lorena Alvarez. Alvarez has faced significant challenges as a single mother and had struggled with a lack of reliable transportation. This NABC Recycled Rides vehicle will provide needed mobility for her family.
paras.zh: 一辆由 Farmers 捐赠并由 Open Road Collision 技术人员翻新的 2017 款本田 CR-V 被赠送给洛雷娜·阿尔瓦雷斯 (Lorena Alvarez)。作为一名单亲母亲，阿尔瓦雷斯面临着重大挑战，并因缺乏可靠的交通而苦苦挣扎。这辆 NABC Recycled Rides 车辆将为她的家人提供所需的机动性。

paras.en: Community members can support the program by donating directly or by contributing unwanted or non-running vehicles through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. Donors receive a tax donation, and proceeds help provide reliable transportation for those in need.
paras.zh: 社区成员可以通过直接捐赠或通过“改变和拯救生命钥匙促进改变”计划贡献不需要或未运行的车辆来支持该计划。捐助者收到税收捐款，收益有助于为有需要的人提供可靠的交通。

paras.en: Additional partners in this presentation include Car Crafters, Copart, Enterprise, Advanced Remarketing Services and Cars for Charity.
paras.zh: 本次演示中的其他合作伙伴包括 Car Crafters、Copart、Enterprise、Advanced Remarketing Services 和 Cars for Charity。

paras.en: Farmers, a level one member of the NABC, has donated nearly 100 vehicles to people and organizations in need through NABC Recycled Rides.
paras.zh: Farmers 是 NABC 的一级会员，通过 NABC Recycled Rides 向有需要的人和组织捐赠了近 100 辆汽车。

paras.en: For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.
paras.zh: 有关回收游乐设施的更多信息，请单击此处。

articles.title: What to Know about Static and Dynamic ADAS Calibrations
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Choosing between static and dynamic ADAS calibration depends on the procedure specified by the vehicle manufacturer. Regardless of the method, the vehicle and its surroundings must meet the manufacturer’s requirements.
paras.zh: 静态和动态 ADAS 校准之间的选择取决于车辆制造商指定的程序。无论采用哪种方法，车辆及其周围环境都必须满足制造商的要求。

paras.en: ADAS systems affected by a repair may need to be calibrated, relearned or re-zeroed. Terminology may vary, but the purpose is to establish an accurate reference point for the system.
paras.zh: 受维修影响的 ADAS 系统可能需要校准、重新学习或重新调零。术语可能有所不同，但目的是为系统建立准确的参考点。

paras.en: A static calibration is performed while the vehicle remains stationary.
paras.zh: 静态校准是在车辆保持静止时执行的。

paras.en: Technicians position targets at exact distances and heights. The targets must also be square to the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 技术人员将目标定位在精确的距离和高度。目标还必须与车辆中心线成直角。

paras.en: The vehicle must meet specified requirements for weight, ride height, tire pressure, fluid levels, lighting and background conditions.
paras.zh: 车辆必须满足重量、行驶高度、轮胎压力、液位、照明和背景条件的规定要求。

paras.en: Dynamic calibration takes place while driving. The technician places the system into calibration mode and drives the vehicle under specified conditions.
paras.zh: 动态校准在驾驶时进行。技术人员将系统置于校准模式并在指定条件下驾驶车辆。

paras.en: During the drive, the sensors verify that they can identify the roadway, recognize objects and align correctly with the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 在驾驶过程中，传感器验证它们是否可以识别道路、识别物体并与车辆中心线正确对齐。

paras.en: Extra weight, improper tire pressure, incorrect ride height or environmental interference can cause calibration to fail. These conditions can also establish an inaccurate reference.
paras.zh: 额外的重量、不正确的轮胎压力、不正确的行驶高度或环境干扰都可能导致校准失败。这些条件也可能建立不准确的参考。

paras.en: Whether the procedure is static or dynamic, technicians must follow the manufacturer’s instructions exactly. ADAS calibration depends on precision, and even small inconsistencies can affect system performance.
paras.zh: 无论程序是静态还是动态，技术人员都必须严格遵循制造商的说明。 ADAS 校准取决于精度，即使很小的不一致也会影响系统性能。

articles.title: AkzoNobel and Axalta to Be Called Axanzo Following Merger
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: AkzoNobel and Axalta Coating Systems have announced Axanzo as the name of the combined company following completion of their intended merger.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔和艾仕得涂料系统公司宣布，在完成合并计划后，合并后的公司名称将更名为 Axanzo。

paras.en: The planned merger, announced in November 2025, will create a global coatings leader with the scale, strength and reach to accelerate sustainable growth and deliver breakthrough innovation. The envisaged post-closing NYSE and Euronext Amsterdam ticker symbol will be AXZ.
paras.zh: 这项计划于 2025 年 11 月宣布的合并将打造一家全球涂料领导者，其规模、实力和影响力足以加速可持续增长并提供突破性创新。预计收盘后纽约证券交易所和阿姆斯特丹泛欧交易所的股票代码将为 AXZ。

paras.en: “We’re excited to announce the new name for our combined company,” said Greg Poux-Guillaume, CEO of AkzoNobel who will also be CEO of the new organization. “Axanzo signals a bold new start for a company which will be stronger in every way. It’s a launchpad for going further and faster than we ever could alone, embodying the pace and power to innovate, the strength to deliver and the excellence to succeed.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔首席执行官格雷格·普吉约姆 (Greg Poux-Guillaume) 表示：“我们很高兴宣布合并后公司的新名称。”他也将担任新组织的首席执行官。 “Axanzo 标志着公司的一个大胆的新开始，它将在各方面变得更加强大。它是一个比我们独自走得更远、更快的发射台，体现了创新的步伐和力量、交付的力量以及成功的卓越能力。”

paras.en: Axalta CEO Chris Villavarayan, who will be deputy CEO of the combined company, added, “Axanzo will continuously reset the standard of what coatings can do. The new name perfectly captures our shared ambition to push boundaries, honoring our heritage and offering an exciting glimpse of what’s to come.”
paras.zh: 艾仕得首席执行官 Chris Villavarayan 将担任合并后公司的副首席执行官，他补充道：“Axanzo 将不断重新设定涂料的标准。新名称完美体现了我们突破界限、尊重我们的传统并令人兴奋地展望未来的共同雄心。”

paras.en: The subtle, but intentional, reference to the heritage of both companies unites both companies’ legacies to usher in a new era for the industry. The combined business will bring together a diversified and balanced portfolio of around 100 highly regarded and trusted brands across paints and coatings, spanning more than 160 countries.
paras.zh: 对两家公司传统的微妙但有意的提及将两家公司的传统结合起来，开创了行业的新时代。合并后的业务将汇集约 100 个备受推崇和信赖的油漆和涂料品牌的多元化、平衡的产品组合，覆盖 160 多个国家。

paras.en: “Axanzo will focus on delivering uncompromising performance to sharpen our competitive edge, while establishing a profitable and sustainable path forward as a world leader in coatings,” Poux-Guillaume said. “By forging our expertise, the best of each of us will become the standard for all of us.”
paras.zh: Poux-Guillaume 表示：“Axanzo 将专注于提供不妥协的性能，以增强我们的竞争优势，同时作为涂料领域的世界领导者建立一条盈利且可持续的前进道路。” “通过锻造我们的专业知识，我们每个人中最好的人将成为我们所有人的标准。”

paras.en: Both AkzoNobel and Axalta will continue to operate as independent companies until closing, which is expected in early 2027 once all regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions have been finalized. The announcement of the new name does not change how customers and partners currently work with either company. They will continue to be served by their existing teams and through the brands and relationships they know and trust.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔和艾仕得都将继续作为独立公司运营，直至交割，预计在所有监管部门批准和惯例交割条件最终确定后，将于 2027 年初完成交割。新名称的公布不会改变客户和合作伙伴目前与这两家公司的合作方式。他们将继续由现有团队以及他们了解和信任的品牌和关系提供服务。

paras.en: Watch the Axanzo name reveal video here.
paras.zh: 在此观看 Axanzo 名字揭晓视频。

articles.title: NAIC seeks public comment on producer licensing handbook revisions
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) working group has adopted revisions to the association’s State Licensing Handbook for insurance producers and has requested public comment.
paras.zh: 全国保险专员协会 (NAIC) 工作组已通过对该协会《保险生产商国家许可手册》的修订，并征求公众意见。

paras.en: The Producer Licensing Uniformity (D) Working Group adopted the revisions on Oct. 7. The Producer Licensing (D) Task Force will review all submitted comments and consider adopting the revised handbook at its Nov. 5 meeting.
paras.zh: 生产者许可一致性 (D) 工作组于 10 月 7 日通过了修订版。生产者许可 (D) 工作组将审查所有提交的意见，并考虑在 11 月 5 日的会议上通过修订后的手册。

paras.en: The revisions include several additions to the recommended best practices for insurance regulators on producer exam content and testing administration. These include establishing a state advisory committee made up of state insurance regulators and the industry to work with testing vendors annually to review examination form questions “for substantive and psychometric requirements.”
paras.zh: 这些修订包括对保险监管机构建议的生产者考试内容和测试管理最佳实践的一些补充。其中包括建立一个由州保险监管机构和行业组成的州咨询委员会，每年与测试供应商合作，审查考试形式的问题“是否符合实质性和心理测量要求”。

paras.en: The working group recommends states should work with testing vendors to approve and issue candidate information bulletins that “accurately describe the examinations and examination policies and procedures, and provide sufficient examination content outline and study references for the candidate to prepare for the examination.”
paras.zh: 工作组建议各州应与考试供应商合作批准和发布考生信息公告，“准确描述考试和考试政策和程序，并为考生准备考试提供充分的考试内容大纲和学习参考”。

paras.en: It’s also recommended that states set clear performance standards for test vendors and require accountability.
paras.zh: 还建议各州为测试供应商制定明确的绩效标准并要求问责。

paras.en: The new recommendations include making testing available at locations reasonably convenient to residents of all areas of the state, with registration available online or by phone and the ability for a candidate to schedule testing within two to five business days of registration, according to the proposed revised handbook. It also recommends that states administer exams through a secure test-center network that employs qualified test proctors.
paras.zh: 根据拟议的修订手册，新的建议包括在该州所有地区的居民相当方便的地点提供测试，可以在线或通过电话注册，并且候选人能够在注册后的两到五个工作日内安排测试。它还建议各州通过雇用合格考试监考人员的安全考试中心网络来管理考试。

paras.en: Another proposed addition to the handbook states that there isn’t a uniform approach nationwide on whether the surplus lines license (for residents and non-residents) is a separate license type or a line of authority on the producer license.
paras.zh: 手册中的另一项提议补充指出，对于剩余线许可证（针对居民和非居民）是单独的许可证类型还是生产者许可证的授权线，全国范围内没有统一的方法。

paras.en: “Regardless of the approach taken, a resident must hold a valid property/casualty producer license to qualify for the issuance of a surplus lines license,” the proposed addition states. “This underlying P&C license requirement is for both individuals and business entities.”
paras.zh: 拟议的补充规定：“无论采取何种方法，居民都必须持有有效的财产/伤亡生产者许可证，才有资格获得剩余额度许可证。” “这一基本的 P&C 许可证要求适用于个人和商业实体。”

paras.en: Proposed requirements for remote testing guidelines are included in the revisions as well.
paras.zh: 远程测试指南的拟议要求也包含在修订中。

paras.en: According to the revisions, remote testing offers the same support as in-person test sites but includes several guidelines for states to follow to ensure proper testing:
paras.zh: 根据修订，远程测试提供与现场测试站点相同的支持，但包括一些供各州遵循的准则，以确保正确的测试：

paras.en: - “Procedures for conducting a system check of the candidate’s computer and internet service are sufficient.
paras.zh: - “对候选人的计算机和互联网服务进行系统检查的程序就足够了。

paras.en: - “The installation of any necessary software to facilitate the delivery of the exam.
paras.zh: - “安装任何必要的软件以方便考试的进行。

paras.en: - “Conduct a comprehensive security check, including verifying the identity of the candidate.
paras.zh: - “进行全面的安全检查，包括验证候选人的身份。

paras.en: - “Candidates must be in a distraction-free environment, where they can complete the exam unassisted in a secure environment.
paras.zh: - “考生必须处于无干扰的环境中，可以在安全的环境中独立完成考试。

paras.en: - “Exams are continuously monitored by video and audio recording similar to in-person test sites, as well as AI-enhanced monitoring proctoring.
paras.zh: - “考试通过类似于现场考试现场的视频和音频记录以及人工智能增强监控监考进行持续监控。

paras.en: - “Exam hours should include evening and weekend hours.
paras.zh: - “考试时间应包括晚上和周末时间。

paras.en: - “Testing vendors should establish procedures that analyze post- exam data for patterns of suspicious activity.”
The proposed changes also provide additional guidance on approval of continuing education instructors.

Comments on the revisions and additions to the handbook will be accepted through Oct. 30. Written comments should be sent to Tim Mullen, NAIC staff support for the Producer Licensing (D) Task Force, at [email protected].
paras.zh: 有关手册修订和补充的意见将于 10 月 30 日之前接受。书面意见应发送至生产者许可 (D) 工作组的 NAIC 工作人员 Tim Mullen，电子邮件地址为 [email protected]。

paras.en: At the Nov. 5 meeting, the task force will also consider adopting proposed revisions to the NAIC Independent Adjuster Licensing Guideline, the 1033 written consent process template, and proposed 2027 task force charges.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 5 日的会议上，工作组还将考虑通过对 NAIC 独立理算师许可指南、1033 书面同意流程模板的拟议修订，以及拟议的 2027 年工作组收费。

paras.en: The agenda and materials for the meeting will be posted on the task force webpage.
paras.zh: 会议议程和材料将发布在工作组网页上。

articles.title: Rivian and Redwood expand partnership to repurpose EV batteries
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Rivian has expanded its partnership with energy technology company Redwood Materials to recycle production scrap and end-of-life EV batteries, according to a Rivian press release. Redwood will also provide stationary battery storage at its manufacturing plant in Normal, Illinois.
paras.zh: 据 Rivian 新闻稿称，Rivian 扩大了与能源技术公司 Redwood Materials 的合作关系，以回收生产废料和报废电动汽车电池。 Redwood 还将在其位于伊利诺伊州诺莫尔的制造工厂提供固定电池存储。

paras.en: Redwood collects Rivian EV battery packs through Rivian’s nationwide network of service centers when they are no longer suitable for in-vehicle use. Redwood then evaluates each battery pack for energy storage at Rivian’s manufacturing facilities or other locations, or for recycling. Redwood will now also recycle battery scrap generated at Rivian’s manufacturing operations.
paras.zh: 当 Rivian 电动汽车电池组不再适合在车内使用时，Redwood 将通过 Rivian 的全国服务中心网络收集这些电池组。然后，Redwood 评估每个电池组在 Rivian 制造工厂或其他地点的储能或回收利用情况。 Redwood 现在还将回收 Rivian 制造业务中产生的电池废料。

paras.en: Rivian says the partnership expansion builds on existing work, announced in April, that provides 10 megawatt-hours (MWh) of battery energy storage from repurposed Rivian battery packs at the automaker’s Illinois manufacturing plant.
paras.zh: Rivian 表示，此次合作伙伴关系扩展建立在 4 月份宣布的现有工作的基础上，该项目通过该汽车制造商伊利诺伊州制造工厂改造后的 Rivian 电池组提供 10 兆瓦时 (MWh) 的电池储能。

paras.en: “Giving Rivian battery packs a second life in stationary storage is a massive unlock for the energy transition,” said RJ Scaringe, Rivian founder and CEO, in the release. “By partnering with JB and the Redwood team, we’re turning retired EV batteries into a powerful tool to make the grid more reliable and lower energy costs for everyone.”
paras.zh: Rivian 创始人兼首席执行官 RJ Scaringe 在新闻稿中表示：“让 Rivian 电池组在固定存储中获得第二次生命，是能源转型的一次重大解锁。” “通过与 JB 和 Redwood 团队合作，我们正在将退役的电动汽车电池转变为强大的工具，使电网更加可靠，并降低每个人的能源成本。”

paras.en: JB Straubel, Redwood Materials founder and CEO, added that every Rivian battery pack can potentially provide domestic grid energy storage and critical materials.
paras.zh: Redwood Materials 创始人兼首席执行官 JB Straubel 补充说，每个 Rivian 电池组都有可能提供国内电网储能和关键材料。

paras.en: “Redwood’s unique ability to integrate and redeploy Rivian batteries with our technology is an opportunity to enable fast, flexible, and more cost-efficient energy storage,” he said. “As the demand and cost for energy keep rising, working with companies like Rivian is how we help meet these challenges.”
paras.zh: “Redwood 具有将 Rivian 电池与我们的技术集成和重新部署的独特能力，这是实现快速、灵活且更具成本效益的能源存储的机会，”他说。 “随着能源需求和成本不断上升，与 Rivian 这样的公司合作是我们帮助应对这些挑战的方式。”

paras.en: Energy storage applications with repurposed batteries can ease grid stress during periods of high electricity demand, improving grid reliability while reducing energy costs for users and the grid at large, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，采用重新利用电池的储能应用可以缓解电力需求高时期的电网压力，提高电网可靠性，同时降低用户和整个电网的能源成本。

paras.en: During periods of low demand or when low-cost renewable energy is most productive, the packs can store electricity for easy dispatch during periods of higher demand. When paired with EV battery packs from Rivian and others, the release states that Redwood’s proprietary technology architecture offers an integrated system that can respond intelligently to the needs of the facility it is serving.
paras.zh: 在需求低迷时期或低成本可再生能源最具生产力时，电池组可以储存电力，以便在需求较高时期轻松调度。该新闻稿称，当与 Rivian 等公司的电动汽车电池组配合使用时，Redwood 的专有技术架构提供了一个集成系统，可以智能地响应其所服务设施的需求。

paras.en: Then, when batteries are no longer useful in energy storage applications, or when manufacturing generates scrap, they can be recycled.
paras.zh: 然后，当电池在储能应用中不再有用时，或者当制造产生废料时，它们可以被回收。

paras.en: Redwood’s process can recycle and recover critical minerals, such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and copper, at rates exceeding 95%, encouraging circular, domestic supply chain development for battery materials in the U.S., according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，Redwood 的工艺可以回收和回收锂、镍、钴和铜等关键矿物，回收率超过 95%，从而鼓励美国电池材料循环国内供应链的发展。

paras.en: “This expanded partnership reflects a broader shift underway in how American manufacturers source power,” the release states. “As grid connections take years to secure and conventional infrastructure remains supply-constrained, companies increasingly need partners who can solve more than one piece of the problem — recovering materials, managing recycling, and deploying storage as a single system rather than separate vendors.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“这种扩大的合作伙伴关系反映了美国制造商获取电力的方式正在发生更广泛的转变。” “由于电网连接需要数年时间才能确保安全，而且传统基础设施仍然供应有限，企业越来越需要能够解决多个问题的合作伙伴——回收材料、管理回收以及将存储部署为单个系统而不是单独的供应商。”

paras.en: BMW and General Motors have also previously announced partnerships with Redwood. BMW’s was to recycle lithium-ion batteries, similar to recycling partnerships Redwood signed with Toyota, Ford, Volvo, and Volkswagen.
paras.zh: 宝马和通用汽车此前也宣布与 Redwood 建立合作伙伴关系。宝马的目标是回收锂离子电池，类似于红木与丰田、福特、沃尔沃和大众签署的回收合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: GM launched a program to accelerate the deployment of energy storage systems using new and second-life battery packs from the automaker’s EVs.
paras.zh: 通用汽车启动了一项计划，利用该汽车制造商电动汽车的新型电池组和二次电池组来加速储能系统的部署。

paras.en: Featured image: Rivian’s manufacturing operations at its Normal, Illinois plant.
paras.zh: 特色图片：Rivian 在伊利诺伊州诺莫尔工厂的制造业务。

articles.title: Pronto Network to Support ‘Brakes for Breasts’ Fundraiser
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: During the month of October, The Pronto Network will join independent auto repair shops across the United States in supporting the 2026 Brakes for Breasts fundraiser, an industry-wide effort raising funds for breast cancer vaccine research, the company announced.
paras.zh: 该公司宣布，10 月份，Pronto Network 将与美国各地的独立汽车维修店一起支持 2026 年 Brakes for Breasts 筹款活动，这是一项全行业范围内为乳腺癌疫苗研究筹集资金的活动。

paras.en: As part of the fundraiser, participating Pronto Network Service Centers will provide customers with free brake pads or shoes. Customers pay for labor and any additional parts necessary to complete the brake job, and shops then donate 10% of the brake job directly to the Cleveland Clinic Breast Cancer Vaccine Research Fund, specifically supporting The Dr. Tuohy Lab and its breast cancer vaccine research. The Pronto Network says it will then match the donations made by these service centers.
paras.zh: 作为筹款活动的一部分，参与活动的 Pronto 网络服务中心将为客户提供免费的刹车片或刹车鞋。客户支付完成制动工作所需的人工和任何额外零件的费用，然后商店将制动工作的 10% 直接捐赠给克利夫兰诊所乳腺癌疫苗研究基金，专门支持 The Dr. Tuohy 实验室及其乳腺癌疫苗研究。 Pronto Network 表示，随后将匹配这些服务中心的捐款。

paras.en: Sponsoring Manufacturers and Partner Support
paras.zh: 赞助制造商和合作伙伴支持

paras.en: Additional sponsoring manufacturers participating in the fundraiser include Bendix, Bosch, DuraGo, NewTek, PowerStop, ProMax, and Wagner.
paras.zh: 参与筹款活动的其他赞助制造商包括 Bendix、博世、DuraGo、NewTek、PowerStop、ProMax 和 Wagner。

paras.en: “We’re excited to bring the Brakes for Breasts fundraiser to a select group of our service centers this year,” said Kerri Gulick, director of marketing and communications for The Pronto Network. “Independent repair shops have strong connections to the communities they serve, and this fundraiser gives our network an opportunity to come together to support research that could have a meaningful impact on the future of breast cancer vaccines. We’re grateful to our participating members, service centers, and manufacturer partners for helping us support this important cause.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴今年能将 Brakes for Breasts 筹款活动带到我们精选的服务中心，”Pronto Network 营销和传播总监 Kerri Gulick 说道。 “独立维修店与他们所服务的社区有着密切的联系，这次筹款活动使我们的网络有机会齐心协力支持可能对乳腺癌疫苗的未来产生有意义影响的研究。我们感谢我们的参与会员、服务中心和制造商合作伙伴帮助我们支持这一重要事业。”

paras.en: The research supported by Brakes for Breasts is being conducted by The Dr. Tuohy Lab at Cleveland Clinic, whose researchers have developed a breast cancer vaccine that proved effective in laboratory animals. Phase 1 clinical trials were successfully completed in 2026, and the lab is actively working toward the launch of Phase 2 in 2027.
paras.zh: Brakes for Breasts 支持的这项研究由克利夫兰诊所的 Tuohy 博士实验室进行，该实验室的研究人员开发了一种乳腺癌疫苗，并在实验动物中证明有效。一期临床试验已于2026年顺利完成，实验室正在积极争取2027年启动二期临床试验。

articles.title: Understanding Honda’s Variable Valve Timing System
articles.author: Jerry Renshaw

paras.en: It’s been understood for a long time that being able to control valve lift, duration and timing is a great way to optimize various aspects of engine performance. It can enhance power, throttle response, fuel economy and emissions, and engine designers have devised hydraulic, electro-hydraulic and even “camless” systems that use poppet valves rather than a conventional valve train. With stricter emissions standards in place, many manufacturers see variable valve timing (VVT) as a good way to hit those targets.
paras.zh: 长期以来，人们一直认为能够控制气门升程、持续时间和正时是优化发动机各个方面性能的好方法。它可以增强动力、节气门响应、燃油经济性和排放，发动机设计者设计了液压、电动液压甚至“无凸轮”系统，这些系统使用提升阀而不是传统的气门机构。随着更严格的排放标准的实施，许多制造商将可变气门正时 (VVT) 视为实现这些目标的好方法。

paras.en: A lumpy racing cam can introduce a lot more air into the combustion chambers, enhancing efficiency, but that usually means a rough idle and possible drivability problems at lower RPMs. A less aggressive cam might mean a smooth idle, but when intake valves close too early at higher engine speeds it can compromise performance. If both intake and exhaust valves are open, even just momentarily, it can cause unburnt fuel to exit the engine or can push unburnt gases back into the intake manifold.
paras.zh: 块状的赛车凸轮可以将更多的空气引入燃烧室，从而提高效率，但这通常意味着在较低转速下怠速不稳，并且可能出现驾驶性能问题。不太积极的凸轮可能意味着平稳的怠速，但是当进气门在较高的发动机转速下过早关闭时，可能会损害性能。如果进气门和排气门都打开，即使只是暂时打开，也会导致未燃烧的燃料排出发动机或将未燃烧的气体推回进气歧管。

paras.en: Earlier VVT systems were two-step designs, with one timing profile for engine speeds below 3500 RPM or so, and another timing and lift profile for engine speeds above 3500 RPM. Newer VVTs are designed for infinite adjustment throughout the RPM range.
paras.zh: 早期的 VVT 系统采用两步式设计，一种正时曲线适用于发动机转速低于 3500 RPM 左右的情况，另一种正时和升程曲线适用于发动机转速高于 3500 RPM 的情况。较新的 VVT 设计用于在整个 RPM 范围内进行无限调节。

paras.en: VVT systems date back as far as early aircraft engines and even steam locomotives, while Fiat was the first manufacturer to introduce a successful VVT design in the late ‘60s. One of the most successful and reliable systems, though, has been Honda’s Variable Valve Timing and Lift Electronic Control (VTEC) and i-VTEC designs. Honda’s systems have been around since model year 1989. Let’s take a closer look.
paras.zh: VVT 系统的历史可以追溯到早期的飞机发动机甚至蒸汽机车，而菲亚特是 60 年代末第一家成功引入 VVT 设计的制造商。不过，最成功、最可靠的系统之一是本田的可变气门正时和升程电子控制 (VTEC) 和 i-VTEC 设计。本田的系统自 1989 年车型以来就已存在。让我们仔细看看。

paras.en: Any VVT system is designed to change the relationship between the crankshaft and camshaft. Older, simpler systems use a phaser that enables a range of adjustment, but only for valve timing and not lift and duration. Here’s a quick breakdown of how VTEC performs:
paras.zh: 任何 VVT 系统都是为了改变曲轴和凸轮轴之间的关系而设计的。较旧、较简单的系统使用相位器，可以进行一系列调整，但仅限于气门正时，而不是升程和持续时间。以下是 VTEC 性能的快速细分：

paras.en: As RPMs go up, the engine management computer directs oil through the rocker shaft (the horizontal tube that runs through all the rocker arms).
paras.zh: 随着转速上升，发动机管理计算机将机油引导通过摇臂轴（穿过所有摇臂的水平管）。

paras.en: As this oil pressure goes up, a pin is actuated and slides through the low-RPM rocker arms, locking them together with a third high-RPM rocker arm.
paras.zh: 随着油压上升，销被驱动并滑过低转速摇臂，将它们与第三个高转速摇臂锁定在一起。

paras.en: Each cylinder has a third lobe on the camshaft, situated between the lobes for intake and exhaust valves, and this third rocker arm follows that lobe and its profile to optimize valvetrain operation for higher engine speeds.
paras.zh: 每个气缸的凸轮轴上都有第三个凸角，位于进气门和排气门的凸角之间，第三个摇臂遵循该凸角及其轮廓，以优化气门机构操作，以实现更高的发动机转速。

paras.en: This technology was first explored on Honda’s motorcycle engine, then Honda’s New Engine Concept project (unveiled in 1984) helped convince the OEM’s management that a dynamic cam phasing system was a good feature for enhancing engine performance.
paras.zh: 这项技术首先在本田的摩托车发动机上进行了探索，然后本田的新发动机概念项目（于 1984 年推出）帮助 OEM 管理层相信动态凸轮定相系统是增强发动机性能的一个很好的功能。

paras.en: The i-VTEC (“i” for Intelligent) debuted in 2001 and uses an adjustable cam gear that’s actuated by oil pressure. The ECM constantly monitors engine load and RPMs to make adjustments to cam timing in real time, while the VTEC system only kicks in at about 4000 RPMs or more. i-VTEC is available in two different iterations: one for performance engines (think Civic Si or Acura TSX) and one for economy and daily drivers (think Accord or CR-V). With i-VTEC setups, the camshaft for intake valves can be adjustable from 25 to 50 degrees, from fully retarded at idle to mild advance at full throttle.
paras.zh: i-VTEC（“i”代表智能）于 2001 年首次亮相，采用由油压驱动的可调节凸轮装置。 ECM 持续监控发动机负载和 RPM，以实时调整凸轮正时，而 VTEC 系统仅在大约 4000 RPM 或更高时启动。 i-VTEC 有两种不同的版本：一种用于高性能发动机（例如 Civic Si 或 Acura TSX），一种用于经济型和日常驾驶者（例如 Accord 或 CR-V）。借助 i-VTEC 设置，进气门凸轮轴的调节范围为 25 至 50 度，从怠速时完全延迟到全油门时温和提前。

paras.en: i-VTEC is still featured in select naturally-aspirated models, including the Civic, HR-V and CR-V, although it’s gradually being phased out in favor of turbocharging and more standard VTC systems. It can still be found in Honda’s K-series, R-series, J-series and L-series engine families.
paras.zh: i-VTEC 仍然在部分自然吸气车型中使用，包括 Civic、HR-V 和 CR-V，但它正逐渐被涡轮增压和更标准的 VTC 系统所取代。它仍然可以在本田的 K 系列、R 系列、J 系列和 L 系列发动机家族中找到。

paras.en: In economy setups, with four valves per cylinder, VTEC-E can effectively make the engine operate as a 12-valve by shutting down one intake valve at lower RPMs. Honda’s V6 engines pair up the i-VTEC design with Variable Cylinder Management (VCM), which shuts down three or even four cylinders during light-load, steady RPM situations such as highway cruising. Honda now also offers turbo four-cyliners with i-VTEC for even more performance and power.
paras.zh: 在经济型设置中，每缸有 4 个气门，VTEC-E 可以通过在较低转速时关闭一个进气门，有效地使发动机作为 12 气门运行。本田的 V6 发动机将 i-VTEC 设计与可变气缸管理 (VCM) 相结合，可在高速公路巡航等轻载、转速稳定的情况下关闭三个甚至四个气缸。本田现在还提供配备 i-VTEC 的涡轮四缸发动机，以实现更高的性能和动力。

paras.en: VTEC adds a layer of complexity to any engine, and it does sometimes come with some service bugs, despite Honda’s reputation for reliability.
paras.zh: VTEC 为任何发动机增加了一层复杂性，尽管本田在可靠性方面享有盛誉，但它有时确实会出现一些维修错误。

paras.en: - Low oil volume or dirty oil can affect operation, since VTEC relies on oil pressure to lock the rocker arms together with the more aggressive cam lobe. Low oil levels or contaminated oil can starve the system.
paras.zh: - 油量低或油脏会影响操作，因为 VTEC 依靠油压将摇臂与更具攻击性的凸轮凸角锁定在一起。低油位或受污染的油可能会导致系统饥饿。

paras.en: - Dirty oil can contaminate and clog the tiny mesh filter behind the VTEC solenoid.
paras.zh: - 脏油会污染并堵塞 VTEC 电磁阀后面的微小网状过滤器。

paras.en: - VTEC solenoids and pressure switches have been known to fail or become stuck mechanically.
paras.zh: - VTEC 电磁阀和压力开关已知会发生故障或机械卡住。

paras.en: - In some instances, a failed pressure switch or sensor fault can limit RPMs to about 3000, triggering limp mode and an illuminated CEL.
paras.zh: - 在某些情况下，压力开关故障或传感器故障可能会将 RPM 限制在 3000 左右，从而触发跛行模式并点亮 CEL。

paras.en: These problems can register trouble codes P1259/P1253 (system malfunction or circuit failure), P2646/P2647 (rockers oil pressure switch circuit low/high) or OBD1 codes 21 or 22 (VTEC solenoid valve or VTEC oil pressure switch).
paras.zh: 这些问题可记录故障代码 P1259/P1253（系统故障或电路故障）、P2646/P2647（摇臂油压开关电路低/高）或 OBD1 代码 21 或 22（VTEC 电磁阀或 VTEC 油压开关）。

paras.en: If you suspect a solenoid issue, touch a 12v jumper wire to the solenoid terminal; even with the engine off, you should hear a click as the internal plunger moves. In many cases, the pickup screen for the solenoid can be cleaned of gunk and debris with Brakleen. Drivability symptoms can include rough idle, stalling, limp mode, bucking and sputtering, loss of power and, in some cases, trouble codes for emissions or traction control. It’s important to remember to let the engine get up to operating temperature before attempting any troubleshooting.
paras.zh: 如果您怀疑电磁阀有问题，请将 12V 跳线接触电磁阀端子；即使发动机关闭，内部柱塞移动时您也应该听到咔嗒声。在许多情况下，可以使用 Brakleen 清除电磁阀拾取屏幕上的污垢和碎片。驾驶性能症状可能包括怠速不稳、失速、跛行模式、颠簸和溅射、动力损失，以及在某些情况下排放或牵引力控制的故障代码。重要的是要记住在尝试任何故障排除之前让发动机达到工作温度。

paras.en: Honda’s cylinder deactivation has come with its share of problems. Even though the deactivated cylinders aren’t firing, they’re still creating a vacuum that can draw oil past the piston rings and oil control ring and up into the combustion chamber. Common issues include oil consumption, fouled spark plugs, misfires and even piston ring and catalytic converter damage. Drivers also report harshness and vibration due to an altered engine balance, wearing out hydraulic motor mounts prematurely. The oil burning and piston ring wear issues have even resulted in a class action lawsuit that Honda has had to follow up on, as well as numerous technical service bulletins. Coolant-sensor bypass devices are available to trick the engine management computer into shutting down the VCM feature and keeping all cylinders firing, compromising fuel economy in favor of engine longevity and smoothness.
paras.zh: 本田的停缸技术也带来了一些问题。即使停用的气缸没有点火，它们仍然会产生真空，可以将油吸入活塞环和油控制环并向上进入燃烧室。常见问题包括油耗、火花塞污染、失火，甚至活塞环和催化转化器损坏。驾驶员还报告说，由于发动机平衡改变，液压马达支架过早磨损，带来了不平顺性和振动。烧油和活塞环磨损问题甚至引发了本田不得不跟进的集体诉讼，以及无数的技术服务公告。冷却液传感器旁路装置可诱骗发动机管理计算机关闭 VCM 功能并保持所有气缸点火，从而牺牲燃油经济性以利于发动机寿命和平稳性。

paras.en: The VCM system settlement covered Accord models (2008-2012), Odyssey models (2008-2013), Pilot models (2009-2013) and Crosstour models (2010-2012). As part of that settlement, Honda extended the powertrain warranty to eight years and unlimited mileage and reimbursed customers for out-of-pocket expenses related to diagnostics and repairs.
paras.zh: VCM系统和解涉及雅阁车型（2008-2012年）、奥德赛车型（2008-2013年）、Pilot车型（2009-2013年）和Crosstour车型（2010-2012年）。作为和解协议的一部分，本田将动力总成保修期延长至八年和无限里程，并报销客户与诊断和维修相关的自付费用。

paras.en: A separate lawsuit covers the 3.5L J35 V6 from model years 2016-2023 in models that include the Ridgeline, Pilot, Odyssey and Passport as well as the Acura MDX and TLX. This one stems from improperly ground crankshaft pins that can lead to premature bearing, piston and rod failure. Complaints have ranged from roughness to knocking, ticking, metal shavings in the oil filter and even complete engine seizure.
paras.zh: 另一项诉讼涉及 2016-2023 年车型的 3.5L J35 V6，其中包括 Ridgeline、Pilot、Odyssey 和 Passport 以及 Acura MDX 和 TLX。这一问题源于曲轴销磨削不当，可能导致轴承、活塞和连杆过早失效。投诉范围从粗糙度到敲击声、滴答声、机油滤清器中的金属屑，甚至发动机完全卡死。

articles.title: Litens Aftermarket’s Scott Howat on Complete Belt Drive Systems
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Scott Howat, director of sales and marketing, Litens Aftermarket N.A.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是北美 Litens 售后市场销售和营销总监 Scott Howat。

paras.en: Howat said the company’s engineering-driven approach is what differentiates its belt drive tensioners. With a history of innovation dating back to its founder’s invention of the first belt tensioner in 1979, Litens has developed an extensive portfolio of patented technologies. Litens engineers complete belt drive systems, with the tensioner and pulley system playing a central role in their operation. Howat emphasized that this engineering expertise and problem-solving approach allow Litens to deliver innovative tensioning solutions to the aftermarket.
paras.zh: Howat 表示，该公司的工程驱动方法使其皮带传动张紧器与众不同。 Litens 的创新历史可以追溯到 1979 年其创始人发明的第一个皮带张紧器，目前已开发出广泛的专利技术组合。莱顿工程师完成了皮带传动系统，其中张紧器和皮带轮系统在其运行中发挥着核心作用。 Howat 强调，这种工程专业知识和解决问题的方法使莱顿能够为售后市场提供创新的张紧解决方案。

paras.en: Howat outlined Litens’ strategy for integrating Dolz into its aftermarket portfolio, following its acquisition of the European water pump manufacturer about three years ago. Building on the approach used to establish the Litens brand in North America, the company is taking a phased approach to introducing Dolz to the market and building brand awareness. Howat, who oversees the company’s North American sales and marketing operations, said the strategy includes a marketing campaign launched this year, with plans to formally introduce the Dolz brand at AAPEX.
paras.zh: Howat 概述了莱顿在大约三年前收购欧洲水泵制造商 Dolz 后将其整合到其售后市场产品组合中的战略。基于在北美建立 Litens 品牌的方法，该公司正在采取分阶段的方法将 Dolz 引入市场并建立品牌知名度。负责该公司北美销售和营销业务的 Howat 表示，该战略包括今年启动的营销活动，并计划在 AAPEX 上正式推出 Dolz 品牌。

paras.en: Litens’ ability to translate OE engineering expertise into aftermarket innovation begins with its extensive OE product knowledge and data, Howat explained. This expertise also enables the company to identify opportunities to improve upon existing OE designs.
paras.zh: Howat 解释说，莱顿将原厂工程专业知识转化为售后市场创新的能力始于其广泛的原厂产品知识和数据。这种专业知识还使公司能够找到改进现有 OE 设计的机会。

paras.en: As an example, Howat highlighted Litens’ newly patented Easy Button Latch technology, which simplifies tensioner installation by incorporating the locking mechanism directly into the component. The innovation eliminates installation challenges associated with conventional locking pins. It demonstrates how Litens leverages its engineering capabilities to develop aftermarket solutions that deliver practical benefits to technicians.
paras.zh: 作为一个例子，Howat 重点介绍了 Litens 新获得专利的 Easy Button Latch 技术，该技术通过将锁定机构直接集成到组件中来简化张紧器的安装。这项创新消除了与传统锁定销相关的安装挑战。它展示了莱顿如何利用其工程能力来开发售后解决方案，为技术人员带来实际好处。

paras.en: - How Litens’ engineering expertise and patented tensioner technologies differentiate its belt drive systems. (5:00)
paras.zh: - Litens 的工程专业知识和专利张紧器技术如何使其皮带传动系统脱颖而出。 （5:00）

paras.en: - How Litens is integrating Dolz into its portfolio and building brand awareness in the North American aftermarket. (6:53)
paras.zh: - Litens 如何将 Dolz 整合到其产品组合中并在北美售后市场建立品牌知名度。 (6:53)

paras.en: - Litens leverages OE engineering expertise and data to develop innovative aftermarket solutions. (8:30)
paras.zh: - Litens 利用 OE 工程专业知识和数据来开发创新的售后解决方案。 （8:30）

paras.en: - Litens’ patented Easy Button Latch technology simplifies tensioner installation for technicians. (9:36)
paras.zh: - Litens 的 Easy Button Latch 专利技术简化了技术人员的张紧器安装。 （9:36）

paras.en: - Lightning Round: Howat shares some personal insights. (11:24)
paras.zh: - 闪电轮：Howat 分享一些个人见解。 (11:24)

articles.title: BendPak Tire Changers, Wheel Balancers Earn Safety Certification
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Wheel balancers and tire changers from the Ranger Division of BendPak have earned ETL certification, the company announced. All current models meet applicable UL and CSA safety standards in the United States and Canada.
paras.zh: 该公司宣布，BendPak Ranger 部门的车轮平衡机和轮胎拆装机已获得 ETL 认证。所有当前型号均符合美国和加拿大适用的 UL 和 CSA 安全标准。

paras.en: Intertek Testing Services independently tested the equipment and validated its compliance with electrical, pneumatic and mechanical safety requirements. Intertek is a nationally recognized testing laboratory.
paras.zh: Intertek 测试服务独立测试了设备并验证其符合电气、气动和机械安全要求。 Intertek是国家认可的测试实验室。

paras.en: BendPak Completes 18-Month Certification Project
paras.zh: BendPak 完成为期 18 个月的认证项目

paras.en: The certification followed an 18-month BendPak project to overhaul critical internal components and safety systems. The company redesigned the equipment to meet applicable standards.
paras.zh: 该认证是在为期 18 个月的 BendPak 项目之后获得的，该项目旨在检修关键的内部组件和安全系统。该公司重新设计了设备以满足适用的标准。

paras.en: The project included upgrades to electrical architecture, structural components and mechanical and pneumatic systems.
paras.zh: 该项目包括电气架构、结构部件以及机械和气动系统的升级。

paras.en: The company redesigned or replaced components that did not meet the required criteria. BendPak also reconfigured systems and incorporated additional safeguards.
paras.zh: 该公司重新设计或更换了不符合要求标准的部件。 BendPak 还重新配置了系统并纳入了额外的防护措施。

paras.en: BendPak says it then subjected every modification to testing before the equipment could achieve certification.
paras.zh: BendPak 表示，在设备获得认证之前，它会对每项修改进行测试。

paras.en: The ETL mark on the product label identifies certified equipment.
paras.zh: 产品标签上的 ETL 标志标识经过认证的设备。

paras.en: Certification Covers Ranger Wheel Service Equipment
paras.zh: 认证涵盖 Ranger Wheel 服务设备

paras.en: Certified Ranger wheel service equipment includes:
paras.zh: 经过认证的 Ranger 车轮维修设备包括：

paras.en: - LS45DS Laser-Spot sonar wheel balancer
paras.zh: - LS45DS 激光点声纳车轮平衡仪

paras.en: - RB30T heavy-duty truck and passenger car wheel balancer
paras.zh: - RB30T重型卡车和客车车轮平衡机

paras.en: - R76ATR single-tower tilt-back tire changer
paras.zh: - R76ATR单塔后倾式轮胎拆装机

paras.en: - R980DP dual-assist swing-arm tire changer
paras.zh: - R980DP 双辅助摆臂式轮胎拆装机

paras.en: - R80EX dual-tower tilt-back tire changer
paras.zh: - R80EX双塔后倾式轮胎拆装机

articles.title: Turning ADAS Calibration into a Competitive Advantage
articles.author: Autel

paras.en: See how Zimbrick of Madison transformed its approach to ADAS calibration by bringing more of the process in-house. With three body shops, 16 automotive brands and a centralized glass and calibration center, Zimbrick partnered with National Calibration and Diagnostic Solutions (NCDS) and Autel to build a more controlled and scalable calibration workflow. The video explores how the right equipment, training and support can help collision repair facilities improve efficiency, documentation, repair quality and customer communication while keeping up with increasingly complex vehicle technology.
paras.zh: 了解 Zimbrick of Madison 如何通过将更多流程引入内部来改变其 ADAS 校准方法。 Zimbrick 拥有 3 个车身修理厂、16 个汽车品牌以及一个集中式玻璃和校准中心，与国家校准和诊断解决方案 (NCDS) 以及 Autel 合作，构建了更加受控和可扩展的校准工作流程。该视频探讨了正确的设备、培训和支持如何帮助碰撞修复机构提高效率、文档记录、维修质量和客户沟通，同时跟上日益复杂的车辆技术的步伐。

paras.en: - Bringing ADAS calibration in-house: Zimbrick reduced its reliance on outside vendors to gain greater control over scanning, calibration and the overall repair process.
paras.zh: - 将 ADAS 校准引入内部：Zimbrick 减少了对外部供应商的依赖，以更好地控制扫描、校准和整个维修过程。

paras.en: - Centralizing calibration services: A hub-and-spoke model allows three body shops to work with a centralized calibration center while maintaining consistent processes.
paras.zh: - 集中校准服务：中心辐射模型允许三个车身修理厂与集中校准中心合作，同时保持一致的流程。

paras.en: - Improving repair quality and accountability: In-house capabilities give Zimbrick greater visibility into technician training, OEM procedures, documentation and how calibrations are completed.
paras.zh: - 提高维修质量和问责制：内部能力使 Zimbrick 能够更好地了解技术人员培训、OEM 程序、文档以及如何完成校准。

paras.en: - Combining glass and calibration: Locating glass replacement and ADAS calibration together allows Zimbrick to complete more windshield installations and calibrations on the same day.
paras.zh: - 将玻璃和校准相结合：将玻璃更换和 ADAS 校准结合在一起，使 Zimbrick 能够在同一天完成更多挡风玻璃安装和校准。

paras.en: - Training the entire team: Education extends beyond technicians to estimators, helping staff better understand ADAS requirements and explain necessary procedures to customers.
paras.zh: - 培训整个团队：教育范围从技术人员延伸到估算人员，帮助员工更好地了解 ADAS 要求并向客户解释必要的程序。

paras.en: - Building customer confidence: Employees can explain why a calibration is required, what equipment is being used and how the procedure fits into a complete repair rather than simply presenting an additional charge.
paras.zh: - 建立客户信心：员工可以解释为什么需要校准、使用什么设备以及该程序如何适应完整的维修，而不是简单地收取额外费用。

paras.en: - Getting more from ADAS technology: Autel equipment provides diagnostic, calibration and documentation capabilities, while NCDS provides tooling recommendations, training, workflow guidance and ongoing technical support.
paras.zh: - 从 ADAS 技术中获得更多收益：Autel 设备提供诊断、校准和文档功能，而 NCDS 提供工具建议、培训、工作流程指导和持续的技术支持。

paras.en: - Creating a scalable operation: With approximately 400 repair orders moving through the operation each month, bringing scans and calibrations under Zimbrick’s control helps turn a necessary repair procedure into an opportunity for greater efficiency and additional in-house service.
paras.zh: - 创建可扩展的运营：每个月约有 400 个维修订单通过运营，将扫描和校准置于 Zimbrick 的控制之下有助于将必要的维修程序转变为提高效率和额外内部服务的机会。

articles.title: NAPA Academy Provides New Training Resources
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Running a successful parts store requires more than knowing which part fits which vehicle. It takes effective inventory management, dependable delivery service, employees who understand customers’ needs and a manager who can connect everyday decisions to the store’s financial performance.
paras.zh: 经营一家成功的零件店需要的不仅仅是知道哪个零件适合哪辆车。它需要有效的库存管理、可靠的送货服务、了解客户需求的员工以及能够将日常决策与商店财务业绩联系起来的经理。

paras.en: NAPA is giving independent store owners new resources to develop those capabilities through NAPA Academy, extending training developed for its company-owned stores to independent businesses. The program was introduced during the 2026 NAPA Store Owner and Field Sales Meeting, held Sept. 21-24 in Atlanta. The initial offering focuses on store managers, combining short online courses with a downloadable resource guide designed to help translate training into daily practice.
paras.zh: NAPA 正在为独立商店所有者提供新的资源，以通过 NAPA 学院发展这些能力，并将为其公司拥有的商店开发的培训扩展到独立企业。该计划是在 9 月 21 日至 24 日在亚特兰大举行的 2026 年 NAPA 商店业主和现场销售会议期间推出的。最初的产品主要针对商店经理，将简短的在线课程与可下载的资源指南相结合，旨在帮助将培训转化为日常实践。

paras.en: Introducing the program, Cassie Bell, NAPA’s senior vice president of HR, said the expansion supports the company’s Drive 2030 strategy and its investment in people. Although owners have requested training for several positions, she said store managers were a logical starting point.
paras.zh: NAPA 人力资源高级副总裁 Cassie Bell 在介绍该计划时表示，此次扩张支持公司的 Drive 2030 战略及其对人才的投资。尽管店主要求对多个职位进行培训，但她表示，商店经理是一个合乎逻辑的起点。

paras.en: “We believe fundamentally that the store manager is critical to obtaining consistent customer service, to building the teams and driving those operational performances inside of our stores,” Bell said.
paras.zh: 贝尔说：“我们从根本上认为，商店经理对于获得一致的客户服务、建设团队和推动商店内部的运营绩效至关重要。”

paras.en: The program’s development began with a practical question: What do successful employees and stores do differently?
paras.zh: 该计划的开发始于一个实际问题：成功的员工和商店的做法有何不同？

paras.en: Jesse Parrish, NAPA’s director of learning and development, said the Academy worked with teams across the organization to identify the knowledge, skills and behaviors that define excellence in specific roles. NAPA partnered with industry professionals to turn those findings into training, reference materials and learning pathways.
paras.zh: NAPA 学习和发展总监 Jesse Parrish 表示，学院与整个组织的团队合作，确定定义特定角色卓越表现的知识、技能和行为。 NAPA 与行业专业人士合作，将这些发现转化为培训、参考材料和学习途径。

paras.en: By observing high-performing managers and market directors in top-performing stores, the team identified the practices and strategies driving their success. Those real-world insights became the foundation for new training programs designed to help others apply proven strategies throughout the organization.
paras.zh: 通过观察表现最好的商店中的表现出色的经理和市场总监，团队确定了推动他们成功的实践和策略。这些现实世界的见解成为新培训计划的基础，旨在帮助其他人在整个组织中应用经过验证的策略。

paras.en: For store operations, the resulting framework has four areas of emphasis: driving financial results, leading and developing teams, enabling operational excellence and delivering exceptional customer service.
paras.zh: 对于商店运营，最终框架有四个重点领域：推动财务业绩、领导和发展团队、实现卓越运营以及提供卓越的客户服务。

paras.en: Those areas address responsibilities ranging from understanding store performance and building improvement plans to coaching employees, managing inventory, optimizing delivery service and building customer loyalty.
paras.zh: 这些领域涉及的职责包括了解商店绩效和制定改进计划、指导员工、管理库存、优化送货服务和建立客户忠诚度。

paras.en: The team documented those practices in how-to guides, training courses and tools intended to help other stores apply them.
paras.zh: 该团队将这些做法记录在操作指南、培训课程和工具中，旨在帮助其他商店应用它们。

paras.en: The online courses generally take 10 to 20 minutes to complete. Owners can take the courses themselves or assign them to employees, allowing training to address specific development needs.
paras.zh: 在线课程通常需要 10 到 20 分钟才能完成。业主可以自己参加课程或将课程分配给员工，从而通过培训来满足特定的发展需求。

paras.en: Although the first offering centers on store management, its usefulness extends to other positions. Parrish pointed to customer service lessons, including effective phone conversations, as examples of content relevant to counter employees.
paras.zh: 尽管第一个产品以商店管理为中心，但它的用处扩展到其他职位。帕里什指出，客户服务课程（包括有效的电话交谈）是与柜台员工相关的内容示例。

paras.en: “It is not just limited to the store manager,” he said. “While the content’s focused on them, there are relevant courses here for others that may be frontline workers working the counter.”
paras.zh: “这不仅限于商店经理，”他说。 “虽然内容主要针对他们，但这里也有针对其他可能是柜台一线工作人员的相关课程。”

paras.en: That connection matters because a store’s customer experience depends on both management decisions and individual employee interactions. Training managers to coach their teams complements instruction that helps counter professionals better serve wholesale and retail customers.
paras.zh: 这种联系很重要，因为商店的客户体验取决于管理决策和员工个人互动。培训经理来指导他们的团队补充了指导，帮助柜台专业人员更好地为批发和零售客户服务。

paras.en: The second major resource is a downloadable store manager guide. It outlines the role’s responsibilities, key functions and performance metrics, with linked how-to guidance covering subjects such as budgeting, performance management, customer service and root cause analysis.
paras.zh: 第二个主要资源是可下载的商店经理指南。它概述了该角色的职责、关键职能和绩效指标，并附有涵盖预算、绩效管理、客户服务和根本原因分析等主题的相关操作指南。

paras.en: Parrish described its purpose in everyday terms: helping employees understand “how do you do the work on a Tuesday morning at nine o’clock?”
paras.zh: 帕里什用日常用语描述了其目的：帮助员工了解“周二早上九点钟你是如何工作的？”

paras.en: The training framework recognizes three proficiency levels: foundation, advanced and mastery. Foundation focuses on performing a job independently and effectively. Advanced emphasizes consistently meeting performance targets and helping others succeed. Mastery involves anticipating opportunities, leading broader improvements and consistently exceeding targets.
paras.zh: 培训框架承认三个熟练程度：基础、高级和精通。基金会专注于独立有效地开展工作。高级强调始终如一地实现绩效目标并帮助他人取得成功。精通包括预测机会、领导更广泛的改进以及持续超越目标。

paras.en: That structure provides a development path for employees with different experience levels, from someone entering a management role to an established leader seeking to improve store performance.
paras.zh: 这种结构为不同经验水平的员工提供了一条发展道路，从进入管理岗位的员工到寻求提高商店绩效的既定领导者。

paras.en: Participation is voluntary, Parrish emphasized, with independent owners able to use the resources as they see fit within their businesses. The materials are intended to remain within the NAPA family. NAPA also is exploring how to tailor resources further to independent owners’ needs.
paras.zh: 帕里什强调，参与是自愿的，独立所有者可以根据自己的业务使用他们认为合适的资源。这些材料旨在保留在 NAPA 系列中。 NAPA 还在探索如何进一步调整资源以满足独立业主的需求。

paras.en: Bell encouraged owners to access the content, develop a plan for using it and return regularly as materials are updated. She also asked them to share feedback about missing resources or opportunities for improvement.
paras.zh: 贝尔鼓励所有者访问这些内容，制定使用计划，并在材料更新时定期返回。她还要求他们分享有关缺少资源或改进机会的反馈。

paras.en: “If you need something more, you need something different, something’s not working, whatever that looks like, please reach back out to us,” Bell said. “We are only as good as the feedback we’re receiving from you.”
paras.zh: 贝尔说：“如果你需要更多东西，你需要一些不同的东西，有些东西不起作用，无论看起来是什么样的，请联系我们。” “我们的表现取决于您从我们那里收到的反馈。”

articles.title: AACF Golf Tournament Sells Out All Foursomes for 2026
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) announced that all foursomes for its 34th annual Bob Schoeberl Memorial Golf Tournament have sold out. More than 220 golfers will participate in the AACF golf tournament to support aftermarket families facing hardship.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 宣布，第 34 届年度鲍勃·舍伯尔纪念高尔夫锦标赛的所有四人一组均已售完。超过 220 名高尔夫球手将参加 AACF 高尔夫锦标赛，以支持面临困难的售后家庭。

paras.en: The tournament takes place Nov. 1-2, 2026, at Spanish Trail Country Club in Las Vegas. It brings together aftermarket leaders to raise funds for industry members and their families facing significant hardships. These include catastrophic illnesses, serious accidents, natural disasters and other life-changing circumstances.
paras.zh: 比赛将于 2026 年 11 月 1 日至 2 日在拉斯维加斯西班牙小径乡村俱乐部举行。它汇集了售后市场领导者，为面临重大困难的行业成员及其家人筹集资金。其中包括灾难性疾病、严重事故、自然灾害和其他改变生活的情况。

paras.en: “We are incredibly grateful for the response from our industry,” said John Kairys, executive director of AACF. “Selling out every foursome speaks volumes about the generosity of the companies and individuals who continue to stand behind AACF’s mission. Their support allows us to provide meaningful assistance to aftermarket families when they need it most.”
paras.zh: AACF 执行董事 John Kairys 表示：“我们非常感谢业界的回应。” “每四个人就卖完，充分说明了继续支持 AACF 使命的公司和个人的慷慨。他们的支持使我们能够在售后家庭最需要的时候为他们提供有意义的帮助。”

paras.en: AACF Golf Tournament Recognizes Industry Sponsors
paras.zh: AACF 高尔夫锦标赛表彰行业赞助商

paras.en: AACF recognizes its 2026 Diamond, Platinum and Gold sponsors for their support and commitment to helping industry families.
paras.zh: AACF 表彰其 2026 年钻石级、白金级和黄金级赞助商对帮助行业家庭的支持和承诺。

paras.en: - The Group, The Pronto Network and Federated Auto Parts
paras.zh: - 该集团、Pronto Network 和 Federated Auto Parts

paras.en: AACF also thanks its Event and Tee sponsors for their contributions. Their support helps make the tournament possible and provides assistance to families in need.
paras.zh: AACF 还感谢其赛事和 T 恤赞助商的贡献。他们的支持有助于使锦标赛成为可能，并为有需要的家庭提供帮助。

paras.en: The weekend begins Sunday evening, Nov. 1, with AACF’s Industry Cocktail Reception. The event features an open bar, hors d’oeuvres, live entertainment and opportunities to connect with aftermarket leaders.
paras.zh: 周末从 11 月 1 日星期日晚上开始，以 AACF 的行业鸡尾酒会开始。该活动设有开放式酒吧、开胃小菜、现场娱乐表演以及与售后市场领导者交流的机会。

paras.en: A live auction begins at 6:30 p.m. featuring:
paras.zh: 现场拍卖于下午 6:30 开始。特色：

paras.en: - Two Daytona 500 tickets in the Hendrick Motorsports Suite, including a $2,500 travel voucher. Valvoline Global Operations sponsors the package.
paras.zh: - 两张亨德里克赛车运动套房的 Daytona 500 门票，包括价值 2,500 美元的旅行代金券。胜牌全球运营部赞助了该套餐。

paras.en: - An AutoZone Liberty Bowl game and travel package, including airfare for two and two nights at the Peabody Hotel. AutoZone sponsors the package.
paras.zh: - AutoZone 自由碗比赛和旅行套餐，包括两晚机票和皮博迪酒店两晚。 AutoZone 赞助了该套餐。

paras.en: - A DuraMAX Grand Prix NASCAR at COTA race weekend in Austin, Texas, including airfare and hotel accommodations for two. RelaDyne sponsors the package.
paras.zh: - 在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的 COTA 比赛周末参加 DuraMAX NASCAR 大奖赛，包括两人机票和酒店住宿。 RelaDyne 赞助了该套餐。

paras.en: - A Buffalo Bills helmet featuring the signature of reigning NFL MVP Josh Allen. Castle Products sponsors the item.
paras.zh: - 布法罗比尔队头盔，带有卫冕 NFL MVP 乔什·艾伦 (Josh Allen) 的签名。 Castle Products 赞助该项目。

paras.en: Prize Drawing Supports Aftermarket Families
paras.zh: 抽奖活动支持售后家庭

paras.en: AACF’s prize drawing features 20 prizes, including a grand prize trip for two to Cabo. The drawing takes place during Monday’s tournament luncheon. Participants do not need to attend to win. Participants can enter the drawing at https://bit.ly/4yl0eWx.
paras.zh: AACF 的抽奖活动共有 20 个奖品，其中包括两人前往卡波的大奖之旅。抽签是在周一的锦标赛午餐期间进行的。参与者无需出席即可获胜。参与者可以通过https://bit.ly/4yl0eWx参与抽奖。

paras.en: Together, the live auction and prize drawing offer prizes valued at more than $50,000. Proceeds help AACF provide emergency assistance to families throughout the aftermarket. Golf begins Monday morning, Nov. 2. The tournament luncheon, prize drawing and awards presentation follow.
paras.zh: 现场拍卖和抽奖活动的奖品总价值超过 50,000 美元。所得收益将帮助 AACF 为整个售后市场的家庭提供紧急援助。高尔夫比赛于 11 月 2 日星期一上午开始。接下来是锦标赛午宴、抽奖和颁奖典礼。

paras.en: Additional Sponsorship Opportunities Remain
paras.zh: 仍有额外赞助机会

paras.en: Although all foursomes have sold out, companies can still participate through a limited number of Event and Tee sponsorships. Event sponsorships start at $3,300. Opportunities include sponsoring the golf luncheon, breakfast or course refreshments. Tee sponsorships cost $1,650.
paras.zh: 尽管所有四人一组均已售完，但公司仍然可以通过数量有限的活动和 T 恤赞助来参与。活动赞助起价为 3,300 美元。机会包括赞助高尔夫午餐、早餐或球场茶点。 T 恤赞助费为 1,650 美元。

paras.en: Sponsorships provide recognition throughout the event and include invitations to Sunday’s Industry Cocktail Reception. AACF encourages interested companies to act soon because limited sponsorship opportunities remain.
paras.zh: 赞助在整个活动期间提供认可，包括邀请参加周日的行业鸡尾酒会。由于赞助机会仍然有限，AACF 鼓励感兴趣的公司尽快采取行动。

paras.en: For event details and sponsorship information, visit https://aacfgolf.info/.
paras.zh: 有关活动详情和赞助信息，请访问 https://aacfgolf.info/。

articles.title: Alliance Fleet Solutions Joins VMS Distribution Network
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: Alliance Fleet Solutions joined the Vehicle Management Solutions (VMS) distribution network as a preferred partner. The company said this expands access to the VMS fleet management platform across Colorado and surrounding markets.
paras.zh: Alliance Fleet Solutions 作为首选合作伙伴加入了车辆管理解决方案 (VMS) 分销网络。该公司表示，这扩大了科罗拉多州及周边市场对 VMS 车队管理平台的访问范围。

paras.en: The agreement is part of the broader VMS strategy to distribute its AI-powered fleet technology through established fleet management providers. Alliance Fleet Solutions will offer VMS capabilities alongside its existing fleet services.
paras.zh: 该协议是更广泛的 VMS 战略的一部分，旨在通过成熟的车队管理提供商分发其人工智能驱动的车队技术。 Alliance Fleet Solutions 将在其现有车队服务的同时提供 VMS 功能。

paras.en: “Alliance Fleet Solutions is exactly the type of partner we envisioned when developing this model,” said Dave Prusinski, CEO of VMS. “They bring established relationships and a deep understanding of the fleets they serve, while VMS brings the technology and intelligence needed to help those fleets operate more proactively.”
paras.zh: “Alliance Fleet Solutions 正是我们在开发此模型时所设想的合作伙伴类型，”VMS 首席执行官 Dave Prusinski 说道。 “他们带来了既定的关系以及对其所服务的车队的深入了解，而 VMS 带来了帮助这些车队更主动地运营所需的技术和情报。”

paras.en: VMS Expands Through Fleet Management Providers
paras.zh: VMS 通过车队管理提供商进行扩展

paras.en: The company said the VMS distribution network gives access to technology without requiring users to develop their own AI-powered platform.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，VMS 分销网络无需用户开发自己的人工智能平台即可获取技术。

paras.en: VMS combines fleet data, workflows, and AI to help users identify issues and prioritize actions. It also lets customers manage vehicle and maintenance operations with less manual intervention.
paras.zh: VMS 结合了车队数据、工作流程和人工智能，帮助用户识别问题并确定行动的优先级。它还可以让客户以更少的人工干预来管理车辆和维护操作。

paras.en: Alliance Fleet Solutions provides fleet management services throughout Colorado and nearby markets.
paras.zh: Alliance Fleet Solutions 在整个科罗拉多州和附近市场提供车队管理服务。

paras.en: “At Alliance, we differentiate ourselves by going beyond fleet financing to help fleets spend only on what actually moves their bottom line—improving uptime, right-timing replacements, and maximizing resale value,” said Jonathon Spitz, VP of sales for Alliance Fleet Solutions.
paras.zh: Alliance Fleet Solutions 销售副总裁乔纳森·斯皮茨 (Jonathon Spitz) 表示：“在 Alliance，我们超越车队融资，帮助车队仅将支出用于真正能够提升利润的方面，从而实现差异化——提高正常运行时间、适时更换以及最大化转售价值。”

paras.en: “Partnering with VMS allows us to amplify results by using advanced technology and actionable intelligence to arrive at these decisions sooner.”
paras.zh: “与 VMS 合作使我们能够利用先进技术和可操作的情报来扩大结果，从而更快地做出这些决策。”

paras.en: Partnership Adds Technology to Existing Fleet Services
paras.zh: 合作伙伴关系为现有车队服务增添了技术

paras.en: The preferred partner model allows Alliance Fleet Solutions to add VMS technology to its existing customer relationships and services.
paras.zh: 首选合作伙伴模型允许 Alliance Fleet Solutions 将 VMS 技术添加到其现有的客户关系和服务中。

paras.en: VMS said its distribution strategy is designed to make its platform available through fleet management organizations that already serve customers across different fleet sizes and markets.
paras.zh: VMS 表示，其分销策略旨在通过车队管理组织提供其平台，这些组织已经为不同车队规模和市场的客户提供服务。

paras.en: The agreement is part of the broader VMS strategy to distribute its AI-powered fleet technology through established fleet management providers. Alliance Fleet Solutions will offer VMS capabilities alongside its existing fleet services.
paras.zh: 该协议是更广泛的 VMS 战略的一部分，旨在通过成熟的车队管理提供商分发其人工智能驱动的车队技术。 Alliance Fleet Solutions 将在其现有车队服务的同时提供 VMS 功能。

paras.en: “Alliance Fleet Solutions is exactly the type of partner we envisioned when developing this model,” said Dave Prusinski, CEO of VMS. “They bring established relationships and a deep understanding of the fleets they serve, while VMS brings the technology and intelligence needed to help those fleets operate more proactively.”
paras.zh: “Alliance Fleet Solutions 正是我们在开发此模型时所设想的合作伙伴类型，”VMS 首席执行官 Dave Prusinski 说道。 “他们带来了既定的关系以及对其所服务的车队的深入了解，而 VMS 带来了帮助这些车队更主动地运营所需的技术和情报。”

paras.en: VMS Expands Through Fleet Management Providers
paras.zh: VMS 通过车队管理提供商进行扩展

paras.en: The company said the VMS distribution network gives access to technology without requiring users to develop their own AI-powered platform.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，VMS 分销网络无需用户开发自己的人工智能平台即可获取技术。

paras.en: VMS combines fleet data, workflows, and AI to help users identify issues and prioritize actions. It also lets customers manage vehicle and maintenance operations with less manual intervention.
paras.zh: VMS 结合了车队数据、工作流程和人工智能，帮助用户识别问题并确定行动的优先级。它还可以让客户以更少的人工干预来管理车辆和维护操作。

paras.en: Alliance Fleet Solutions provides fleet management services throughout Colorado and nearby markets.
paras.zh: Alliance Fleet Solutions 在整个科罗拉多州和附近市场提供车队管理服务。

paras.en: “At Alliance, we differentiate ourselves by going beyond fleet financing to help fleets spend only on what actually moves their bottom line—improving uptime, right-timing replacements, and maximizing resale value,” said Jonathon Spitz, VP of sales for Alliance Fleet Solutions.
paras.zh: Alliance Fleet Solutions 销售副总裁乔纳森·斯皮茨 (Jonathon Spitz) 表示：“在 Alliance，我们超越车队融资，帮助车队仅将支出用于真正能够提升利润的方面，从而实现差异化——提高正常运行时间、适时更换以及最大化转售价值。”

paras.en: “Partnering with VMS allows us to amplify results by using advanced technology and actionable intelligence to arrive at these decisions sooner.”
paras.zh: “与 VMS 合作使我们能够利用先进技术和可操作的情报来扩大结果，从而更快地做出这些决策。”

paras.en: Partnership Adds Technology to Existing Fleet Services
paras.zh: 合作伙伴关系为现有车队服务增添了技术

paras.en: The preferred partner model allows Alliance Fleet Solutions to add VMS technology to its existing customer relationships and services.
paras.zh: 首选合作伙伴模型允许 Alliance Fleet Solutions 将 VMS 技术添加到其现有的客户关系和服务中。

paras.en: VMS said its distribution strategy is designed to make its platform available through fleet management organizations that already serve customers across different fleet sizes and markets.
paras.zh: VMS 表示，其分销策略旨在通过车队管理组织提供其平台，这些组织已经为不同车队规模和市场的客户提供服务。

articles.title: What to Know About Modern Windshield Replacement
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Butyl rubber was commonly used to install windshields decades ago but is unsuitable for modern vehicles. Today’s windshields use structural adhesives that help maintain vehicle integrity during collisions.
paras.zh: 几十年前，丁基橡胶普遍用于安装挡风玻璃，但不适用于现代车辆。如今的挡风玻璃使用结构粘合剂，有助于在碰撞过程中保持车辆的完整性。

paras.en: Counter pros should recommend manufacturer-approved windshield adhesives rather than butyl rubber. Proper installation is critical, especially on vehicles equipped with ADAS cameras that require calibration following windshield replacement.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人士应推荐制造商认可的挡风玻璃粘合剂，而不是丁基橡胶。正确安装至关重要，尤其是对于配备 ADAS 摄像头且更换挡风玻璃后需要校准的车辆。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: WAI Global Expands Late-Model Aftermarket Coverage
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: WAI Global expanded late-model aftermarket coverage to address evolving vehicle and application needs. In the third quarter of 2026, WAI Global introduced 124 new part numbers. These additions provide 100% new coverage for more than 52.3 million vehicles in operation across the United States and Canada.
paras.zh: WAI Global 扩大了新型售后市场覆盖范围，以满足不断变化的车辆和应用需求。 2026 年第三季度，WAI Global 推出了 124 个新零件号。这些新增服务为美国和加拿大超过 5230 万辆运营车辆提供 100% 的新覆盖。

paras.en: The third-quarter introductions broaden WAI Global’s aftermarket portfolio across several key product categories. These include alternators, starters, wiper motors, window regulators, voltage regulators, brake calipers, solenoids, sensors and motors. The additions address coverage gaps, improve parts availability and support changing aftermarket demand.
paras.zh: 第三季度的推出扩大了 WAI Global 多个关键产品类别的售后市场产品组合。其中包括交流发电机、起动器、雨刷器电机、车窗调节器、电压调节器、制动卡钳、电磁阀、传感器和电机。这些新增功能解决了覆盖范围差距，提高了零件可用性并支持不断变化的售后市场需求。

paras.en: “Our NPI strategy remains focused on identifying meaningful coverage gaps and bringing late-model and first-to-market solutions to customers quickly,” said Ron Bernstein, president, North America, WAI Global. “Adding coverage for more than 52 million vehicles this quarter reflects the scale of that effort and helps our customers stay ahead of changing vehicle populations and replacement demand.”
paras.zh: WAI Global 北美区总裁 Ron Bernstein 表示：“我们的 NPI 战略仍然专注于识别有意义的覆盖范围差距，并快速为客户提供最新型号和率先上市的解决方案。” “本季度增加了超过 5200 万辆汽车的覆盖范围，这反映了这一努力的规模，并帮助我们的客户领先于不断变化的车辆数量和更换需求。”

paras.en: Notable late-model releases introduced during the quarter include:
paras.zh: 本季度推出的值得注意的最新型号版本包括：

paras.en: - 30884N Starter: Up to 2026 Subaru Impreza
paras.zh: - 30884N 起动机：直至 2026 斯巴鲁翼豹

paras.en: - 41012N Alternator: Up to 2025 Toyota RAV4
paras.zh: - 41012N 交流发电机：直至 2025 年丰田 RAV4

paras.en: - WPM5036 Wiper Motor: Up to 2026 Hyundai Santa Fe and Tucson
paras.zh: - WPM5036 雨刮器电机：直至 2026 年现代 Santa Fe 和 Tucson

paras.en: - MAF20365 MAF Sensor: Up to 2026 Toyota Corolla and Sienna
paras.zh: - MAF20365 MAF 传感器：直至 2026 款丰田 Corolla 和 Sienna

paras.en: - 380448 Window Regulator: Up to 2026 Subaru Ascent
paras.zh: - 380448 车窗升降器：直至 2026 斯巴鲁 Ascent

paras.en: Product Development Focuses on Coverage Gaps
paras.zh: 产品开发重点关注覆盖范围差距

paras.en: The 124 new part numbers span multiple product categories and reflect WAI Global’s ongoing product development strategy. The latest additions prioritize late-model applications while expanding WAI Global’s 100% new aftermarket offering.
paras.zh: 124 个新零件号涵盖多个产品类别，反映了 WAI Global 持续的产品开发战略。最新增加的功能优先考虑最新型号应用，同时扩展 WAI Global 的 100% 新售后市场产品。

articles.title: NAPA Academy Provides New Training Resources
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Running a successful parts store requires more than knowing which part fits which vehicle. It takes effective inventory management, dependable delivery service, employees who understand customers’ needs and a manager who can connect everyday decisions to the store’s financial performance.
paras.zh: 经营一家成功的零件店需要的不仅仅是知道哪个零件适合哪辆车。它需要有效的库存管理、可靠的送货服务、了解客户需求的员工以及能够将日常决策与商店财务业绩联系起来的经理。

paras.en: NAPA is giving independent store owners new resources to develop those capabilities through NAPA Academy, extending training developed for its company-owned stores to independent businesses. The program was introduced during the 2026 NAPA Store Owner and Field Sales Meeting, held Sept. 21-24 in Atlanta. The initial offering focuses on store managers, combining short online courses with a downloadable resource guide designed to help translate training into daily practice.
paras.zh: NAPA 正在为独立商店所有者提供新的资源，以通过 NAPA 学院发展这些能力，并将为其公司拥有的商店开发的培训扩展到独立企业。该计划是在 9 月 21 日至 24 日在亚特兰大举行的 2026 年 NAPA 商店业主和现场销售会议期间推出的。最初的产品主要针对商店经理，将简短的在线课程与可下载的资源指南相结合，旨在帮助将培训转化为日常实践。

paras.en: Introducing the program, Cassie Bell, NAPA’s senior vice president of HR, said the expansion supports the company’s Drive 2030 strategy and its investment in people. Although owners have requested training for several positions, she said store managers were a logical starting point.
paras.zh: NAPA 人力资源高级副总裁 Cassie Bell 在介绍该计划时表示，此次扩张支持公司的 Drive 2030 战略及其对人才的投资。尽管店主要求对多个职位进行培训，但她表示，商店经理是一个合乎逻辑的起点。

paras.en: “We believe fundamentally that the store manager is critical to obtaining consistent customer service, to building the teams and driving those operational performances inside of our stores,” Bell said.
paras.zh: 贝尔说：“我们从根本上认为，商店经理对于获得一致的客户服务、建设团队和推动商店内部的运营绩效至关重要。”

paras.en: The program’s development began with a practical question: What do successful employees and stores do differently?
paras.zh: 该计划的开发始于一个实际问题：成功的员工和商店的做法有何不同？

paras.en: Jesse Parrish, NAPA’s director of learning and development, said the Academy worked with teams across the organization to identify the knowledge, skills and behaviors that define excellence in specific roles. NAPA partnered with industry professionals to turn those findings into training, reference materials and learning pathways.
paras.zh: NAPA 学习和发展总监 Jesse Parrish 表示，学院与整个组织的团队合作，确定定义特定角色卓越表现的知识、技能和行为。 NAPA 与行业专业人士合作，将这些发现转化为培训、参考材料和学习途径。

paras.en: By observing high-performing managers and market directors in top-performing stores, the team identified the practices and strategies driving their success. Those real-world insights became the foundation for new training programs designed to help others apply proven strategies throughout the organization.
paras.zh: 通过观察表现最好的商店中的表现出色的经理和市场总监，团队确定了推动他们成功的实践和策略。这些现实世界的见解成为新培训计划的基础，旨在帮助其他人在整个组织中应用经过验证的策略。

paras.en: For store operations, the resulting framework has four areas of emphasis: driving financial results, leading and developing teams, enabling operational excellence and delivering exceptional customer service.
paras.zh: 对于商店运营，最终框架有四个重点领域：推动财务业绩、领导和发展团队、实现卓越运营以及提供卓越的客户服务。

paras.en: Those areas address responsibilities ranging from understanding store performance and building improvement plans to coaching employees, managing inventory, optimizing delivery service and building customer loyalty.
paras.zh: 这些领域涉及的职责包括了解商店绩效和制定改进计划、指导员工、管理库存、优化送货服务和建立客户忠诚度。

paras.en: The team documented those practices in how-to guides, training courses and tools intended to help other stores apply them.
paras.zh: 该团队将这些做法记录在操作指南、培训课程和工具中，旨在帮助其他商店应用它们。
