articles.title: EU must curb energy prices to prevent people turning to populists, commissioner warns – as it happened
articles.author: Jakub Krupa (now and earlier) and Martin Belam (earlier)

paras.en: EU has to act on energy prices to prevent people from turning to populists and extremists, EU commissioner warns
Europe hasto take action to curb soaring oil and gas prices to prevent people from turning to populists and extremists, a senior EU official has said.

Dan Jørgensen, the European commissioner for energy and housing policy,said EU governments could choose actions to make fossil fuels cheaper as long as they were “targeted” and “temporary” so as not to derail the continent from its goal to tackle the climate crisis by drastically cutting carbon emissions.

Earlier this week European gas prices hit their highest level since the winter of 2022, when consumers faced rising prices in the wake of supply disruption following Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

Meanwhile global oil prices have surged to $92 a barrel, an increase of $20 a barrel since March with even bigger price increases in some product markets, the International Energy Agency reported this week

Speaking to the Guardian and other European newspapers, Jørgensen said the EU was approaching a “tough” winter for citizens and business with “no signs that the situation in the Middle East is improving”.

Since the US and Israel launched the war on Iran that unleashed spiralling oil and gas prices, the EU had spent an extra €110bn (£93bn) paying for energy it would not have spent if supplies had remained stable, according to EU estimates.

Faced with that situation governments and the EU had to take action to help people heat their homes and put petrol in their cars, the commissioner said, even if that meant favouring fossil fuels in the short-term.
Jørgensen, a former Danish climate and energy minister, pointed out that even in an average year nearly 50m people in Europe struggle to heat their homes.

“If we do not tackle what people see as their most fundamental problems every day… if they do not have the ability to pay their bills at the end of the month, there’s a risk that they will listen to populists and extremists.”
He said governments could subsidise fossil fuels if necessary, “but it needs to be targeted and it needs to be temporary.”

He was speaking on Wednesday when the European Commission proposed a one-year delay to the EU’s methane emissions rules for oil and gas imports under pressure from the US, but also France. The rules, due to take effect on January 1, 2027, would have required foreign oil and gas suppliers to the EU to monitor and report methane, a super-polluting greenhouse gas.

Earlier this year the European Commission proposed a major overhaul of the EU’s emissions trading system, the EU’s flagship policy to cut polluting emissions. Green groups fear the plans will weaken what they see as the EU’s most effective tool in fighting planet-heating gases.
But many member states are looking for more, including scrapping an extension of the ETS to housing and transport.

EU leaders, who discussed fuel prices on Thursday, are expected to call for the EU executive “to examine and put forward as needed further measures to address soaring energy prices in the short term” according to a draft of their summit conclusions.
And, on that note, we will be closing the blog for today.
Europe hasto take action to curb soaring oil and gas prices to prevent people from turning to populists and extremists, a senior EU official has said (16:03).
If EU citizens don’t see their “fundamental problems” addressed, they may turn “to populists and extremists,” Dan Jørgensen said.
EU leaders are meeting in Brussels to discuss energy prices, EU budget, Middle East, and Ukraine during a two-day summit attended by Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy (11:16, 11:57, 13:25, 15:08).
The meeting comes amid heightened tensions between Ukraine and the US, with EU leaders joining Kyiv in criticising the US-Russia diesel deal (10:36) and reported Starlink disruptions (9:45, 9:49).
We will pick up on tonight’s developments in tomorrow morning’s blog.

Separately, the leaders of Romania and Bulgaria held urgent talks with Nato’s secretary general Mark Rutte over repeated drone attacks on ships off Black Sea coast (14:31, 15:26), with seven people missing after latest incidents last night (12:03, 13:01).
If you have any tips, comments or suggestions, email me at jakub.krupa@theguardian.com.
I am also on Bluesky at @jakubkrupa.bsky.social and on X at @jakubkrupa.
Nato's Rutte says he discussed 'importance of implementing energy ceasefire' with Zelenskyy

After meeting with Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Nato’s Mark Rutte has said the pair discussed “the importance of implementing an energy ceasefire,” as well as “continuous support for Ukraine” from Nato allies.
Serbian ruler’s secret role in ‘illegal’ effort to help Trump business
Meanwhile, Serbia’s authoritarian ruler personally intervened to advance an allegedly illegal scheme to hand over a protected site in Belgrade for a Trump tower, the Guardian can reveal.

Aleksandar Vučić summoned officials to a meeting at his presidential offices about the project, which has culminated in a landmark indictment of senior figures from his regime on charges of abuse of public office.

The criminal case is believed to be the first resulting from the Trumps’ global moneymaking campaign, described by critics as a “pay to play” arrangement where everything from sanctions relief to cutting-edge chips is available to those who enrich the first family and their associates.

The alleged scheme to override the protected status of a historic building in the Serbian capital looms over an election scheduled for 25 October, when Vučić will seek to extend his 12 years in power in the face of a mass protest movement spurred by government corruption.

A nationalist former propaganda chief under Slobodan Milošević, Vučić hosted the US president’s son Donald Trump Jr and son-in-law Jared Kushner in Belgrade as they developed plans for a $500m hotel and residential tower to add to their global property portfolios.

After the abuse of power charges were brought last December, Kushner’s company announced the project would not proceed “at this time”. Vučić threatened reprisals, calling the prosecutors “corrupt gangs” who “fabricated cases”.
“We have lost an exceptional investment,” the Serbian president said. “I will personally ensure that everyone who participated in causing this damage is held accountable.”

Vučić’s culture minister is among those charged with abuse of power. But a Guardian investigation, drawing on interviews and leaked documents, reveals that the Serbian president himself led the initial meeting where the alleged scheme was discussed. This crucial meeting is not mentioned in the indictment, raising questions about what information the prosecutors are holding back and why.

Representatives of the Trumps and Kushner said they had no part in the removal of the building’s protected status and that it would be “false” to say the Belgrade project was part of a “pay to play” scheme.

Vučić did not respond to requests for comment. His decision to call a snap election means that a hearing at which witnesses might reveal details of his involvement will not take place until after the vote.

Russia attempting to destabilise societies across Nato, Romania's Dan says after drone incidents

Meanwhile, Romania’s Nicușor Dan has warned that Russia seeks to “destabilise societies – not just in Romania and Bulgaria, but across European nations, particularly those on the Eastern Flank,” as he responded to overnight drone attacks on ships in Romanian territorial waters of the Black Sea (12:03).

Briefing the media in Brussels after his meeting with Nato’s Mark Rutte and Bulgaria’s Rumen Radev (13:01, 14:31), Dan said they discussed the recent incidents in Romania and Bulgaria, and that he believed there was “a need for equipment suited to this new type of challenge.”

He said that’s what happened when Romania was affected by stray drones coming into its territory. “You will recall that … we turned to the allies, some military equipment arrived and the situation stabilised.”
“Clearly, Russia is attempting to destabilise societies – not just in Romania and Bulgaria, but across European nations, particularly those on the Eastern Flank – and to erode support for Ukraine.
Our response is to continue supporting Ukraine, as this is a matter of international law and a matter concerning Romania’s own security.”
However, he did not offer more details about the incidents, saying the investigation was ongoing.
Zelenskyy to meet with Nato's Rutte, several national leaders as he lands in Brussels for EU summit
The Ukrainian president also confirmed he’s now in Brussels, where he is expected to meet with Nato’s Mark Rutte later today, and join the European Council tomorrow.
He will also hold bilateral talks with Belgium’s de Wever (no doubt on frozen assets), Denmark’s Frederiksen, France’s Macron and Poland’s Tusk.
“Tomorrow, meetings are planned with the presidents of the European Council and the European Commission, as well as the prime ministers of Hungary, Finland, and Sweden.

All of us in Europe want this war to end. And for that to happen, strong signals are needed – more real pressure on Russia and more defence support for Ukraine. It is especially important now to act together to protect lives.”
Zelenskyy claims Ukraine destroyed four Russian planes by striking airfield
A Ukrainian missile strike destroyed four fighter jets at an airfield in western Russia overnight, Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said in a social media post.

Last night, Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck an airfield in the Voronezh region. Four Su-34 aircraft were destroyed and two more Su-34s were hit. Our Long Neptune missile was used to strike the target.
The claim has not been independently verified, and there has been no immediate comment from Russia’s defence ministry. The Voronezh region borders Ukraine.

Posting to social media, Nato’s secretary general Mark Rutte confirmed he met earlier with Bulgarian prime minister Rumen Radev and Romanian president Nicușor Dan to discuss security in the Black Sea and the latest attacks on commercial shipping (13:01).
Nato will continue to work closely with our allies in the Black Sea, adjusting our deterrence and defence posture as needed.
Violent clashes have been taking place in Albania, where prime minister Edi Rama has today rejected calls to resign.

Protesters have voiced anger about perceived corruption, the cost and quality of education and a deal to sell off parts of its southern coastline to a luxury resort development backed by US President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner.
In a written statement to Reuters, Rama rejected calls to quit, saying:

My responsibility is to listen, address legitimate concerns and keep Albania moving forward. The alternative would be a betrayal of the Albanians who gave me a strong mandate to complete negotiations on EU membership.
EU leaders heading for mighty clash over EU's next long-term budget - snap analysis
One other thing that is clear from this morning’s doorstep statements: leaders are heading for a mighty clash over the EU’s next long-term budget.

Agreeing the EU seven-year budget is always a fraught negotiating exercise, which pits a group of “frugals”, such as Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, who oppose a bigger budget, against a larger group in southern and eastern Europe, who want to maintain the EU’s traditional spending on agriculture and regional funding.

European Council president António Costa wanted a deal by the end of the year to ensure that the next long-term budget (2028-35) would be ready on time – and avoid getting caught in the crossfire of major elections next year in France, Poland and Italy.
That timing is in doubt, as the EU’s frugals (who prefer to be called “modernisers”) reiterated this morning they are in no hurry.
Sweden’s prime minister Ulf Kristersson said he expected tense talks today.

“We are not reaching agreement this month, not next month. I don’t know even if it’s possible to reach an agreement before the end of the year. I think we are not in a hurry, honestly. We need to have a budget that could combine the modernisation, the resources for Ukraine and of course the traditional things as well. But all the titles [areas of spending] need to be decreased to be able to reach an agreement.”

Friedrich Merz said he expected the “very, very difficult” talks to run into December (11:05) but privately Germany has made it clear it is ready to see the talks go into next year unless there are massive cuts to the current proposal.

In the other camp is Spain’s Pedro Sánchez, who described the current proposal as “insufficient” to face the bloc’s challenges, adding that his government would fight to expand it. But with Spain due to hold elections in November, the Socialist leader may not be around to make that argument.
The latest draft summit conclusions call for only a “timely agreement” rather than setting a deadline “by the end of the year”, as in an earlier version.

The European Commission’s €2tn (£1.7tn) budget proposal, which aims to increase spending on defence, border security and research, has already been trimmed by €140bn by Ireland, who as holders of the rotating presidency were tasked with finding a common ground by October.

The frugal camp thinks the cuts, which target defence and research, are in the wrong places, while the self-styled “friends of cohesion” think there is too much scrimping on the EU’s traditional priorities, such as regional development funds.

France, which does not belong in either camp, but faces acute budget pressures, wants to see the EU agree to new common taxes in order to fund a budget that allows increased spending on new priorities such as defence and maintain the traditional ones, such as farm subsidies.
While the Commission has floated EU taxes on big companies, tobacco and e-waste, member states cannot agree on any of the options.
And the whole budget has to be agreed … by unanimity.
Two drones hit ships in Romanian territorial waters, president Dan says ahead of urgent talks with Nato
Back to Romania, the country’s president Nicușor Dan confirmed that two aerial drone hit ships which caught fire in Romanian territorial waters overnight (12:03).

Dan also said the Romanian state will offer “a reaction” to the incident, without speculating on what it could be. He also suggested that the issue should be added to tomorrow’s agenda on Ukraine-related issues.
Later today, Dan and Bulgaria’s PM Rumen Radev will meet with Nato’s secretary general Mark Rutte to discuss the recent incidents in their respective territorial waters.
Swedish parliament rejects Andersson's PM candidacy
A quick update from Sweden, wherethe country’s parliament rejected Social Democrats leader Magdalena Andersson’s candidacy to form a single-party minority government.
Only 99 lawmakers voted in favour, with 248 against. Two people were absent.

The vote, forced by the parliament’s speaker Andreas Norlén, was widely expected to fail, but is intended to put more pressure on parties as they continue discussions on who could form the next government.

Four centre-left opposition parties, which have all said they favour Andersson as prime minister, won last month a majority of seats in Sweden’s parliament, the Riksdag, but do not agree on who should be part of a new government.
Norlén will now have to appoint a new candidate to hold further exploratory talks on the new government.
'Sanctions must not be lifted,' Zelenskyy says, as he says Russia's attacks come 'in response to signals from US'
Oh, and we have just heard from Zelenskyy again, doubling down on his criticism of Russia and attributing its latest attacks to “signals from the US.”
Responding to a “horrific” drone attack on a supermarket in Odesa, he said:

“Russia continues its bloody terror. The store was partially destroyed, and cars were damaged. Three people were injured. All necessary emergency services are working at the scene and providing assistance to those affected. It is important that our partners help us defend against this. Residential buildings, stores, energy and other critical infrastructure are under attack virtually nonstop. Not a single hour of peace.”

“What is happening is Russia’s pointed response to the signals it is receiving from America. Unfortunately, there are dangerous signals about the possibility of further sanctions relief. These sanctions were imposed by the world, by America, Europe, and our partners in response to Russia’s aggression against Ukraine and its war against us. Nothing has changed. The war has not stopped. The sanctions must not be lifted. Russia must end the slaughter it itself started and has continued for 1,695 days now. More money to fund the killing will not help bring this about. Strength is what is needed, and America is stronger than Russian terror.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: US effort to get Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire collapses

The White House’s unilateral effort to negotiate an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine has collapsed as Moscow sent a record swarm of drones overnight to attack infrastructure in central Ukraine and Kyiv appeared to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries – despite warnings from Donald Trump.

Zelenskyy said on Wednesday that he would resume strikes on Russian oil refineries after halting those attacks to show that Ukraine was ready for peace talks. “The block [on attacking refineries] is out. We’re done,” he told the Financial Times. He also attacked the gap in US intelligence sharing as “dangerous”.

Images from Ryazan showed flames at the refinery, which regional officials said had been targeted by 69 drones and four Flamingo cruise missiles. Debris from a drone struck by anti-aircraft fire had hit the refinery and sparked the fire, the ministry claimed.
In Ukraine, more than 360 Russian drones targeted Kirovohrad, a central region that has been hit less hard than others closer to Russia, in attacks that killed three and injured six.
“The enemy deliberately hit critical infrastructure, transport enterprises, logistics facilities and residential homes,” the regional governor, Andriy Raikovych, said in a statement.
'We need honesty from our partners about this war,' Zelenskyy says
Meanwhile, Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy offered an update on last night’s Russian attacks on Ukraine.

“Emergency services are still providing assistance in dozens of our cities and communities. Repair crews and rescuers are working to deal with the aftermath of Russian attacks. For practically all of yesterday and throughout last night, a massive shahed attack was under way. The drones kept coming in waves, and there was not a single hour when our skies were clear of them.”
He said “more than 850” drones were sent against Ukraine, “at a time when the speed of our defence capabilities is being artificially restricted.”

“It is obvious that Russia deliberately chose to escalate its attacks after receiving sanctions relief and seeing attempts to pressure Ukraine. Russia exploits every such opportunity and must be held accountable for what it does. Strong decisions are needed to end this war. Ukraine needs steady support, above all in defending our skies.
We need HONESTY from our partners about this war: It is important that everyone in America stand not with the aggressor, but with our efforts to protect lives, end this war, and guarantee security.”

articles.title: Nicolás Maduro tells New York court new torture allegations are ‘false’
articles.author: Associated Press

paras.en: Nicolás Maduro insisted on Thursday during an appearance in a New York court that torture allegations in a rewritten drug trafficking indictment against the deposed Venezuelan president and his wife were “false accusations”.

Maduro, shackled at the ankles, was brought to court to face the new charges accusing the couple of leading a state-sponsored campaign of repression that tortured scores of victims, including three Americans.
Judge Alvin K Hellerstein entered a not-guilty plea on behalf of Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores. They were seized from their Caracas home by the US military in a night-time raid in January.

Hellerstein announced that he was entering the plea on behalf of Maduro after Maduro twice responded to the judge’s request to enter a plea by criticizing the indictment, saying it contained “false accusations and false testimony”. Maduro spoke through an interpreter.
Attorney Barry Pollack said when the charges were announced last week that Maduro, 63, denied them and “looks forward to his day in court”.

According to the rewritten indictment, Maduro oversaw a violent torture system that beat, asphyxiated and delivered electric shocks to its victims. He is accused of personally recommending torture methods, receiving updates on specific victims’ treatment and threatening to kill one prisoner’s child as a form of psychological torture.
Flores, 70, a former attorney general, helped develop the repressive system and ordered the torture of some specific people, the indictment alleges.
When she was asked to enter a plea, she said through an interpreter: “I am completely innocent. I am not guilty.”

Maduro, who served as Venezuela’s president from 2013 until his capture in January, has been under investigation for years by the international criminal court over allegations of crimes against humanity, tied to his crackdown on opponents. He has always denied wrongdoing.
Prosecutors told the judge during the hearing that lawyers on both sides want the trial date moved from 1 June to 14 June.

Torture is a crime under international law and can be prosecuted outside the country where the abuse occurred and regardless of the victims’ nationality. But the prosecution of foreign officials in the US is exceedingly rare, having been tried only a few times, including against the son of the former Liberian president Charles Taylor, Russians responsible for war crimes in Ukraine and a former prison warden in Bashar Assad’s Syria.

Earlier this year, Maduro and his wife pleaded not guilty in the US drug case, which said they conspired to flood the US with cocaine. Their attorneys say the case should be dismissed on immunity grounds because they were the leader and first lady of a foreign country.
The revised indictment covers allegations of torture stretching back to Maduro’s ascent to power in 2013, when he took over as president from his mentor Hugo Chávez, who died of cancer that year.

articles.title: Seven sailors missing after drones strike tankers near Romania’s Black Sea coast
articles.author: Jennifer Rankin in Brussels

paras.en: Seven sailors are missing after drones struck two tankers near Romania’s Black Sea coast, setting them ablaze and raising fresh security concerns on a vital shipping route used by Ukraine.

A Nato military source told Reuters the drones that hit the Wine Trader and the Yara J came from Russia. “The drones that caused the fires on board two tankers inside Romanian territorial waters were of Russian origin,” the source said.

Romania’s president, Nicușor Dan, described the situation in the Black Sea as serious. “Commercial ships are being attacked and sunk,” he wrote on X. “Seafarers killed, injured and missing very close to the shores of Romania and Bulgaria. This is unacceptable and it has to stop.”

His statement followed a meeting with Bulgaria’s prime minister, Rumen Radev, and Nato’s secretary-general, Mark Rutte, on Thursday, where they agreed “to strengthen our defences in the Black Sea”, Dan said.
Rutte said: “Nato will continue to work closely with our allies in the Black Sea, adjusting our deterrence and defence posture as needed.”
A Nato official said the issue would be discussed at a meeting of the North Atlantic Council next week.

The missing crew were from the Wine Trader, a San-Marino flagged tanker travelling from Tunisia to Romania. All crew on the Yara J, which was struck just inside Romanian waters late on Wednesday, were safe.
Similar incidents in recent weeks have raised fears that the zone is becoming another front in Russia’s war on Ukraine.
Dan said the two ships had been struck by drones, but declined to say whether Russia was responsible.

Romania shares a 614km (381-mile) border with Ukraine, much of it along the Danube. The country has experienced frequent drone incursions since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, including a daytime encroachment last November that led Nato to scramble fighter jets.
Before the latest incidents, EU leaders were already concerned about drone strikes on merchant ships off the coast of Bulgaria.

On Tuesday, drone strikes on two ships off the coast of Bulgaria prompted emergency rescue operations, with 11 crew member from the HS Dignity, a cargo ship sailing under a Guinea-Bissau flag, still missing.

On another ship, the Ukrainian-operated Chelsea 3, sailing under a Maltese flag, rescuers evacuated all 15 crew members, with five receiving treatment for minor injuries. The crew reported that the ship’s deck and hull were hit by three aerial drones.
“The results of this attack favour Russia. However, we don’t have any solid evidence that the drones are Russians,” Radev said after arriving in Brussels for an EU summit on Thursday.
At least 23 sailors have been reported missing or killed after attacks on commercial shipping near the coasts of Bulgaria and Romania in the past 10 days, according to Reuters.

Russia has stepped up its bombing campaign on Ukraine’s Black Sea infrastructure, forcing Kyiv to turn to Danube river ports and Black Sea routes off the coasts of Romania and Bulgaria to export its grain, sunflower oil and other products.

According to a draft summit declaration, EU leaders will say that attacks against civilian shipping, including “member state-flagged vessels, such as the recent attacks in Bulgaria’s and Romania’s exclusive economic zones in the Black Sea, are unacceptable and constitute a serious violation of international and maritime law”.

articles.title: School headscarf ban sparks rare protests in Azerbaijan and row with Turkey

paras.en: "You are telling me, I can't come to school?" says a teenage girl in a navy blue Islamic headscarf, captured on video challenging a staff member at the entrance to her school.
paras.zh: “你是在告诉我，我不能来上学吗？”一位戴着海军蓝伊斯兰头巾的十几岁女孩说道，她在视频中向学校入口处的一名工作人员发起挑战。

paras.en: The footage has been shared widely on social media, and shows a group of girls in hijabs standing behind her applauding as she continues: "Why should I have to give up my religion?"
paras.zh: 这段视频已在社交媒体上广泛分享，并显示一群戴头巾的女孩站在她身后鼓掌： “我为什么要放弃我的宗教信仰？”

paras.en: Last Monday the education ministry in Azerbaijan began enforcing new uniform rules, turning away female pupils wearing hijabs. Protests began outside state schools in the capital, Baku, and in several southern districts including Masally and Jalilabad.
paras.zh: 上周一，阿塞拜疆教育部开始执行新的统一规定，拒绝女学生戴头巾。抗议活动开始于首都巴库的公立学校外，以及包括马萨利和贾利拉巴德在内的几个南部地区。

paras.en: Protests are rare in this oil- and gas-producing country of 10.5 million people.
paras.zh: 在这个拥有1050万人口的石油和天然气生产国，抗议活动很少见。

paras.en: Azerbaijan is constitutionally secular and the government strongly enforces that.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆在宪法上是世俗的，政府强力执行。

paras.en: President Ilham Aliyev has been in power since 2003 and has little tolerance for dissent. Opposition politicians and many independent journalists are in jail.
paras.zh: 伊利哈姆·阿利耶夫总统自2003年以来一直掌权，对异议几乎没有容忍度。反对派政客和许多独立记者被判入狱。

paras.en: Azerbaijan is pulled between two neighbours, Turkey and Iran. Azerbaijanis belong to a Turkic group of nations, speaking a language close to Turkish, and Turkey is its closest ally.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆位于两个邻国土耳其和伊朗之间。阿塞拜疆人属于一个突厥国家集团，讲一种接近土耳其的语言，土耳其是其最亲密的盟友。

paras.en: But like Iran to the south, Azerbaijan is mainly Shia - over 60% of its people identify as Shia Muslims, while most Turks are Sunni.
paras.zh: 但与南部的伊朗一样，阿塞拜疆主要是什叶派-超过60 ％的人口认定为什叶派穆斯林，而大多数土耳其人是逊尼派。

paras.en: The interior ministry said it had detained 37 people on Monday who tried to obstruct the rules and "grossly violate public order".
paras.zh: 内政部表示，周一已拘留了37人，他们试图阻挠规则并“严重违反公共秩序”。

paras.en: The rules, approved on 21 September, ban clothing which contradict "the principle of secularism in education" in state schools. They do not mention the hijab. Similar guidelines were extended to teachers on 6 October.
paras.zh: 9月21日批准的规则禁止在公立学校穿着与“教育世俗主义原则”相矛盾的服装。他们没有提到头巾。10月6日，向教师推广了类似的指导方针。

paras.en: In one video, pupils outside School No. 69 in Balakhany, outside Baku, hold a banner reading: "The hijab does not prevent anyone from getting an education."
paras.zh: 在一段视频中，巴库郊外Balakhany第69学校外的学生举着横幅，上面写着： “头巾不会阻止任何人接受教育。”

paras.en: Shahiza Huseynova, a mother who was protesting outside a school in the Mashtaga district of the capital, was detained on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 周二，在首都马什塔加区一所学校外抗议的母亲Shahiza Huseynova被拘留。

paras.en: In an interview with Meydan TV, an independent Azerbaijani-language channel based in Germany, Huseynova's husband Agha said she had been given a warning: "Either you take off your child's hijab and send them to school, or you go to prison."
paras.zh: Huseynova的丈夫Agha在接受总部位于德国的独立阿塞拜疆语频道Meydan TV的采访时说，她收到了警告： “要么你脱下孩子的头巾送他们上学，要么你去监狱。”

paras.en: Friends have also lost contact with Ilkin Huseynov, an activist who on Tuesday launched an online platform called "Let Leyli Go to School". It offers free lessons from volunteer teachers to pupils barred from class.
paras.zh: 朋友们也失去了与活动家Ilkin Huseynov的联系，后者周二推出了一个名为“让Leyli上学”的在线平台。它为志愿教师和被禁止上课的学生提供免费课程。

paras.en: According to a friend, Huseynov left his home in Baku with unidentified men at about 16:00 on Wednesday, and his phone has been switched off ever since.
paras.zh: 据一位朋友透露， Huseynov于周三16:00左右与身份不明的男子一起离开了他在巴库的家，此后他的手机一直处于关机状态。

paras.en: The authorities have not commented, but friends believe he has been detained. On Thursday, the platform's Instagram page could not be accessed.
paras.zh: 当局没有发表评论，但朋友们认为他已被拘留。周四，无法访问该平台的Instagram页面。

paras.en: Since the protests began, users have reported problems accessing Instagram and TikTok without a virtual private network (VPN).
paras.zh: 自抗议活动开始以来，用户报告在没有虚拟专用网络（ VPN ）的情况下访问Instagram和TikTok时出现问题。

paras.en: Most of the protests have been in religiously conservative neighbourhoods in Baku's outlying settlements and in southern districts near the 765km (475-mile) border with Iran.
paras.zh: 大多数抗议活动发生在巴库边远定居点的宗教保守社区以及与伊朗接壤的765公里（ 475英里）边界附近的南部地区。

paras.en: The authorities have long been wary of religious influence from Iran, where more ethnic Azerbaijanis live than in Azerbaijan itself.
paras.zh: 当局长期以来一直对来自伊朗的宗教影响持谨慎态度，伊朗的阿塞拜疆族人比阿塞拜疆本身还多。

paras.en: On the night of 13 October, Azerbaijan's State Service for Special Communications and Information Security said a "foreign hacker group" had attacked more than 100 state websites.
paras.zh: 10月13日晚，阿塞拜疆国家特殊通信和信息安全局表示，一个“外国黑客组织”袭击了100多个国家网站。

paras.en: A pro-Iranian group calling itself the 313 Team (Cyber Islamic Resistance) claimed responsibility.
paras.zh: 一个自称为313小组（网络伊斯兰抵抗组织）的亲伊朗团体声称对此负责。

paras.en: Azerbaijani officials have defended the rules. One MP, Nigar Arpadarai, told the 1news.az website that children did not choose to wear the hijab themselves but were influenced by their families.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆官员为规则辩护。国会议员Nigar Arpadarai告诉1news.az网站，孩子们自己没有选择戴头巾，而是受到家人的影响。

paras.en: "A child has no freedom to choose a religion. This is a conscious prerogative of adults," she said.
paras.zh: “儿童没有选择宗教的自由。这是成年人的自觉特权，”她说。

paras.en: The row has now spilled over into Turkey, Baku's closest ally, which provided vital support during Azerbaijan's 2020 war with Armenia over Nagorno-Karabakh.
paras.zh: 这场争吵现在已经蔓延到巴库最亲密的盟友土耳其，土耳其在阿塞拜疆与亚美尼亚在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫的2020年战争期间提供了重要支持。

paras.en: The two countries call themselves "one nation, two states".
paras.zh: 两国自称“一国两国”。

paras.en: President Recep Tayyip ErdoÄan, a devout Muslim, has spoken of creating a "pious generation".
paras.zh: 虔诚的穆斯林总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（ Recep Tayyip ErdoÄan ）谈到了创造“虔诚的一代”。

paras.en: His chief adviser, Oktay Saral, has called the Azerbaijani restrictions "unacceptable" and urged Baku to "reverse this mistake".
paras.zh: 他的首席顾问奥克泰·萨拉尔（ Oktay Saral ）称阿塞拜疆的限制“不可接受” ，并敦促巴库“扭转这一错误”。

paras.en: "A headscarf is not an obstacle; it is a requirement of one's faith!" Saral wrote on X.
paras.zh: “头巾不是障碍，是信仰的要求！“ Saral在X上写道。

paras.en: Several MPs from Turkey's governing AK Party joined in.
paras.zh: 来自土耳其执政党正义与发展党的几名议员也加入进来。

paras.en: Small demonstrations were held outside Azerbaijan's embassy in Ankara, organised by KÃ¶klÃ¼ DeÄiÅim, an Islamist movement linked to Hizb ut-Tahrir, and outside its consulate in Istanbul, organised by conservative Islamist group ÃzgÃ¼r-Der.
paras.zh: 小型示威活动在阿塞拜疆驻安卡拉大使馆外举行，由与Hizb ut-Tahrir有联系的伊斯兰运动组织KöklÃ ¼ DeÄiÅim组织，并在其驻伊斯坦布尔领事馆外举行，由保守的伊斯兰组织ÃzgÃ ¼ r-Der组织。

paras.en: President Aliyev's New Azerbaijan Party accused Turkish officials of an "openly defamatory" information campaign and of "baseless accusations", warning that Oktay Saral's comments risked harming ties, and cautioned against interference in Azerbaijan's internal affairs.
paras.zh: 阿利耶夫总统的新阿塞拜疆党指责土耳其官员进行“公开诽谤”的宣传活动和“毫无根据的指控” ，警告奥克泰·萨拉尔的言论有可能损害两国关系，并警告不要干涉阿塞拜疆的内政。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Ilham Aliyev himself said no one should "stick their noses into our way of life".

Behind the dispute there may lie another source of friction. Turkish protesters have linked the headscarf rules to Azerbaijan's close ties with Israel, which sells weapons to Baku and buys Azerbaijani oil.
Turkey's relations with Israel have collapsed over Gaza, but Azerbaijan has tried to maintain relationships with both countries.

That is a difficult balancing act. On Thursday, when Israel's President Isaac Herzog addressed a regional security summit hosted by Azerbaijan in Baku, delegations from Turkey, Iran and other countries walked out of the hall.

articles.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has called off plans to livestream the execution of former US army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan by firing squad.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）取消了直播前美国陆军精神病学家尼达尔·哈桑（ Nidal Hasan ）被行刑队处决的计划。

paras.en: Trump had previously said he approved of showing the death of the Fort Hood attacker, while Vice-President JD Vance cast doubt on whether it would happen and said he would not watch it.
paras.zh: 特朗普此前曾表示，他同意显示胡德堡袭击者的死亡，而副总统JD万斯对此是否会发生表示怀疑，并表示他不会观看。

paras.en: Trump's decision to cancel the livestream came after widespread criticism in the US and globally. On Thursday, he said that "many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die".
paras.zh: 特朗普取消直播的决定是在美国和全球广泛批评之后做出的。周四，他说， “许多人非常善良，善意，人们宁愿不看着他死去”。

paras.en: "I think streaming the execution for all to see might have been a strong deterrent for the World to witness how America deals with Terrorists and SCUM like Hasan," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说： “我认为，让所有人都看到死刑可能是一种强大的威慑，让世界目睹美国如何对付恐怖分子和像哈桑这样的人渣。”

paras.en: "He will die, as scheduled, by firing squad, but this event will not be streamed," the president added.
paras.zh: 总统补充说： “他将按计划被行刑队击毙，但这一事件不会被串流播出。”

paras.en: Hasan fatally shot 13 unarmed US soldiers at a military base in Texas in 2009, injuring another 32. His execution by firing squad will be the first military execution in more than 60 years.
paras.zh: 2009年，哈桑在德克萨斯州的一个军事基地开枪打死13名手无寸铁的美国士兵，另有32人受伤。他被行刑队处决将是60多年来的第一次军事处决。

paras.en: Trump said the families of the victims can still view the execution in person if they wish.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，如果受害者家属愿意，他们仍然可以亲自观看处决。

paras.en: "They deserve to witness JUSTICE!" he said.
paras.zh: “他们应该见证正义！”他说。

paras.en: After the Pentagon announced last week that it would execute Hasan on 3 December 2026 by firing squad and livestream the event, a cascade of criticism quickly followed from human rights groups and many others. The United Nations called the plans "abhorrent".
paras.zh: 五角大楼上周宣布将于2026年12月3日通过行刑队处决哈桑并直播这一事件后，人权组织和其他许多人迅速提出了一连串批评。联合国称这些计划“令人憎恶”。

paras.en: While there were more than 2,700 executions across 17 countries last year, only two nations carried them out publicly. According to Amnesty International, 11 public executions were known to have been carried out in Iran in 2025 and another six in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 虽然去年在17个国家有2700多人被处决，但只有两个国家公开执行。据大赦国际称，已知2025年在伊朗执行了11次公开处决，在阿富汗又执行了6次处决。

paras.en: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth defended his decision to air Hasan's execution online, saying that "people need to understand that there's serious consequences for these types of things".
paras.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·黑格塞斯（ Pete Hegseth ）为他在网上公开处决哈桑的决定进行了辩护，称“人们需要明白，这类事情会产生严重后果”。

paras.en: But as criticism mounted, Trump appeared to hedge his support, saying on Friday that he "absolutely" approved of the livestream plan, but adding that the Pentagon was still "making a determination" on it.
paras.zh: 但随着批评的加剧，特朗普似乎对冲了他的支持，周五表示他“绝对”批准了直播计划，但补充说五角大楼仍在对此“做出决定”。

paras.en: The president also called Hasan "totally nuts".
paras.zh: 总统还称哈桑“完全疯了”。

paras.en: "I really don't care how he goes, as long as he goes, and I think that the death penalty is a very worthy way of going for him," he said.
paras.zh: “我真的不在乎他怎么样，只要他去，我认为死刑对他来说是一种非常值得的方式，”他说。

paras.en: John Galligan, a lawyer for Hasan working primarily on civil issues, told the BBC that Trump's decision to cancel the livestream of his execution "comes as no surprise".
paras.zh: 哈桑的律师约翰·加利根（ John Galligan ）主要负责民事问题，他告诉英国广播公司（ BBC ） ，特朗普决定取消他的处决直播“并不奇怪”。

paras.en: "It was initially a dumb decision and statement by Hegseth to livestream any execution - and it violated the Army's own regulation," Galligan said.
paras.zh: Galligan说： “最初，直播任何处决都是Hegseth的愚蠢决定和声明-这违反了陆军自己的规定。”

paras.en: He said Hasan is paralysed from the chest down, something that Trump "allegedly didn't even know" when he approved the livestream plan.
paras.zh: 他说，哈桑从胸部以下瘫痪，特朗普在批准直播计划时“据称甚至不知道”这一点。

paras.en: "The damage has already been done - the Army is now just trying to clean up the mess," Galligan said. "It will permanently remain a stain on our military justice system."
paras.zh: “损害已经造成-陆军现在只是试图清理混乱，”加利根说。“这将永远是我们军事司法系统的一个污点。”

paras.en: He added that it was not clear if Hasan was aware yet of Trump's "reversal" of the livestream decision.
paras.zh: 他补充说，目前尚不清楚哈桑是否知道特朗普“推翻”了直播决定。

paras.en: Hasan opened fire in a crowded medical building where deploying soldiers were awaiting check-ups and vaccines.
paras.zh: 哈桑向一座拥挤的医疗大楼开火，那里的部署士兵正在等待检查和疫苗接种。

paras.en: He later admitted in court that he was the gunman and apologised for "any mistakes". He said during his court-martial in 2013 that he believed he was protecting Muslims and the Taliban in Afghanistan from the US military.
paras.zh: 他后来在法庭上承认自己是枪手，并为“任何错误”道歉。他在2013年的军事法庭上说，他相信自己正在保护阿富汗的穆斯林和塔利班免受美军的袭击。

paras.en: The killings on 5 November 2009 were the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.
paras.zh: 2009年11月5日的杀戮是有史以来对美国军事基地最致命的非战斗性攻击。

paras.en: US military law requires that a military execution be approved by the US president. It also requires appellate review, when a higher court inspects the decision and gives a final judgement on its legality to move forward.
paras.zh: 美国军事法律要求军事处决必须得到美国总统的批准。当上级法院检查裁决并对其合法性做出最终判决时，也需要上诉复审。

articles.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume

paras.en: Russia has accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery after Volodymyr Zelensky said such strikes, halted at the request of the US, would resume.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯指责乌克兰袭击一家炼油厂，此前沃洛季米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）表示，应美国要求停止的此类罢工将恢复。

paras.en: Ukraine's president said he had restricted attacks for three days while Russia had continued striking Ukrainian energy infrastructure. "We're done," he told the Financial Times, external.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统表示，他已经限制了三天的袭击，而俄罗斯则继续袭击乌克兰的能源基础设施。“我们已经完成了，”他告诉英国《金融时报》。

paras.en: Zelensky also accused the US of withdrawing intelligence-sharing on Russian strikes to pressure Kyiv into ending attacks altogether after it struck a deal to import Russian diesel, and he said curbs on Starlink satellite services used by Ukraine's military were deliberate.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基还指责美国撤回对俄罗斯罢工的情报共享，以迫使基辅在达成进口俄罗斯柴油的协议后完全结束袭击，他说，乌克兰军方对Starlink卫星服务的限制是故意的。

paras.en: Ukrainian defence sources told the BBC some Starlink functionality had resumed as of Thursday morning.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国防消息人士告诉BBC ，截至周四上午， Starlink的一些功能已经恢复。

paras.en: They said its military service Starshield's "operation while on the move" had been restored, although it remains unclear whether the restrictions to the speed at which drones could fly while still maintaining Starlink internet connection have been fully lifted.
paras.zh: 他们表示，其军事服务Starshield的“移动操作”已经恢复，但目前尚不清楚是否已完全取消对无人机飞行速度的限制，同时仍保持Starlink互联网连接。

paras.en: Officials were still working to clarify "the reasons and circumstances" behind the move, the sources added.
paras.zh: 消息人士补充说，官员仍在努力澄清此举背后的“原因和情况”。

paras.en: In a separate development, seven people are missing after a drone attack set a chemical tanker on fire off Romania, according to naval officials. Moscow said it had hit two cargo ships with military cargo heading to Ukraine's Odesa port, without naming them.
paras.zh: 根据海军官员的说法，在另一个开发项目中，无人机袭击导致罗马尼亚附近的一艘化学品油轮起火，造成7人失踪。莫斯科表示，它击中了两艘运载军用货物前往乌克兰敖德萨港的货船，但没有透露他们的名字。

paras.en: The Kremlin said Kyiv had "attempted a large-scale attack" on a refinery south of Moscow early on Thursday.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示，基辅周四早些时候“试图对莫斯科南部的一家炼油厂进行大规模袭击”。

paras.en: According to Russia's defence ministry, four missiles and dozens of drones were intercepted and the falling debris caused a fire at the site in Ryazan.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯国防部称，四枚导弹和数十架无人机被拦截，坠落的碎片在梁赞现场引发了火灾。

paras.en: President Vladimir Putin said Kyiv had also tried to hit refineries on Wednesday - which Ukraine has denied - and had not caused "significant damage" so far.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）表示，基辅周三也试图袭击炼油厂-乌克兰否认了这一点-到目前为止还没有造成“重大损害”。

paras.en: Zelensky said dozens of Ukrainian cities had come under Russian attack in the past day.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，过去一天，数十个乌克兰城市遭到俄罗斯的袭击。

paras.en: He previously said he would agree to the "energy ceasefire" announced by US President Donald Trump on Sunday if Moscow also abided by it.
paras.zh: 他此前曾表示，如果莫斯科也遵守美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日宣布的“能源停火” ，他将同意。

paras.en: But he accused Russia of ignoring the proposed deal within hours of it being announced, with strikes leaving hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians without power. The Kremlin never said it had agreed to the deal.
paras.zh: 但他指责俄罗斯在宣布拟议的协议后数小时内无视该协议，罢工使数十万乌克兰人失去权力。克里姆林宫从未表示同意这笔交易。

paras.en: Zelensky agreed that he felt betrayed by the US when asked by Piers Morgan on Wednesday night, after Washington appeared to withdraw key elements of its support.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基同意，在华盛顿似乎撤回其支持的关键要素后，当皮尔斯·摩根（ Piers Morgan ）在周三晚上提出要求时，他感到被美国背叛了。

paras.en: European leaders have rallied around the Ukrainian president. Italy's Defence Minister Guido Crosetto told the BBC that the US restricting its intelligence-sharing with Kyiv would be a "complete mistake".
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人聚集在乌克兰总统周围。意大利国防部长吉多·克罗塞托（ Guido Crosetto ）告诉英国广播公司，美国限制与基辅分享情报将是一个“完全错误”。

paras.en: "Because it is a fundamental form of support. This means denying a country any chance of defending itself."
paras.zh: “因为它是一种基本的支持形式。这意味着剥夺一个国家自卫的机会。”

paras.en: He added: "Peace will be achieved when Putin will be convinced that there is a stalemate... that he cannot advance anymore. But if he sees a weakness on the Ukrainian front, if the United States takes its resources away, then Putin will think he can win, and so he will continue the war."
paras.zh: 他补充说： “当普京确信存在僵局......他不能再前进时，和平就会实现。但如果他看到乌克兰方面的弱点，如果美国拿走它的资源，那么普京会认为他能赢，所以他会继续战争。”

paras.en: Zelensky met Nato chief Mark Rutte as a two-day summit of European leaders began in Brussels on Thursday. The head of the military alliance said they had discussed "the importance of implementing an energy ceasefire as well as Nato allies' continuous support for Ukraine".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周四在布鲁塞尔举行的为期两天的欧洲领导人峰会上会见了北约主席马克·吕特。军事联盟负责人表示，他们已经讨论了“实施能源停火的重要性以及北约盟国对乌克兰的持续支持”。

paras.en: Zelensky told the FT that Ukrainian officials had been told by US counterparts that "if you will not stop [the strikes], we will block intelligence".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基告诉英国《金融时报》，美国官员告诉乌克兰官员， “如果你们不停止（罢工） ，我们将封锁情报部门”。

paras.en: Ukraine's military relies on US early-warning alerts of incoming Russian aerial attacks to mount air defences, limiting successful strikes, while Starlink internet links are used throughout its war effort to guide drones and protect its skies.
paras.zh: 乌克兰军方依靠美国对俄罗斯空袭的早期预警来建立防空系统，限制了空袭的成功，而Starlink的互联网链接在整个战争过程中被用来引导无人机和保护其天空。

paras.en: There were suggestions a technical glitch was to blame for the sudden Starlink restrictions on Tuesday evening, but owner Elon Musk appeared to deny this and suggested it was the Trump administration's doing.
paras.zh: 有人认为，周二晚上突然实施的Starlink限制应归咎于技术故障，但所有者埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)似乎否认了这一点，并暗示这是特朗普政府的所作所为。

paras.en: "It was not a technical problem, it was the will," Zelensky told the FT.
paras.zh: “这不是技术问题，而是遗嘱，”泽伦斯基告诉英国《金融时报》。

paras.en: Trump has denied halting intelligence-sharing. Starlink's sister service Starshield is provided to Ukraine under a US defence department contract. The BBC has approached the US authorities for comment.
paras.zh: 特朗普否认停止情报共享。Starlink的姐妹服务Starshield是根据美国国防部合同提供给乌克兰的。英国广播公司已与美国当局联系以征求意见。

paras.en: Zelensky spoke to the FT during a visit to London on Wednesday which also included a meeting with Prime Minister Andy Burnham in Downing Street - who announced the UK would speed up delivery of lightweight multirole missiles to Kyiv.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周三访问伦敦期间与英国《金融时报》进行了交谈，其中还包括在唐宁街与英国首相安迪·伯纳姆（ Andy Burnham ）会晤，后者宣布英国将加快向基辅交付轻型多用途导弹。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president told the newspaper he would now only halt strikes on Russian oil infrastructure - which Kyiv says are vital to cutting off revenue streams to its war machine - if the US supplied more Patriot air defence missiles.
paras.zh: 这位乌克兰总统告诉该报，如果美国提供更多的爱国者防空导弹，他现在只会停止对俄罗斯石油基础设施的打击--基辅说，这对于切断其战争机器的收入来源至关重要。

paras.en: Ukraine has suffered a shortage of the US-made defences since the outbreak of the Iran war consumed stockpiles.
paras.zh: 自伊朗战争爆发以来，乌克兰一直缺少美国制造的防御系统，耗尽了库存。

paras.en: Striking a more defiant tone than recently, the Ukrainian president told the newspaper his American counterpart had an affinity for autocratic leaders like Putin.
paras.zh: 这位乌克兰总统的语气比最近更加挑衅，他告诉该报，他的美国同行对像普京这样的专制领导人有亲和力。

paras.en: He said it was not up to him to mend US-Ukrainian relations given the events of the past week: "We didn't destroy any relationship."
paras.zh: 他说，鉴于过去一周发生的事件，他无法修复美乌关系： “我们没有破坏任何关系。”

paras.en: Tensions have previously frayed between the two leaders. After returning to the White House last year, the pair shared a fiery Oval Office meeting in which Trump implied Zelensky was the main block to a peace deal.
paras.zh: 此前，两位领导人之间的紧张关系已经破裂。去年回到白宫后，两人在椭圆形办公室举行了一次激烈的会议，特朗普暗示泽伦斯基是达成和平协议的主要障碍。

paras.en: Zelensky has since walked a careful diplomatic line, showing willingness towards US-brokered deals while stressing that the terms of any peace deal must be just.
paras.zh: 此后，泽伦斯基采取了谨慎的外交路线，表示愿意接受美国斡旋的交易，同时强调任何和平协议的条款都必须是公正的。

paras.en: But he criticised the agreement between Russia and the US to release 300,000 tonnes of diesel to the US and global marketplace, struck last week, as the US effectively investing in Russia's war effort.
paras.zh: 但他批评俄罗斯和美国上周达成的向美国和全球市场释放30万吨柴油的协议，因为美国有效地投资于俄罗斯的战争努力。

paras.en: That deal was the latest effort by Trump to lower fuel prices in the US ahead of the midterm elections, after months spent grappling with the political consequences of the Iran war, which has sent fuel costs skyrocketing.
paras.zh: 这笔交易是特朗普在中期选举前降低美国燃料价格的最新努力，此前特朗普花了数月时间应对伊朗战争的政治后果，伊朗战争导致燃料成本飙升。

paras.en: Zelensky told the FT: "The question will be: when will the next deal be? Maybe it will be gas. Definitely it will be gas."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基告诉英国《金融时报》： “问题将是：下一笔交易是什么时候？也许是汽油。肯定是汽油。”

paras.en: With Russia continuing to strike Ukraine, Zelensky suggested the disruptions to US support was no coincidence.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯继续袭击乌克兰，泽伦斯基表示，美国的支持中断并非巧合。

paras.en: Local officials report at least 13 people were killed across Ukraine on Wednesday in what Zelensky called a "constant", large-scale Russian attack. He said more than 850 drones had been launched at dozens of cities and communities.
paras.zh: 当地官员报告称，周三在乌克兰各地至少有13人丧生，泽伦斯基称之为俄罗斯“持续”的大规模袭击。他说，已有850多架无人机在数十个城市和社区发射。

paras.en: At least three people were killed in the central region of Kirovohrad as it suffered its largest attack since Russia's full-scale invasion began in 2022, officials there said, with nearly 360 drones launched during a 10-hour barrage. Deaths were also reported in Donetsk, Kherson and Volyn.
paras.zh: 基洛沃格勒州官员表示，自2022年俄罗斯全面入侵以来，该州中部地区遭受了最大规模的袭击，至少有3人丧生，近360架无人机在10小时的炮火中发射。顿涅茨克、赫尔松和沃伦也有死亡报告。

paras.en: "It is clear that Russia deliberately escalated these attacks, taking advantage of the easing of sanctions and seeing attempts to pressure Ukraine," Zelensky wrote on social media.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在社交媒体上写道： “很明显，俄罗斯故意升级这些袭击，利用放松制裁的机会，并看到向乌克兰施压的企图。”

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.

"We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."

The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.

Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.

articles.title: CentroMotion @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: Agritechnica 2025 was an incredible opportunity to connect with industry leaders, customers, and partners from around the world. We want to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who visited the CarlisleCBF and CentroMotion team at the show.

We’re excited to share the CentroMotion Agritechnica 2025 video, which captures the energy of our stand and highlights the innovative agricultural equipment products we showcased. From advanced friction technologies to solutions designed for the future of farming, this video gives you a front-row look at what makes Carlisle Brake & Friction a trusted partner in the Ag market.
👉 Watch the video here: [Agritechnica 2025 Video]
Thank you again for making Agritechnica 2025 a success. We look forward to continuing the conversation and driving innovation together!

articles.title: Crash Champions Opens First Location in Spring Hill, Fla.
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Crash Champions announced it has opened a new automotive repair center at 1118 Suzanne Drive in Spring Hill, Fla. The 32,000-plus square-foot facility includes more than 29,000 square feet of production space and is the company’s first location in Spring Hill.
The I-CAR Gold Class repair center opened for business Sept. 21. The addition expands Crash Champions’ presence in Florida, where it operates more than 60 locations.

“Spring Hill is an important addition to our Florida team, and we’re proud to expand the Crash Champions presence to this community,” said Matt Ebert, founder and CEO of Crash Champions. “We have built a strong and trusted relationship with Florida customers and business partners, and this new location gives us another opportunity to serve drivers with the high level of craftsmanship, care and professionalism they deserve.”

Spring Hill customers will have access to collision repair and calibration services delivered by an experienced team focused on repair quality, safety and customer experience. Crash Champions offers flexible payment options to assist with repair costs and insurance deductibles.

Across its network of more than 650 repair centers in 38 states, the company continues to invest in its people and create career opportunities throughout the collision repair industry. That commitment was recognized with the company’s 2026 listing as a Great Place to Work.
For more information on Crash Champions, visit crashchampions.com.
For career opportunities, visit careers.crashchampions.com.

articles.title: A proposed federal bill could put auto sellers in prison for not disclosing missing, disabled airbags
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: U.S. Rep. Mike Lawler (R-District 17) has filed a bill that would require auto dealerships and other resale channels selling used vehicles to sell them with functional airbag systems, or if an airbag is missing or disabled, to clearly disclose that.

If passed, the bill would mean up to life in prison for sellers if someone dies as a result of a vehicle sold at an auction or dealership without disclosing the vehicle is missing an airbag or is equipped with a disabled one.
Lawler filed the Anthony Amoros Law Right to Know Act this week, according to a press release from his office.

Anthony Amoros died in 2013 at the age of 18 after crashing his car on a windy stretch of road, according to a New York CBS News report. Amoros’s family purchased the vehicle without knowing it lacked an airbag.

New York Gov. Kathy Hochul signed a bill titled “Anthony Amoros Law” in 2021 that prohibits used car dealers from selling vehicles without a working airbag, according to Spectrum News. The law requires sellers to provide consumers with certification that the vehicle is equipped with an airbag.

“Every driver and passenger deserves to know that the vehicle they are getting into is safe, and this bill will help protect consumers by making sure they have the information they need to make informed decisions,” Lawler said in his press release. “This legislation will ensure dealerships and third-party sellers cannot sell these vehicles without clearly informing consumers of the safety risks.”
Lawler’s bill would require sellers to disclose that vehicles don’t have a working airbag on the front of the sales contract receipt and invoice.
The proposed law would give state officials or agencies authority to regulate and enforce compliance after Federal Trade Commission (FTC) notice.
The FTC will have the right to intervene in any action or file a petition of appeal.
Penalties outlined in the bill allow for a court to award an additional $25,000 for an action that involves death or paralysis.
The bill states that those who knowingly sell a vehicle without a working airbag and disclosure could be fined and face up to 10 years in prison.
It adds that a seller could face up to 20 years in prison if someone is seriously injured, including paralysis.
The bill also defines a “deficiency” as a vehicle without a functional airbag system and/or inflatable restraint system.

Counterfeit airbags are not specifically mentioned in the bill. However, it’s likely that vehicles without an airbag or a deficient airbag system travel through the same salvage routes as vehicles with counterfeit airbags.
The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) recently identified an 11th death caused by a counterfeit airbag part that the agency banned earlier this year.
The death happened Aug. 27 in Dallas, Texas, and is described as an otherwise survivable crash by NHTSA.

Teena Bohi, an Automotive Anti-Counterfeiting Council (A2C2) board member, said during a Collision Industry Conference (CIC) meeting in July that NHTSA’s investigation has uncovered how dangerous counterfeit parts find their way into vehicles.

“The totaling of a vehicle isn’t a cut-and-dried process,” Bohi says. “The value is driven depending on whether it is self-insured, the state the vehicle was in, the insurer’s own practices, processes, and thresholds. There is a lot that goes into just determining if the vehicle is totaled.”

Next, the vehicle often goes to an auction. If it is a public auction, an airbag deployment will possibly be reported to the National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS). The system is a database meant to prevent the resale of stolen vehicles and track unsafe salvage cars. If the vehicle goes to a wholesale or private auction, the previous crash information is not always captured, she said.

According to an Automotive News opinion piece, about 2.5 million vehicles were totaled by insurers last year before eventually returning to U.S. roadways. It says that a shift in insurers totaling more vehicles, along with the higher cost of new and used vehicles, has forced more dealers to repair and sell salvaged-titled vehicles.
Copart CEO Jeff Liaw discussed how salvaging a car for auction competes with collision repairs during a 2025 earnings call.

“Even an insurance carrier can sell their cars through other intermediaries; they can have more of them repaired,” Liaw said in the September call. “In many respects, we compete with the repair shops. The higher the returns we generate, the more we can win the rights to resolve that claim versus the repair industry. The lower the returns we generate, the more we lose head-to-head against the repair shops as well. There are a number of competitive threats that we face on any given day.”
He went on to describe how delivering “excellent service,” such as expediting cycle times and interacting with policyholders, can drive auction returns.
Those vehicles eventually have to be rebuilt before returning to the road — a process Bohi said can create opportunities for counterfeit safety components to enter the supply chain.
After repairs, vehicles are retitled, and the process can vary state to state, including the inspection process, Bohi says. Many don’t require airbag inspections.
“There are a lot of gaps where attention could be focused that could help address these types of issues,” Bohi said.
The Automotive News piece suggests that state processes, including inspection requirements, may need reworking as the market shifts to more dealers selling salvaged titles.

Last month, a California judge suspended the license of a Los Angeles-based automotive dealer after a Bureau of Automotive Repair (BAR) investigation found the business performed fraudulent vehicle safety systems inspections.
Industry Smog also issued 15 certificates of compliance without performing the required inspections, according to a press release.
A Michigan police officer was also recently sentenced for falsifying salvage vehicle inspections, according to a Michigan Department of Attorney General press release.

BAR has proposed changes that would add more regulations on parts used in airbag replacement. The changes would also ban manufacturing, importing, or selling any airbags that don’t meet the regulation rules.
NHTSA Deputy Administrator Lee White will open the Society of Collision Repair Specialists’ (SCRS) 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit during the SEMA Show in Las Vegas.

White will present on the agency’s current vehicle and roadway safety priorities, emerging transportation technologies, data-driven research, and the federal government’s work with the industry to reduce fatalities and serious injuries, an SCRS release states.
The session “The National Safety Objective: Safer Vehicles, Safer Roads,” will be held Thursday, Nov. 5 from 12:30-1:30 p.m.
Register for the session here and all three OEM Summit sessions here.

articles.title: Honda ready to test technology on public roads that charges EVs wirelessly
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Through a joint venture with two other companies, Honda has developed underlaying technology for a magnetic-coupling wireless power transfer road system (WPT road system), which will enable wireless in-motion charging of EVs, according to a press release.
Honda R&D, Taisei Corp. (Taisei), and Taisei Rotec Corp. (Taisei Rotec) plan to conduct demonstration testing of the system beginning in the Japanese 2027 fiscal year.
The system combines proprietary technology from each of the companies:
- Honda: High-power-density power receiver/transmitter units compatible with DC power distribution
paras.zh: - 本田：与直流配电兼容的高功率密度电力接收器/发射器单元

paras.en: - Taisei: High-response DC power supply system
- Taisei Rotec: Technology for embedding equipment in roads

“With these technologies, the system achieves high-power wireless power transfer (WPT) and excellent ease of installation in road pavement, envisioning applications for a wide range of mobility products, from passenger EVs to large commercial EVs,” the release states.

Honda says it has been working on dynamic wireless power transfer (DWPT) technology since 2021. The technology supplies power to vehicles while they are in motion and reduces the frequency of charging needed at home or at a charging station, the release states.

“Initially, Honda will strive to put DWPT technology into practical use in the logistics and transportation sectors, where DWPT technology is expected to deliver significant benefits,” the release states.

Honda, Taisei, and Taisei Rotec have been conducting research and development of the magnetic-coupling WPT road system since 2025, according to the release. This has resulted in the development of the underlaying technology for the system.

This includes conducting experiments and validation testing on a test roadway at the Future Technology Field for Taisei Group/Satte (T-FIELD/SATTE). The tests verified the effectiveness of the technologies for a WPT system, road pavement structures, and road construction methods intended for demonstration testing on public roads with large commercial vehicles, according to the release.
paras.zh: 这包括在大成集团/Satte (T-FIELD/SATTE) 未来技术场的测试道路上进行实验和验证测试。新闻稿称，这些测试验证了 WPT 系统、道路路面结构和道路施工方法技术的有效性，这些技术旨在在大型商用车辆的公共道路上进行示范测试。

paras.en: - DC distribution-based ground assembly (GA) systems that connect multiple GA units embedded in the road using a DC connection
- A vehicle assembly (VA) unit installed on the vehicle

Honda says that to achieve the real-world implementation of a WPT road system, it is essential to develop GA units and pavement structures with sufficient strength to withstand the loads of large commercial vehicles and a power transfer system capable of handling high-power transfer to EVs driving at high speeds, while also offering excellent practicality for installation in roads.
Testing at the T-FIELD/SATTE focused on GA units and pavement structures capable of withstanding the traffic of large vehicles with a gross vehicle weight of about 20 tons.
It also tested whether the DC power supply systems can supply high-power electricity to a DC distribution-based GA system with high responsiveness and stability.
The GA units were also tested for highly practical installation and future upgrades.

Next, the companies plan to begin testing long-term durability in late 2026 through a loading test equivalent to 1 million wheel loads using actual vehicles. It will also conduct DWPT performance tests and evaluate measures to address electromagnetic field leakage.
paras.zh: 接下来，两家公司计划在 2026 年底开始通过使用实际车辆进行相当于 100 万轮车轮负载的负载测试来测试长期耐久性。它还将进行 DWPT 性能测试并评估解决电磁场泄漏的措施。

paras.en: “Through these tests, the three companies will strive to ensure both power transfer performance and the safety of the GA units as structures embedded in the roadway,” the release states.

After this phase, the companies plan to further verify performance at high power output levels of up to 150 kW for potential application to large commercial vehicles, as well as verification of the reliability of WPT performance for vehicles traveling at high speeds.

Honda says that all three companies will participate in the “Tateyama Project” starting during the Japanese 2027 fiscal year. It will include demonstration testing of DWPT technology conducted by East Nippon Expressway Company Limited on the Tateyama Expressway in Chiba, Japan.

“Striving to realize a sustainable mobility society where people can enjoy freedom of mobility well into the future, Honda will continue to pursue co-creation with a diverse range of partners beyond the automotive industry, including road infrastructure-related businesses, government agencies and energy-related businesses,” the release states.

articles.title: Toyota opens new battery center as part of ‘electrification transformation’
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Toyota has opened a new battery center in Saline, Michigan, calling it “the next chapter of its electrification transformation.”

According to a press release from the automaker, the Toyota Battery Center of North America (TBC) gives Toyota Michigan-based battery teams increased capabilities to evaluate and develop technology across the full battery-development cycle, from sourcing raw materials and customer applications to recycling.

“Toyota has long been at the forefront of battery development,” said Keita Moritsu, Toyota Motor North America R&D senior vice president and chief technology officer, in the release. “This center is where that leadership expands to North America — and where we’re building its next chapter.”
paras.zh: 丰田汽车北美研发高级副总裁兼首席技术官 Keita Moritsu 在新闻稿中表示：“丰田长期以来一直处于电池开发的最前沿。” “这个中心是领导力扩展到北美的地方 - 也是我们正在构建下一个篇章的地方。”

paras.en: On site, teams of engineers and technicians assess battery performance and develop new technologies for use in hybrid, plug-in hybrid, hydrogen, and fully electric vehicles.

Toyota says the 30,000-square-foot facility serves as a central hub for development and evaluation, in partnership with Toyota’s North American manufacturing network, to support battery evaluation for Toyota Battery Manufacturing North Carolina, as well as the OEM’s vehicle manufacturing plants across North America.

“For Toyota customers, this facility means Toyota engineers can detect and resolve field concerns faster and closer to the source,” said Jordan Choby, Group Vice President of Powertrain, in the release. “It also means we can develop longer-lasting batteries designed to perform in the conditions American drivers face every day.”

Toyota says it will share research access at the facility with the University of Michigan Electric Vehicle Center. As a founding member of the center, Toyota says the program is a part of its commitment to developing the next generation of battery engineers and technicians in Michigan.

In 2025, Toyota began production at Toyota Battery Manufacturing North Carolina, its first battery plant opened outside of Japan. Located in Liberty, the $14 billion facility houses lithium-ion battery production lines for hybrid electric, plug-in hybrid electric, and battery electric vehicles.
Featured image: Toyota Battery Center of North America (TBC) in Saline, Michigan. (Provided by Toyota)
