articles.title: Galileo Space Is Building Satellites That Turn Signals Into Answers in Orbit
articles.author: Galileo Space

paras.en: Galileo Space is building satellites designed to turn signals into answers in orbit. Modern defense and commercial operations need fast answers about what is happening and where. Existing systems can leave segmented data crawling through processing for hours or days. FPV drones and moving radars must be detected and tracked quickly. Ballistic missile launch plume detection can provide critical early warning. Interference disrupting navigation frequencies or crucial satcom links must be detected and traced to its source. A ship lost at sea may still broadcast a distress signal. A tumbling satellite may lose contact with the ground while still emitting signals that help locate it. Rescue crews may have only hours to find someone before nightfall.
paras.zh: 伽利略航天公司正在建造旨在将信号转化为轨道上答案的卫星。现代国防和商业运营需要快速了解正在发生的事情和地点。现有系统可能会让分段数据在处理过程中爬行数小时或数天。 FPV 无人机和移动雷达必须被快速检测和跟踪。弹道导弹发射羽流检测可以提供关键的早期预警。必须检测干扰导航频率或关键卫星通信链路的干扰并追踪其来源。在海上失踪的船只仍可能会发出求救信号。翻滚的卫星可能会与地面失去联系，但仍会发出有助于定位的信号。救援人员可能只有几个小时的时间才能在夜幕降临之前找到人。

paras.en: The solution combines innovative sensors with AI fusion at the edge to generate actionable reports directly in orbit. The system is designed to operate fully autonomously for weeks, selecting and carrying out its own sensing tasks. It identifies threats, geolocates signals and delivers actionable intelligence to operators within minutes, not hours or days. The mission is to give defense teams the early warning they need to survive and commercial operators the answers they need to act.
paras.zh: 该解决方案将创新传感器与边缘人工智能融合相结合，直接在轨道上生成可操作的报告。该系统设计为完全自主运行数周，选择并执行自己的传感任务。它可以在几分钟（而不是几小时或几天）内识别威胁、对信号进行地理定位并向操作员提供可采取行动的情报。其使命是为防御团队提供生存所需的早期预警，并为商业运营商提供采取行动所需的答案。

paras.en: Working side by side with government stakeholders, the team has developed a deep understanding of operational needs and critical capability gaps. The company is in the final stages of securing its first government contract. Its first demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch in Q4 of 2027 to prove its capabilities in orbit and open the door to a potential Phase III government contract. Galileo has also deepened relationships with commercial companies that need near live data, creating a path to early revenue alongside its defense business.
paras.zh: 该团队与政府利益相关者并肩工作，对运营需求和关键能力差距有了深入的了解。该公司正处于获得第一份政府合同的最后阶段。其第一颗示范卫星计划于 2027 年第四季度发射，以证明其在轨能力，并为潜在的第三阶段政府合同打开大门。伽利略还加深了与需要近乎实时数据的商业公司的关系，为其国防业务创造了一条早期收入的途径。

paras.en: Galileo was selected for a16z speedrun as one of 80 companies chosen from 30,000 applicants.
paras.zh: Galileo 是从 30,000 名申请者中选出的 80 家公司之一，被选为 a16z speedrun 项目的一员。

paras.en: CEO: Brings a decade of experience in national security space and military systems at Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin. Led testing in orbit for protected military communications satellites and consulted for the U.S. Space Force on acquiring new technology. Combines spacecraft engineering expertise with deep knowledge of defense missions, government procurement and what operators need.
paras.zh: 首席执行官：在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司和洛克希德·马丁公司拥有十年的国家安全空间和军事系统经验。领导受保护的军用通信卫星在轨测试，并就获取新技术为美国太空军提供咨询。将航天器工程专业知识与国防任务、政府采购和运营商需求的深入了解相结合。

paras.en: CSO: Was responsible for building machine learning systems for Google, YouTube and Amazon’s Prime Video. Brings expertise in AI, software infrastructure and building systems at global scale. Now leads Galileo’s satellite software, bringing that experience into orbit to turn complex sensor data into clear intelligence that operators can act on.
paras.zh: CSO：负责为谷歌、YouTube 和亚马逊的 Prime Video 构建机器学习系统。在全球范围内带来人工智能、软件基础设施和建筑系统方面的专业知识。现在领导伽利略的卫星软件，将这种经验带入轨道，将复杂的传感器数据转化为操作员可以采取行动的清晰情报。

paras.en: CTO: Designed, tested and delivered all RF radios for SpaceX Starship flights, owning the radios through Flight 10, including first booster catch at the tower. Introduced Starship’s first integrated Starlink phased array antenna and RTK GPS receiver hardware that helped guide the booster back to the tower. Previously worked on electronic warfare for a Navy jammer missile at Raytheon and designed high power RF amplifiers for the Navy and Ka band block upconverters for the Army at two startups.
paras.zh: 首席技术官：为 SpaceX 星舰飞行设计、测试并交付了所有 RF 无线电设备，并拥有 10 号航班的无线电设备，包括塔上的第一个助推器捕获器。推出 Starship 首款集成 Starlink 相控阵天线和 RTK GPS 接收器硬件，帮助引导助推器返回塔楼。此前曾在雷神公司从事海军干扰导弹的电子战工作，并在两家初创公司为海军设计高功率射频放大器，为陆军设计 Ka 频段上变频器。

paras.en: Visit our website: https://galileo-space.com
paras.zh: 访问我们的网站：https://galileo-space.com

articles.title: China launches Guowang, Yaogan-40 satellites, sets up busy Q4 manifest
articles.author: Andrew Jones

paras.en: HELSINKI — China completed its ninth and tenth launches of September, sending Guowang and Yaogan satellites into orbit, ahead of an intense finish to the year.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛基——中国在九月完成了第九次和第十次发射，将“国王”号和“遥感”卫星送入轨道，为今年的紧张收官之年做好准备。

paras.en: A Long March 8A lifted off at 9:32 a.m. Eastern (1332 UTC) Sept. 23 from the Hainan commercial spacecraft launch site, carrying the 26th group of satellites for China’s Guowang national low Earth orbit satellite internet project. Less than a day later, a Long March 6A lifted off at 4:46 a.m. Eastern (0846 UTC) Sept. 24 from Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center with the fourth group of Yaogan-40 satellites.
paras.zh: 9月23日东部时间1332年上午9时32分，长征八号A运载火箭从海南商业航天发射场升空，搭载着中国国网国家低轨卫星互联网工程第26组卫星。不到一天后，长征六号甲运载火箭于9月24日东部时间凌晨4时46分（世界标准时间0846）从太原卫星发射中心升空，搭载第四组遥感四十号卫星。

paras.en: The pair of launches capped a September in which Chinese launchers flew at a pace that frequently saw multiple orbital missions within days, including four different rockets launching from three sites within 48 hours Sept. 15–16.
paras.zh: 这两次发射为9月份画上了圆满的句号，中国运载火箭的飞行速度经常在几天内执行多次轨道任务，其中包括9月15日至16日48小时内从三个地点发射的四枚不同的火箭。

paras.en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp. (CASC) stated the Guowang satellites had entered their planned orbits. The satellites were later tracked by U.S. Space Force in roughly circular 1,100-kilometer-altitude orbits inclined by 50 degrees. The batch was developed under the overall leadership of the China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), CASC’s main spacecraft maker, according to the corporation.
paras.zh: 中国航天科技集团公司（CASC）表示，国王卫星已进入预定轨道。这些卫星随后被美国太空军在大约 1,100 公里高、倾斜 50 度的圆形轨道上进行跟踪。据该公司称，该批次产品是在中国航天科技集团公司主要航天器制造商中国空间技术研究院（CAST）的全面领导下开发的。

paras.en: Guowang is run by China SatNet, a state-owned enterprise established in 2021, and is planned to comprise around 13,000 satellites. The constellation uses satellites from multiple manufacturers and is launched on a range of Long March vehicles, with the Long March 8A, which debuted in February 2025, now launching regularly from Hainan’s commercial pads.
paras.zh: 国网由成立于 2021 年的国有企业中国卫星网运营，计划包含约 13,000 颗卫星。该星座使用多个制造商的卫星，并在一系列长征运载火箭上发射，其中长征八号甲于 2025 年 2 月首次亮相，现在定期从海南的商业发射场发射。

paras.en: The three Yaogan-40 (04) satellites will mainly be used for electromagnetic environment detection and related technology experiments, Xinhua reported, using boilerplate language typical of Yaogan launches. The satellites were also developed under CAST’s leadership.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，三颗遥感四十（04）卫星将主要用于电磁环境探测和相关技术实验，使用遥感发射典型的样板语言。这些卫星也是在中国科协的领导下研制的。

paras.en: The satellites entered near polar orbits with altitudes of around 800 km, joining three earlier batches in similar orbits. Analysis by Integrity ISR indicates that the Yaogan-40 groups are placed into orbital planes separated by 72 degrees in right ascension of the ascending node, suggesting a fifth group will be needed to complete the constellation.
paras.zh: 这些卫星进入了高度约 800 公里的近极轨道，加入了类似轨道的早期三批卫星。 Integrity ISR 的分析表明，Yaogan-40 群被放置在升交点赤经中相距 72 度的轨道平面中，这表明需要第五个群来完成该星座。

paras.en: The Long March 6A, a kerosene-liquid oxygen core with solid boosters, is one of CASC’s main vehicles for both Yaogan and megaconstellation missions from Taiyuan. The rocket has now flown 27 times since its debut in March 2022, with all flights successfully reaching orbit, though the upper stage has experienced a number of breakup events after payload deployment.
paras.zh: 长征六号甲运载火箭是带有固体助推器的煤油液氧核心，是中国航天科技集团公司在太原执行遥感和巨型星座任务的主要运载工具之一。自 2022 年 3 月首次亮相以来，该火箭现已飞行 27 次，所有飞行均成功进入轨道，尽管上级在有效载荷部署后经历了多次解体事件。

paras.en: The pair of launches take China to 70 orbital launch attempts for 2026. With the country aiming to surpass 100 launches in a calendar year for the first time, the final quarter will see heavy activity. China launched 26 times in Q3, following 26 in Q2 and 18 in Q1, and would need to conduct at least 31 launches in Q4. The country’s annual launch schedule is typically backloaded with a greater number of launches later in the year.
paras.zh: 这两次发射使中国在 2026 年进行了 70 次轨道发射尝试。由于该国的目标是在一个日历年内首次超过 100 次发射，因此最后一个季度将出现大量活动。中国在第三季度发射了 26 次，继第二季度 26 次和第一季度 18 次之后，第四季度需要至少进行 31 次发射。该国的年度发射计划通常会在今年晚些时候进行更多的发射。

paras.en: One major mission will be Shenzhou-24. China’s next crewed mission now appears likely to launch around November, using a Long March 2F from Jiuquan. The crew is expected, though not officially confirmed, to include a Pakistani payload specialist, chosen from one of two Pakistan Air Force pilots in training at the Astronaut Center of China. The selected astronaut would become the first foreign astronaut to visit Tiangong.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号将是一项重大任务。中国的下一次载人任务现在看来可能会在 11 月左右发射，使用的是酒泉的长征二号F。尽管尚未正式确认，机组人员预计将包括一名巴基斯坦有效载荷专家，他是从在中国宇航员中心接受训练的两名巴基斯坦空军飞行员中挑选的。入选的宇航员将成为第一位访问天宫的外国宇航员。

paras.en: A press conference a day ahead of the Shenzhou-24 launch may also provide updates or insights into the schedule for the first launch of the Mengzhou new generation spacecraft and the Long March 10A, both of which are related to China’s crewed lunar plans.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号发射前一天的新闻发布会还可能提供孟州新一代飞船和长征十号甲首次发射时间表的最新情况或见解，这两者都与中国的载人登月计划有关。

paras.en: Possible debut launches include Orienspace’s Gravity-2, iSpace’s Hyperbola-3 with a first stage recovery attempt, and Zhihang-1 from Zenk Space, which earlier aimed for a launch in June. These would add to 2026 debuts including Tianlong-3 (April), Kinetica-2 (March), the Long March 12B (June), Long March 10B (July) and Pallas-1 (Sept. 1).
paras.zh: 可能的首次发射包括Orienspace的Gravity-2、iSpace的Hyperbola-3（进行第一阶段回收尝试）以及Zenk Space的Zhihang-1（其早些时候计划于6月发射）。这些将在 2026 年首次亮相的基础上增加，包括天龙三号（4 月）、动能二号（3 月）、长征十二号乙（六月）、长征十号乙（七月）和帕拉斯一号（九月 1 日）。

paras.en: Numerous launches for the Guowang and Qianfan constellations are expected. Other notable possible payloads in the coming months include Fengxing-1 on a Gravity-1 solid rocket, which could be China’s first commercial orbital transfer vehicle, from Future Space. Also expected are space computing payloads. The schedule for the planned debut flight of the Haolong reusable spaceplane for cargo to Tiangong from AVIC on a Zhuque-3 rocket from Landspace is currently unknown.
paras.zh: 国望星座和千帆星座预计将进行多次发射。未来几个月其他值得注意的可能有效载荷包括来自未来空间的重力一号固体火箭上的风行一号，这可能是中国第一个商业轨道转移飞行器。预计还有太空计算有效载荷。昊龙可重复使用航天飞机计划通过蓝箭朱雀三号火箭从中航工业飞往天宫的首次飞行时间表目前尚不清楚。

articles.title: LMT Group and Novaspace partner to develop strategy for 5G/6G satellite communications hub in Latvia
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Noordwijk, the Netherlands | September 22, 2026 – During the international Industry Space Days 2026 event at the European Space Agency’s ESTEC facility in Noordwijk, the Netherlands, the Latvian Mobile Telephone (LMT) Group and the globally leading space consultancy Novaspace signed a cooperation agreement on the development of a concept for telecommunications innovation platform for Latvia to link the national connectivity sector with the international satellite industry. The initiative follows the successful ESA 5G/6G Non-Terrestrial Network Hub model and will explore Latvia’s potential role within this network.
paras.zh: 荷兰诺德韦克 | 2026 年 9 月 22 日 – 在欧洲航天局位于荷兰诺德韦克的 ESTEC 设施举行的 2026 年国际工业航天日活动期间，拉脱维亚移动电话 (LMT) 集团和全球领先的航天咨询公司 Novaspace 签署了一项合作协议，为拉脱维亚开发电信创新平台概念，以将国家连接部门与国际卫星行业连接起来。该举措遵循成功的 ESA 5G/6G 非地面网络中心模型，并将探索拉脱维亚在该网络中的潜在作用。

paras.en: Signing the agreement marks a pivotal step toward creating a hub for developing an internationally competitive telecommunications sector in Latvia. The hub will strategically bring LMT into the space industry and impact the emergence of a wider Latvia’s space innovation ecosystem in next-generation satellite technologies, products, and services tailored to commercial applications, resilient critical infrastructure, security, digitalization and green transition. Essentially, the hub will attract national and international cooperation, funding and talent.
paras.zh: 该协议的签署标志着拉脱维亚在创建一个发展具有国际竞争力的电信行业的中心方面迈出了关键一步。该中心将战略性地将 LMT 引入航天工业，并影响拉脱维亚更广泛的航天创新生态系统的出现，包括针对商业应用、弹性关键基础设施、安全、数字化和绿色转型量身定制的下一代卫星技术、产品和服务。从本质上讲，该中心将吸引国内和国际合作、资金和人才。

paras.en: The next generation of mobile communications is closely linked to the rapid growth of the space economy globally. The space infrastructure is already gradually enhancing terrestrial networks, and the 6G era of telecommunications will seamlessly link terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. The rationale for such development is efficient and resilient connectivity, especially essential in scenarios involving severe weather, power outages or physical infrastructure disruptions.
paras.zh: 下一代移动通信与全球航天经济的快速增长密切相关。太空基础设施已经在逐步增强地面网络，电信的6G时代将无缝连接地面和非地面网络。这种开发的理由是高效且有弹性的连接，在涉及恶劣天气、停电或物理基础设施中断的情况下尤其重要。

paras.en: This initiative builds upon LMT Group’s strategic expansion of its track record in connectivity innovation. LMT is already collaborating with ESA and satellite operator Sateliot to pioneer energy efficient dual-mode satellite Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity, enabled by Latvia’s associate membership in ESA. The hardware and software to be developed will cover the current market gap in devices that can seamlessly switch between terrestrial and satellite networks. The planned 5G/6G NTN hub is a natural next step in scaling LMT’s technological footprint within Europe’s space ecosystem.
paras.zh: 这一举措建立在 LMT 集团对其连接创新业绩进行战略扩展的基础上。 LMT 已经与 ESA 和卫星运营商 Sateliot 合作，在拉脱维亚作为 ESA 准会员的支持下，率先推出节能双模卫星物联网 (IoT) 连接。即将开发的硬件和软件将弥补目前可在地面和卫星网络之间无缝切换的设备的市场空白。计划中的 5G/6G NTN 中心是扩大 LMT 在欧洲太空生态系统中技术足迹的自然下一步。

paras.en: “LMT has long evolved beyond traditional mobile operations into a full-scale technology innovator. As we prepare for the 6G era, integrating satellite communications into our infrastructure and service portfolio is essential. Our goal is to ensure resilient, secure communications for new commercial services and for critical infrastructure under any circumstances, to produce exportable space technologies and develop services that contribute to digitalization and green transition. Partnering with Novaspace will allow us to define Latvia’s unique value proposition within the European space ecosystem and expand local high-tech expertise,” Ingmārs Pūķis, VP & Member of the Management Board at LMT.
paras.zh: “LMT 早已超越传统的移动运营，成为全面的技术创新者。在我们为 6G 时代做准备时，将卫星通信集成到我们的基础设施和服务组合中至关重要。我们的目标是确保在任何情况下为新的商业服务和关键基础设施提供弹性、安全的通信，以生产可出口的空间技术并开发有助于数字化和绿色转型的服务。与 Novaspace 的合作将使我们能够在欧洲空间生态系统中定义拉脱维亚的独特价值主张，并扩展当地的高科技专业知识。” Ingmārs Pūķis，LMT 副总裁兼管理委员会成员。

paras.en: The agreement was signed under the EU-funded FIERCE Ecosystem Building Programme, in which LMT participates as an innovation intermediary and Novaspace provides strategic support and space-market expertise. Through the programme, Novaspace will work directly with LMT to define and validate the concept, guiding LMT towards a Latvian 5G/6G terrestrial and non-terrestrial network (TN/NTN) hub. The joint effort will focus on identifying Latvia’s distinctive regional value proposition and connecting the future hub with the wider European 5G/6G and NTN ecosystem, rather than replicating existing European initiatives.
paras.zh: 该协议是在欧盟资助的 FIERCE 生态系统建设计划下签署的，LMT 作为创新中介参与其中，Novaspace 提供战略支持和太空市场专业知识。通过该计划，Novaspace 将直接与 LMT 合作定义和验证这一概念，指导 LMT 建设拉脱维亚 5G/6G 地面和非地面网络 (TN/NTN) 中心。此次共同努力将侧重于确定拉脱维亚独特的区域价值主张，并将未来的枢纽与更广泛的欧洲 5G/6G 和 NTN 生态系统连接起来，而不是复制现有的欧洲举措。

paras.en: “At Novaspace, we are delighted to partner with LMT Group through the FIERCE project. The strength of Europe’s space sector depends on active participation across all Member States, and Latvia is well positioned both to benefit from and contribute to Europe’s growing space economy. Flagship European programmes such as Copernicus, Galileo, EGNOS and IRIS² are creating new opportunities for innovation, resilient connectivity and commercial growth. Drawing on Novaspace’s global market expertise, we look forward to supporting LMT in defining a distinctive role for Latvia within Europe’s 5G/6G and non-terrestrial network ecosystem,” Gabrielle Brophy, Senior Manager at Novaspace.
paras.zh: “在 Novaspace，我们很高兴通过 FIERCE 项目与 LMT 集团合作。欧洲航天领域的实力取决于所有成员国的积极参与，而拉脱维亚处于有利地位，既能从欧洲不断增长的航天经济中受益，又能为欧洲不断增长的航天经济做出贡献。哥白尼、伽利略、EGNOS 和 IRIS² 等欧洲旗舰项目正在为创新、弹性连接和商业增长创造新的机会。利用 Novaspace 的全球市场专业知识，我们期待支持 LMT 定义一个独特的Novaspace 高级经理 Gabrielle Brophy 表示：“拉脱维亚在欧洲 5G/6G 和非地面网络生态系统中发挥着重要作用。”

paras.en: The planned hub will be developed together with research and industry partners in the region. This collaborative framework will help retain and grow specialized engineering and scientific competencies in the Baltic region.
paras.zh: 规划中的中心将与该地区的研究和行业合作伙伴共同开发。这一合作框架将有助于保留和发展波罗的海地区的专业工程和科学能力。

paras.en: The signing ceremony in Noordwijk was attended by representatives of the European Space Agency, Novaspace, the Latvian embassy in the Netherlands, the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Latvia, the Investment and Development Agency of Latvia, Novaspace in representation of the FIERCE project and LMT.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局、Novaspace、拉脱维亚驻荷兰大使馆、拉脱维亚共和国教育和科学部、拉脱维亚投资和发展局、代表 FIERCE 项目的 Novaspace 和 LMT 的代表出席了在诺德韦克举行的签字仪式。

articles.title: Haiti sanctions renewed: Starving the gangs of bullets

paras.en: Haiti sanctions renewed: Starving the gangs of bullets
paras.zh: 海地制裁更新：让该团伙挨饿

paras.en: Haiti is living through one of the world’s most acute security crises.
paras.zh: 海地正在经历世界上最严重的安全危机之一。

paras.en: Armed gangs control large parts of the capital, Port-au-Prince, and are pushing into rural areas, terrorising communities, killing people, committing rape and other sexual assaults, kidnapping for ransom and extorting individuals and businesses.
paras.zh: 武装团伙控制了首都太子港的大部分地区，并正在侵入农村地区，恐吓社区、杀人、实施强奸和其他性侵犯、绑架勒索以及勒索个人和企业。

paras.en: About 1.5 million people, roughly 12 per cent of the population, have been forced from their homes.
paras.zh: 约 150 万人（约占总人口的 12%）被迫离开家园。

paras.en: Haiti makes no guns or ammunition of its own, yet the gangs never seem to run out.
paras.zh: 海地自己不生产枪支或弹药，但该团伙似乎永远不会用完。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the UN Security Council renewed sanctions meant to change that by targeting people considered responsible for or involved in activities threatening Haiti’s peace, security and stability.
paras.zh: 周三，联合国安理会重新实施制裁，旨在改变这种状况，目标是那些被认为对海地和平、安全与稳定负责或参与威胁海地和平、安全与稳定活动的人。

paras.en: Created in 2022 by the Security Council, the Haiti sanctions committee has three main enforcement tools at its disposal: an arms embargo, a travel ban and an asset freeze.
paras.zh: 海地制裁委员会由安理会于 2022 年成立，可使用三种主要执行工具：武器禁运、旅行禁令和资产冻结。

paras.en: The embargo targets weapons and ammunition reaching armed groups. The travel ban and freeze apply to named people and entities who contribute to the Caribbean island nation’s insecurity and gang violence.
paras.zh: 禁运的目标是武装团体获得武器和弹药。旅行禁令和冻结适用于导致加勒比岛国不安全和帮派暴力的特定个人和实体。

paras.en: Nine individuals and two groups are currently sanctioned by the council.
paras.zh: 目前有九个人和两个团体受到该委员会的制裁。

paras.en: The human cost of gang violence in Haiti is stark.
paras.zh: 海地帮派暴力造成的人员伤亡是显而易见的。

paras.en: More than 3,000 people were killed and over 1,500 injured between October last year and April this year.
paras.zh: 去年10月至今年4月，已有3000多人死亡、1500多人受伤。

paras.en: A UN partner reported treating over 2,400 survivors of sexual violence in Port-au-Prince between January and May. Most were women and girls and 16 per cent were minors. Cases involving children as young as eight were also reported.
paras.zh: 联合国合作伙伴报告称，1 月至 5 月期间，在太子港治疗了 2,400 多名性暴力幸存者。大多数是妇女和女孩，16%是未成年人。还报告了涉及年仅八岁儿童的案件。

paras.en: Children are also being recruited by gangs.
paras.zh: 儿童也被帮派招募。

paras.en: Mostly by governments, at ports, borders and banks.
paras.zh: 主要由政府在港口、边境和银行进行。

paras.en: Haitian authorities have recently intercepted several illicit shipments at ports.
paras.zh: 海地当局最近在港口截获了多起非法货物。

paras.en: United States authorities have also intercepted firearms and ammunition destined for Haiti and pursued trafficking investigations.
paras.zh: 美国当局还拦截了运往海地的枪支和弹药，并对贩运活动进行调查。

paras.en: The UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) supports regional efforts to counter trafficking.
paras.zh: 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室（毒品和犯罪问题办公室）支持打击人口贩运的区域努力。

paras.en: Haiti does not manufacture firearms or ammunition, but according to the figures released by the UN human rights office last year, there are an estimated between 270,000 and 500,000 illegal weapons in circulation.
paras.zh: 海地不生产枪支弹药，但根据联合国人权办公室去年公布的数据，估计有27万至50万件非法武器在流通。

paras.en: The arms embargo is violated “on a regular basis” according to the panel of experts on Haiti, an independent fact-finding body established by the Security Council, which gathers evidence and analyses information related to sanctions violations.
paras.zh: 海地问题专家小组是安理会设立的独立实况调查机构，负责收集证据并分析与违反制裁行为有关的信息，该小组表示，违反武器禁运的行为“经常”发生。

paras.en: These independent experts have travelled to Port-au-Prince and Cap-Haïtien in Haiti, Santo Domingo in the neighbouring Dominican Republic and Miami in the US to meet government officials, police, financial institutions, civil society representatives and people affected by gang violence.
paras.zh: 这些独立专家前往海地的太子港和海地角、邻国多米尼加共和国的圣多明各和美国迈阿密，会见政府官员、警察、金融机构、民间社会代表和受帮派暴力影响的人们。

paras.en: Some of the gang’s bullets come from national stockpiles, and police do not centrally track what they seize, so some weapons are unaccounted for or diverted by corrupt officers.
paras.zh: 该团伙的一些子弹来自国家库存，警方并没有集中追踪他们缴获的子弹，因此一些武器下落不明或被腐败官员转用。

paras.en: The asset freeze has fared worse, the panel said. Only two sanctioned individuals’ accounts were reported frozen, with meagre sums, because banks acted slowly and the targets moved money or hid it under third parties’ names.
paras.zh: 该小组表示，资产冻结的情况更糟。据报道，只有两名受制裁个人的账户被冻结，金额微薄，因为银行行动缓慢，而且目标转移资金或将资金藏在第三方名下。

paras.en: The panel found no attempts to break the travel ban, but warned that fraudulent passports could help sanctioned people travel under false names.
paras.zh: 该小组没有发现任何违反旅行禁令的企图，但警告说，伪造的护照可能会帮助受制裁的人以假名旅行。

paras.en: The independent panel’s message is that “targeting gang leaders without addressing the networks that sustain them will inevitably fall short.”
paras.zh: 该独立小组传达的信息是，“针对帮派头目而不解决支撑他们的网络将不可避免地失败。”

paras.en: It points to political, economic and security figures who back gangs and says many gang leaders beyond those on the sanctions list meet the criteria.
paras.zh: 报告指出了支持帮派的政治、经济和安全人士，并表示制裁名单上的许多帮派头目都符合标准。

paras.en: Gangs have continued their deadly expansion despite the sanctions already in place, a clear indication that enforcement matters.
paras.zh: 尽管制裁已经到位，但犯罪团伙仍在继续致命扩张，这清楚地表明执法很重要。

paras.en: At Wednesday’s meeting, speakers from some of the Security Council’s 15 Member States re-emphasised the need to disrupt gang financing, close loopholes and hold the networks supporting armed groups accountable.
paras.zh: 在周三的会议上，安理会 15 个成员国中的一些发言者再次强调，有必要扰乱帮派融资、堵住漏洞并追究支持武装团体的网络的责任。

paras.en: The council extended the work of its sanctions committee by 13 months.
paras.zh: 安理会将制裁委员会的工作期限延长了 13 个月。

paras.en: Haiti welcomed the renewal while warning that sanctions alone cannot restore security.
paras.zh: 海地对延长制裁表示欢迎，同时警告称，单靠制裁无法恢复安全。

paras.en: For Haitians living with gang violence, what matters is whether work of the sanctions committee and the efforts made by the Haitian Government and countries in the region translate into safer neighbourhoods, fewer weapons in criminal hands and greater freedom to travel, work and reach essential services.
paras.zh: 对于遭受帮派暴力的海地人来说，重要的是制裁委员会的工作以及海地政府和该地区国家所做的努力能否转化为更安全的社区、更少的犯罪分子手中的武器以及更大的旅行、工作和获取基本服务的自由。

articles.title: Aston Villa hit Fenerbahce for six in big win at Villa Park

paras.en: Aston Villa vs Fenerbahce; UEFA Champions League
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉 vs 费内巴切；欧洲冠军联赛

paras.en: Aston Villa vs Fenerbahce. UEFA Champions League.
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉对阵费内巴切。欧洲冠军联赛。

paras.en: Aston Villa 6-0 Fenerbahce: Nicolas Jackson and Ross Barkley both score twice in big Champions League win
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉 6-0 费内巴切：尼古拉斯·杰克逊和罗斯·巴克利双双梅开二度，赢得欧冠大胜

paras.en: Match report as Aston Villa were big winners on the return of Champions League football to Villa Park; Fenerbahce were beaten 6-0 with Nicolas Jackson and Ross Barkley scoring two each for Unai Emery’s team as Johan Manzambi also scored in fine display
paras.zh: 比赛报道阿斯顿维拉是冠军联赛重返维拉公园球场的大赢家；费内巴切队以 6-0 击败费内巴切队，尼古拉斯·杰克逊和罗斯·巴克利为乌奈·埃梅里的球队各进两球，约翰·曼赞比也有精彩表现进球

paras.en: Aston Villa dismantled Fenerbahce with Nicolas Jackson and Ross Barkley scoring two each in a 6-0 Champions League win at Villa Park.
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉凭借尼古拉斯·杰克逊和罗斯·巴克利各进两球，在维拉公园球场以 6-0 击败费内巴切。

paras.en: The impressive Johan Manzambi opened the scoring when his shot was deflected in off Fenerbahce captain Milan Skriniar to leave Ederson stranded and although Villa needed goalkeeper Zion Suzuki to save well from Vedat Muriqi it was all but over by the break.
paras.zh: 令人印象深刻的约翰·曼赞比首开纪录，他的射门被费内巴切队长米兰·什克里尼亚尔挡出，埃德森陷入困境，尽管维拉需要门将锡安·铃木从维达特·穆里奇手中扑救，但比赛在中场休息时几乎结束。

paras.en: Jackson's two first-half goals, both arrowed to Ederson's right, put Unai Emery's side three up by half-time. Fenerbahce's fans continued to chant away but there was no way back on what proved a comfortable night for Vila in front of the Prince of Wales.
paras.zh: 杰克逊上半场的两个进球都指向埃德森的右侧，使乌奈·埃默里的球队在半场结束时领先三分。费内巴切的球迷继续高喊口号，但维拉在威尔士亲王面前度过了一个舒适的夜晚，但已经无法挽回了。

paras.en: - Champions League fixtures and results | Latest news: Aston Villa
paras.zh: - 冠军联赛赛程和结果|最新消息：阿斯顿维拉

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream Premier League games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播英超联赛📺

paras.en: The Turkish squad is packed with familiar names. Nathan Ake started, Romelu Lukaku came on, while Mason Greenwood's every touch was booed. But they had nobody with the exuberance of Manzambi or indeed the 18-year-old Ibrahim Mbaye out wide.
paras.zh: 土耳其队里挤满了熟悉的名字。内森·阿克首发，罗梅鲁·卢卡库上场，而梅森·格林伍德的每一次触球都遭到嘘声。但他们没有像曼赞比那样充满活力的球员，甚至没有像 18 岁的易卜拉欣·姆巴耶那样的边路球员。

paras.en: Manzambi won a penalty that Barkley tucked away expertly to make it four and another deflected shot brought the midfielder's second and his team's fifth. There was even time for Alysson to lay on the sixth for fellow substitute Tammy Abraham in the 90th minute.
paras.zh: 曼赞比赢得了一个点球，巴克利熟练地罚进了第四个点球，而另一次偏转的射门为这位中场球员打进了第二个点球，也是球队的第五个点球。第 90 分钟，阿利森甚至有时间为替补队员塔米·亚伯拉罕打进第六球。

paras.en: It is two wins from two in the Champions League now, despite a less convincing start to the Premier League campaign for this new-look team. Villa's fans hoisted up a tifo declaring this the next chapter in their European story. It is good reading for them so far.
paras.zh: 尽管这支新球队在英超联赛中的开局不太令人信服，但目前在冠军联赛中已经取得了两场胜利。维拉的球迷举起了TIFO，宣布这将是他们欧洲故事的新篇章。到目前为止，这对他们来说是很好的阅读。

paras.en: The decision to sell Ollie Watkins this summer would have left some Villa supporters concerned about how much the England forward would be missed this season but Jackson's start to life at Villa Park will have many feeling more encouraged.
paras.zh: 今年夏天出售奥利·沃特金斯的决定会让一些维拉球迷担心本赛季会错过这位英格兰前锋，但杰克逊在维拉公园的开始生活会让很多人感到更加鼓舞。

paras.en: The Senegal striker has scored in each of his last two Premier League appearances and now has three goals from two Champions League games too. The quality of his finishing has been a topic of debate throughout his career but he was utterly clinical in this game.
paras.zh: 这位塞内加尔前锋在过去两场英超比赛中都取得了进球，现在在两场欧冠比赛中也打入了三个进球。在他的整个职业生涯中，他的射门质量一直是争论的话题，但他在这场比赛中表现得非常冷静。

paras.en: Jackson only turned 25 years old in June, whereas Watkins is 30. There are risks associated with Villa's rebuild but, with the new man having worked with Emery before at Villarreal, this is one buy that looks likely to work out well for the West Midlands side.
paras.zh: 杰克逊在六月才满25岁，而沃特金斯已经30岁了。维拉的重建存在风险，但由于新人之前曾在比利亚雷亚尔与埃梅里共事过，所以这笔收购看起来对西米德兰兹队来说可能会很有效。

paras.en: Aston Villa striker Nicolas Jackson speaking to TNT Sports:
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉前锋尼古拉斯·杰克逊接受 TNT 体育采访：

paras.en: "He [Johan Manzambi] is a top player. I'm very happy we're playing together. Hopefully we score many more goals together.
paras.zh: “他（约翰·曼赞比）是一名顶级球员。我很高兴我们一起踢球。希望我们一起打进更多进球。

paras.en: "He [Ibrahim Mbaye] is an amazing player. We're in the [Senegal] national team together so we have a good connection and we talk a lot. He's progressing so hopefully he'll get more time to play. He's very fast. It's good to have him."
paras.zh: “他[易卜拉欣·姆巴耶]是一位了不起的球员。我们一起在[塞内加尔]国家队，所以我们有很好的联系，我们聊了很多。他正在进步，所以希望他能有更多的时间上场。他速度很快。拥有他真是太好了。”

paras.en: On whether he wanted to take the penalty for a hat-trick chance: "Yeah, I wanted to take it, but there are rules. The most important thing is we win, but hopefully next time I'll get the hat-trick."
paras.zh: 关于他是否想主罚帽子戏法机会：“是的，我想主罚，但有规则。最重要的是我们赢了，但希望下次我能上演帽子戏法。”

paras.en: Aston Villa manager Unai Emery speaking in the press conference:
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉主教练乌奈·埃梅里在新闻发布会上发言：

paras.en: "I am delighted for the first win at home. We needed it. In the first half, [even] winning 3-0 I was not so happy, like the last match. They didn't score but Zion played fantastic, they hit the crossbar, did not shoot well. But we wanted to control the match better.
paras.zh: “我很高兴在主场取得首场胜利。我们需要它。上半场，即使是3-0获胜，我也没有那么高兴，就像上一场比赛一样。他们没有进球，但锡安打得很棒，他们击中了横梁，射门不好。但我们想更好地控制比赛。

paras.en: "In the second half, we planned to correct it and I think we did it. After, we planned to stop them and we could score three more. They did not deserve 6-0 but for us it was very important how we achieved the first win at home."
paras.zh: “下半场，我们计划纠正这一问题，我想我们做到了。之后，我们计划阻止他们，这样我们就能再进三个球。他们不值得6-0，但对我们来说，如何取得主场首场胜利非常重要。”

paras.en: Fenerbahce head coach Ismail Kartal speaking in the press conference:
paras.zh: 费内巴切主教练伊斯梅尔·卡尔塔尔在新闻发布会上讲话：

paras.en: "There is not much to say. The score is not earned, this is the top level of the Champions League and mistakes cost you a lot and that is what we experienced today.
paras.zh: “没什么好说的。分数不是赢得的，这是冠军联赛的最高水平，错误会让你付出很大的代价，这就是我们今天经历的。

paras.en: "We could not have imagined a result like this. This is not acceptable. We apologise to all the supporters of the club. We have had our lesson tonight.
paras.zh: “我们无法想象这样的结果。这是不可接受的。我们向俱乐部的所有支持者道歉。今晚我们已经得到了教训。

paras.en: "We have an important league game in a few days. We should forget about tonight's game and concentrate on the next one."
paras.zh: “几天后我们将有一场重要的联赛比赛。我们应该忘记今晚的比赛，专注于下一场比赛。”

paras.en: - Aston Villa have recorded their biggest ever win in major European competition, and their biggest victory under manager Unai Emery across all competitions.
paras.zh: - 阿斯顿维拉在欧洲主要赛事中取得了有史以来最大的胜利，也是在主教练乌奈·埃梅里的带领下在所有比赛中取得的最大胜利。

paras.en: - Fenerbahce suffered their heaviest defeat in the Champions League on the night they played in the competition for the 42nd time.
paras.zh: - 费内巴切在第 42 次参加欧冠比赛的当晚遭遇了欧冠联赛中最惨重的失利。

paras.en: - Aston Villa have won 18 of their last 20 home games in major European competition, and are on the joint-longest active winning streak at home in such competitions (11 - level with Freiburg).
paras.zh: - 阿斯顿维拉在过去 20 场欧洲主要赛事主场比赛中赢了 18 场，并且是此类赛事中主场并列最长的连胜纪录（与弗莱堡 11 场平）。

paras.en: - Aston Villa are one of two teams to score three first half goals in both of their opening two games of a Champions League campaign, alongside PSG also this season - the Villans are the second English team to do so in the European Cup, after Leeds United in 1969/70.
paras.zh: - 阿斯顿维拉是在欧冠联赛前两场比赛中上半场打进三个进球的两支球队之一，本赛季与巴黎圣日耳曼并列 - 维拉是继 1969/70 赛季的利兹联之后第二支在欧洲杯上做到这一点的英格兰球队。

paras.en: - After scoring just once across their first four games this season, Aston Villa have since scored three or more goals in four of their six matches - no Premier League team has scored more times than the Villans since the start of the run.
paras.zh: - 阿斯顿维拉在本赛季前四场比赛中仅进球一次，但此后在六场比赛中的四场比赛中打进了三个或更多进球 - 自赛季开始以来，没有一支英超球队比维拉队进球次数更多。

articles.title: Man City beaten by PSG in thriller as Guardiola returns to Etihad

paras.en: Manchester City vs Paris Saint-Germain; UEFA Champions League
paras.zh: 曼城 vs 巴黎圣日耳曼；欧洲冠军联赛

paras.en: Manchester City vs Paris Saint-Germain. UEFA Champions League.
paras.zh: 曼城对阵巴黎圣日耳曼。欧洲冠军联赛。

paras.en: Man City 2-4 PSG: Erling Haaland scores twice but Enzo Maresca's side suffer first defeat of season in front of Pep Guardiola
paras.zh: 曼城2-4巴黎圣日耳曼：哈兰德梅开二度，但恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队在瓜迪奥拉面前遭遇赛季首败

paras.en: Man City were beaten by PSG in first Champions League outing since Premier League handed down its guilty verdict; Pep Guardiola was in attendance alongside club's high-ranking executives; PSG scored three first-half goals to take control; Erling Haaland responded by scoring two
paras.zh: 曼城在英超联赛做出有罪判决后的首场欧冠比赛中被巴黎圣日耳曼击败；瓜迪奥拉与俱乐部高层一起出席了会议；巴黎圣日耳曼上半场连进三球，掌控局势；埃尔林·哈兰德梅开二度回应

paras.en: Manchester City were beaten 4-2 by a majestic Paris Saint-Germain as Pep Guardiola watched on from the stands in an enthralling Champions League encounter.
paras.zh: 曼城队以 4-2 输给了雄伟的巴黎圣日耳曼队，瓜迪奥拉在看台上观看了这场精彩的欧冠比赛。

paras.en: The reigning back-to-back European champions were keen to make their power felt early at the Etihad, in a game that made clear where the greater concentration of quality resides. Luis Enrique's side were breathtaking in the first half, a masterclass in effortless control with and without the ball.
paras.zh: 卫冕欧洲冠军球队渴望在阿提哈德球场一开始就展现出自己的力量，这场比赛清楚地表明了实力的集中度。路易斯·恩里克的球队上半场表现得令人惊叹，无论有球还是无球，控球能力都是大师级的。

paras.en: Desire Doue scored from range. Ousmane Dembele rounded off a wonderful team move 99 seconds later. And Vitinha finished a brilliant first 45 minutes with a thumping finish from Warren Zaire-Emery's instinctive flick. "If you don't go toe-to-toe, you struggle," reflected Enzo Maresca.
paras.zh: 德西雷·杜埃远射得分。 99秒后，奥斯曼·登贝莱完成了一次精彩的团队动作。维蒂尼亚在前 45 分钟凭借沃伦·扎伊尔·埃默里本能的一脚大力射门完成了精彩的比赛。 “如果你不面对面，你就会陷入困境，”恩佐·马雷斯卡反映道。

paras.en: - Champions League fixtures and results | Latest news: Man City
paras.zh: - 冠军联赛赛程和结果|最新消息：曼城

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream Premier League games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播英超联赛📺

paras.en: A pair of Erling Haaland goals made the scoreline respectable after the interval, and City were good value for both breakthroughs, doing to PSG what had been done to them in the first period. They hit the woodwork a further two times in a half that became increasingly more frantic and transitional.
paras.zh: 哈兰德的两粒进球让中场休息后的比分变得可观，而曼城的两次突破都很有价值，对巴黎圣日耳曼的影响就像他们在第一节中所做的那样。他们在半场中又击中了两次门框，变得越来越疯狂和过渡。

paras.en: Despite wave after wave of attack and big chances missed, it was Gianluigi Donnarumma who failed to escape the glare of the spotlight, his poor handling gifting Maghnes Akliouche and the visitors a fourth. He atoned by denying Ferran Torres' woeful penalty attempt late on.
paras.zh: 尽管一波又一波的进攻和错失的绝佳机会，吉安路易吉·多纳鲁马还是未能逃脱聚光灯的照射，他糟糕的处理让马格尼斯·阿克利乌什和客队获得了第四名。他通过拒绝费兰·托雷斯最后的糟糕点球来弥补这一点。

paras.en: PSG's first-half blitz proved decisive and sobered the atmosphere around a fairly muted Etihad, but Maresca will take comfort from the way his side turned a would-be rout into a thrilling clash of titans.
paras.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼上半场的闪电战被证明是决定性的，并让相当平静的阿提哈德周围的气氛变得清醒，但马雷斯卡将从他的球队将一场可能的溃败变成一场激动人心的巨人冲突中得到安慰。

paras.en: PSG come out on top in battle of recent winners
paras.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼在近期获胜者之战中拔得头筹

paras.en: As well as being two of the earliest clubs to fall foul of UEFA's financial rules back in 2014, Man City and PSG shared one other thing in common before combining to win three of the past four Champions League titles: They had won none of the previous 67.
paras.zh: 曼城和巴黎圣日耳曼不仅是2014年最早违反欧足联财务规定的两家具乐部，而且在过去四届欧冠冠军中三夺冠军之前，曼城和巴黎圣日耳曼还有一个共同点：在之前的67个冠军联赛中，他们都没有赢得过任何冠军。

paras.en: Each lost their first Champions League final - PSG to Bayern in 2020 and City the following year to Chelsea. But with both clubs backed by free-spending owners from the Middle East, boasting some of the most talented squads in world football, that deficiency has since become a surplus.
paras.zh: 双方都在欧冠决赛中首次失利——巴黎圣日尔曼在 2020 年输给了拜仁，次年曼城输给了切尔西。但由于两家具乐部都得到了来自中东挥金如土的老板的支持，并拥有一些世界足坛最有才华的球队，这种不足后来变成了盈余。

paras.en: With City now fighting against charges of financial rule-breaking on a domestic front, all of which the club deny, the decision was made for a show of unity on home turf. Guardiola was flanked by high-ranking executives in the terraces, including Chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak and chief executive Ferran Soriano.
paras.zh: 目前，曼城正在与国内方面违反财务规则的指控作斗争，但俱乐部否认了所有这些指控，因此做出这一决定是为了在主场表现出团结。瓜迪奥拉的两侧是看台上的高级管理人员，其中包括董事长哈尔杜恩·阿尔·穆巴拉克和首席执行官费兰·索里亚诺。

paras.en: They will have seen plenty they liked on the pitch, City's players appearing laser-focused on the job at hand despite the cloud of uncertainty that surrounds them. Ultimately, this is a defeat of fairly insignificant jeopardy where chances and goals made for a superb watch between two European contenders.
paras.zh: 他们会在球场上看到很多他们喜欢的东西，尽管周围充满了不确定性，曼城的球员们仍然专注于手头的工作。最终，这是一场相当微不足道的失败，机会和进球为两个欧洲竞争者之间的精彩比赛创造了机会。

paras.en: The world of football will continue to tune in to see how City handle whatever might come next. Whenever that might be.
paras.zh: 足球界将继续关注曼城如何应对接下来可能发生的一切。无论什么时候。

paras.en: Where do you start trying to make sense of that?
paras.zh: 你从哪里开始尝试理解这一点？

paras.en: Pep Guardiola was back for a bonkers night, with his former side showing plenty of the strengths and weaknesses that displayed themselves in different ways during his tenure. The City fightback at least means his visit won't be characterised by a humbling defeat.
paras.zh: 瓜迪奥拉回来度过了一个疯狂的夜晚，他的前球队在他的任期内以不同的方式展现了很多优点和缺点。曼城的反击至少意味着他的访问不会以惨败告终。

paras.en: PSG were the better side overall and deserved the win, but on another night the scoreline could have been reversed, given the number of chances that went begging for the home side.
paras.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼整体上表现更好，理应获胜，但在另一个晚上，考虑到主队获得的机会数量，比分可能会逆转。

paras.en: The City fans might not get to see their side in this competition next year, but as they made clear before kick-off, this is a fanbase that has stood by the club during dark times before, and is promising to do so again.
paras.zh: 曼城球迷可能无法在明年的比赛中看到自己的球队，但正如他们在开球前明确表示的那样，这是一个在过去的黑暗时期一直支持俱乐部的球迷群体，并承诺再次这样做。

paras.en: "It was a strange game. Two goals in two minutes created some problems for us. We were dead in the game, and then second half we created so many chances. Second half, we were good.
paras.zh: “这是一场奇怪的比赛。两分钟内的两个进球给我们带来了一些问题。我们在比赛中已经死了，然后下半场我们创造了很多机会。下半场，我们表现得很好。”

paras.en: "We lost a bit of balance, distance between players, and we struggle first half. Second half we made changes and adjusted some things, then we were much better. These kind of teams, if you don't go toe-to-toe you struggle. We had to be more brave. Second half, we were.
paras.zh: “我们失去了一点平衡，球员之间的距离，上半场我们很挣扎。下半场我们做出了改变，调整了一些东西，然后我们就好多了。这种球队，如果你不面对面，你就会陷入困境。我们必须更加勇敢。下半场，我们做到了。

paras.en: "We are there, to be honest. My feeling is that we are close. It's already difficult against PSG, but then you concede two quick goals. We can learn from that and move on."
paras.zh: “说实话，我们已经在那里了。我的感觉是我们已经很接近了。对阵巴黎圣日耳曼已经很困难了，但你很快就丢了两个球。我们可以从中吸取教训并继续前进。”

articles.title: Martinez releases statement to clarify outburst - but does not apologise

paras.en: Lisandro Martinez: Man Utd defender releases statement to clarify outburst but does not apologise
paras.zh: 利桑德罗·马丁内斯：曼联后卫发表声明澄清言论，但并未道歉

paras.en: Man Utd defender Lisandro Martinez called out the club's hierarchy after their Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid; Martinez said he had expected more from "upstairs", singling out technical director Jason Wilcox
paras.zh: 曼联后卫利桑德罗·马丁内斯在欧冠联赛输给马德里竞技后批评了俱乐部的等级制度；马丁内斯表示，他对“楼上”的期望更高，并特别提到了技术总监杰森·威尔科克斯(Jason Wilcox)

paras.en: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez has clarified his outburst after Tuesday's Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid in a statement - but stopped short of an apology.
paras.zh: 曼联后卫利桑德罗·马丁内斯在一份声明中澄清了他在周二欧冠输给马德里竞技后的愤怒情绪，但没有道歉。

paras.en: Martinez launched an extraordinary attack on the club's hierarchy after the 2-0 defeat in Madrid, as he criticised the lack of summer investment in the squad, said he expected more from "upstairs" and singled out technical director Jason Wilcox.
paras.zh: 在马德里0-2失利后，马丁内斯对俱乐部高层发起了非同寻常的攻击，他批评球队缺乏夏季投资，表示他对“楼上”的期望更高，并特别提到了技术总监贾森·威尔考克斯。

paras.en: But 24 hours on from his astonishing post-match interview, the Argentina international released a statement on Instagram on Wednesday night to clear up his comments.
paras.zh: 但在接受令人震惊的赛后采访 24 小时后，这位阿根廷国脚于周三晚上在 Instagram 上发表了一份声明，澄清了自己的言论。

paras.en: - Lisandro Martinez outburst Q&A: Wilcox, transfer strategy and what next
paras.zh: - 利桑德罗·马丁内斯爆发问答：威尔科克斯、转会策略和下一步

paras.en: - 'Awful' and 'disrespectful' - Carra and Rooney criticise Martinez outburst
paras.zh: - “糟糕”和“无礼” - 卡拉和鲁尼批评马丁内斯的爆发

paras.en: - Martinez's Man Utd future in doubt after comments
paras.zh: - 马丁内斯的曼联未来在评论后受到质疑

paras.en: He said: "Following everything that has been said about my comments yesterday, I want to share some thoughts on what I said and how I feel.
paras.zh: 他说：“继昨天关于我的言论的所有言论之后，我想分享一些关于我所说的话和我的感受的想法。

paras.en: "After the match, I spoke out of anger and frustration at not getting the result we all wanted.
paras.zh: “赛后，我出于愤怒和沮丧而发表了讲话，因为我没有得到我们都想要的结果。

paras.en: "Those who know me know how I live football, with passion, commitment and a huge desire to win. And when things don't go our way, it hurts, especially when representing a club with the history and stature of Manchester United.
paras.zh: “那些了解我的人都知道我如何生活在足球中，充满激情、奉献精神和对胜利的巨大渴望。当事情不按我们的意愿发展时，就会很痛苦，尤其是在代表一支拥有曼联历史和地位的俱乐部时。”

paras.en: "My words reflect how I feel and how much I want to see this club competing for the biggest honours. Those high standards are part of how I see football and the responsibility that comes with wearing this shirt.
paras.zh: “我的话反映了我的感受，以及我多么希望看到这家具乐部争夺最大的荣誉。这些高标准是我看待足球以及穿着这件球衣所带来的责任的一部分。

paras.en: "When I talk about wanting more, I'm talking about the ambition we must all have as part of this club. To keep growing, to become stronger and to have everything we need to compete at the highest level. These are standards we must all hold ourselves to, starting with me.
paras.zh: “当我谈到想要更多时，我指的是我们作为俱乐部的一部分必须拥有的雄心壮志。为了不断成长，变得更强大，并拥有我们在最高水平上竞争所需的一切。这些是我们所有人都必须遵守的标准，从我开始。”

paras.en: "I know that, first and foremost, it's us, the players, who have to deliver, and I put myself at the front of that responsibility. We need to demand even more of ourselves and work together to take Manchester United back to the top.
paras.zh: “我知道，首先也是最重要的是，我们，球员们，必须交付成果，我把自己置于这一责任的最前面。我们需要对自己提出更高的要求，共同努力，让曼联重回巅峰。”

paras.en: "I believe in my team-mates, our manager and everyone working to help this club move forward. I'm convinced that the way forward is to keep working together, with ambition and commitment.
paras.zh: “我相信我的队友、我们的主教练以及所有努力帮助俱乐部前进的人。我相信前进的道路是继续共同努力，充满雄心和承诺。”

paras.en: "My goal has been the same since day one, to win, to compete at the highest level and to give everything I have for this badge."
paras.zh: “从第一天起，我的目标就一直是一样的，那就是获胜，在最高水平上竞争，并为这枚徽章付出我所拥有的一切。”

paras.en: Sky Sports News' Football Correspondent Rob Dorsett:
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻的足球记者罗布·多塞特：

paras.en: There are real doubts about whether Martinez's contract will be extended when it expires in the summer.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯的合同在夏天到期后是否会续约，确实存在疑问。

paras.en: United will focus on revamping their defence in the next transfer windows and have the formal option to prolong Martinez's stay for a further year.
paras.zh: 曼联将在下一个转会窗口集中精力改进防守，并可以正式选择将马丁内斯的任期再延长一年。

paras.en: Sky Sports News has also been told United are looking at new centre-backs, as well as left-backs.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻还获悉，曼联正在寻找新的中后卫以及左后卫。

paras.en: United's bosses have yet to decide whether to discipline Martinez for his comments, when he said: "I expect more from our technical director [meaning director of football, Jason Wilcox]. We expect more from the top, from upstairs, to bring in more players to compete."
paras.zh: 曼联老板尚未决定是否对马丁内斯的言论进行纪律处分，他说：“我对我们的技术总监（即足球总监杰森·威尔考克斯）有更多期望。我们对高层、楼上有更多期望，以引进更多球员参加比赛。”

paras.en: Sky Sports News has been told there is anger and bemusement at what Martinez said, both in the United boardroom and in the changing room, with at least one other player challenging him over his comments as the squad got on board the plane to fly back to Manchester.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻获悉，在曼联董事会和更衣室里，人们对马丁内斯的言论感到愤怒和困惑，当球队登上返回曼彻斯特的飞机时，至少有一名其他球员对他的言论提出质疑。

paras.en: It is also understood that there is no pressure on Wilcox internally regarding his position.
paras.zh: 据了解，威尔科克斯内部并没有就其职位受到任何压力。

paras.en: The implication that Martinez doesn't think his team-mates are good enough to compete has not gone down well with other players.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯认为他的队友不足以参加比赛的暗示并没有得到其他球员的认可。

paras.en: Martinez has been keen on a move away from Old Trafford for some time.
paras.zh: 一段时间以来，马丁内斯一直渴望离开老特拉福德。

paras.en: In the summer, he pushed for a move to Atletico Madrid, the side that beat United in the Champions League on Tuesday night, to follow his good friend and international team-mate, Cristian Romero, who left Spurs for Spain.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，他推动转会到马德里竞技队，这支球队在周二晚上的冠军联赛中击败了曼联，跟随他的好朋友兼国家队队友克里斯蒂安·罗梅罗离开热刺前往西班牙。

paras.en: No suitable bid for Martinez came in for Manchester United to consider.
paras.zh: 曼联没有考虑对马丁内斯的合适报价。

paras.en: The 28-year-old made similar explosive comments about his bosses when at Ajax in 2022. Martinez, who again wanted a move away, called their sporting director Gerry Hamstra a "nobody".
paras.zh: 这位 28 岁的球员在 2022 年效力阿贾克斯时也对他的老板发表了类似的爆炸性评论。再次想要离开的马丁内斯称他们的体育总监格里·哈姆斯特拉是“无名之辈”。

paras.en: Martinez remains a key part of Michael Carrick's squad and United's bosses know they have to handle this situation carefully.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯仍然是迈克尔·卡里克球队的关键一员，曼联的老板们知道他们必须谨慎处理这种情况。

articles.title: NT Labor backflips, supports 'hyper-scale' data centre moratorium
articles.author: Jack Hislop

paras.en: Territory Labor backflips, supports 'hyper-scale' data centre moratorium
paras.zh: 北领地工党反悔，支持暂停“超大规模”数据中心

paras.en: The Territory Labor opposition says a moratorium on "hyper-scale" data centres should be imposed until July next year, while a review into them is undertaken.
paras.zh: 北领地工党反对派表示，应在明年 7 月之前暂停建设“超大规模”数据中心，同时对其进行审查。

paras.en: Labor had previously only called for a review into "current and future" data centre developments and said a moratorium was unnecessary.
paras.zh: 工党此前仅呼吁对“当前和未来”数据中心的发展进行审查，并表示没有必要暂停。

paras.en: The opposition called for the hyper-scale moratorium in parliament yesterday, after an independent moved a motion for a moratorium on "all AI data centre developments".
paras.zh: 昨天，在一名独立人士提出暂停“所有人工智能数据中心开发”的动议后，反对派呼吁议会大规模暂停。

articles.title: Expert says trust use to avoid tax 'bordering on a joke'
articles.author: Liana Walker

paras.en: Small business advocates say tax reforms that would see a 30 per cent minimum tax on discretionary trusts are a "kick in the gut" and another cost for tradies.
paras.zh: 小企业倡导者表示，税收改革将对全权信托征收最低 30% 的税，这对商人来说是一种“打击”，也是另一项成本。

paras.en: One expert says the way discretionary trusts are being used to offset tax bills is "bordering on a joke".
paras.zh: 一位专家表示，利用全权信托来抵消税款的方式“近乎开玩笑”。

paras.en: If the bill passes, the reforms would come into effect in July 2028.
paras.zh: 如果该法案获得通过，改革将于 2028 年 7 月生效。

paras.en: Small business advocates say it is a misconception that trusts are only used by wealthy families to minimise tax, but one expert says the current system is "bordering on a joke" and in urgent need of reform.
paras.zh: 小企业倡导者表示，认为信托只是富裕家庭用来最小化税收的一种误解，但一位专家表示，现行制度“近乎笑话”，迫切需要改革。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Treasurer Jim Chalmers introduced a bill that would impose a 30 per cent minimum tax on discretionary trusts starting July 2028 to try to discourage people and businesses from using the arrangement to minimise taxable income.
paras.zh: 周三，财政部长 Jim Chalmers 提出了一项法案，将从 2028 年 7 月开始对全权信托征收 30% 的最低税，以阻止个人和企业利用这一安排来最大限度地减少应税收入。

paras.en: Discretionary trusts differ from other types of trusts as they allow the trustees to change beneficiaries and how much they receive each year.
paras.zh: 全权信托与其他类型的信托不同，因为它们允许受托人改变受益人以及每年收到的金额。

paras.en: Associate Professor Dale Boccabella from the University of New South Wales's Business School of Accounting, Auditing and Taxation told The Business some trusts were being used to distribute income in a way to offset tax bills.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士大学会计、审计和税务商学院的副教授戴尔·博卡贝拉 (Dale Boccabella) 告诉《商业报》，一些信托被用来分配收入，以抵消税款。

paras.en: "A 17-year-old beneficiary of a discretionary trust, not allocated anything for years and years, and all of a sudden they turn 18, this is a child of the parents, and they get $22,500. Now why do they get $22,500 allocated? It's tax-free. It's under the effective tax-free threshold.
paras.zh: “一个全权信托的17岁受益人，多年来没有分配任何东西，突然间他们就满了18岁，这是父母的孩子，他们得到了22,500美元。现在为什么他们会得到22,500美元的分配？这是免税的。它在有效的免税门槛之下。

paras.en: "In a discretionary trust, you can have a two-day-old baby born on the 28th of June being allocated $22,500. I mean, you can see how silly it is."
paras.zh: “在全权信托中，你可以为 6 月 28 日出生两天的婴儿分配 22,500 美元。我的意思是，你可以看到这有多么愚蠢。”

paras.en: He said in some cases, the income allocated did not get paid to the children and stayed with the parents.
paras.zh: 他说，在某些情况下，分配的收入并没有支付给孩子，而是留在父母那里。

paras.en: The treasurer said the reforms would affect less than 10 per cent of small businesses; however, Housing Industry Association managing director Jocelyn Martin said there were costs beyond the tax changes.
paras.zh: 财务主管表示，改革将影响不到 10% 的小企业；然而，住房行业协会董事总经理乔斯林·马丁表示，除了税收变化之外，还有其他成本。

paras.en: "Even before they know whether that structure is going to impact them, they have to seek advice from their lawyer or their accountant, and our members are saying that that could cost anywhere between $10,000 and $25,000," she said.
paras.zh: “即使在他们知道这种结构是否会对他们产生影响之前，他们也必须寻求律师或会计师的建议，我们的成员表示，这可能会花费 10,000 至 25,000 美元，”她说。

paras.en: "It's not enough to say that these changes just impact a small proportion; they impact a large proportion.
paras.zh: “仅仅说这些变化只影响一小部分是不够的；它们影响很大一部分。

paras.en: "Maybe the result might be that they don't have to restructure, but they need to do the work to find out whether that's what's going to happen or not."
paras.zh: “也许结果可能是他们不必重组，但他们需要做一些工作来看看这是否会发生。”

paras.en: More than 1 million trusts are operating in Australia, with about 84 per cent of them discretionary.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚有超过 100 万个信托在运营，其中约 84% 是全权信托。

paras.en: The number of discretionary trusts has doubled since 2001–02.
paras.zh: 自 2001 年 2 月以来，全权信托的数量翻了一番。

paras.en: About one in six small businesses used discretionary trusts in 2022-23, the last year of available data, with Treasury analysis suggesting 140,000 businesses of an estimated 350,000 would not need to pay the new tax.
paras.zh: 2022-23 年（现有数据的最后一年），大约六分之一的小型企业使用了全权信托，财政部分析表明，估计有 35 万家企业中的 14 万家企业不需要缴纳新税。

paras.en: Ms Martin said about three in five small businesses in the housing industry used a trust structure.
paras.zh: 马丁女士说，住房行业中大约五分之三的小企业使用信托结构。

paras.en: "I think there's an assumption that a trust structure is just something that wealthy people use to avoid or minimise taxes," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为有一种假设，即信托结构只是富人用来避税或最小化税收的东西，”她说。

paras.en: "What we see are small businesses that are using the legitimate structure of a trust to manage their business, manage the cycles, the cash flow cycles, to actually pay themselves in a lot of instances as well, because some of our members have said they will pay themselves in good times and not necessarily be able to in bad times," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们看到的是，小企业正在利用合法的信托结构来管理其业务、管理周期、现金流周期，在很多情况下也能实际支付自己的费用，因为我们的一些成员表示，他们会在经济好的时候支付自己的费用，而在经济不景气的时候不一定能够支付。”

paras.en: Questioned on how much tax tradies currently pay, given that the proposed change introduces a 30 per cent minimum, Ms Martin said the HIA's concern was that the change was an additional cost to residential construction.
paras.zh: 当被问及拟议的改革引入了 30% 的最低税率后，目前技工要缴纳多少税款时，Martin 女士表示，HIA 担心这一变化会给住宅建设带来额外成本。

paras.en: "Already we know that the tax that is paid by our residential businesses is extremely high," she said.
paras.zh: “我们已经知道，我们的住宅企业缴纳的税款非常高，”她说。

paras.en: "But not just that, the cost that they pay to comply with some of these business measures is also escalating all the time.
paras.zh: “但不仅如此，他们为遵守其中一些商业措施而支付的成本也在不断上升。

paras.en: "So I think our concern really when we say there's another tax on tradies is really it's just another kick in the gut."
paras.zh: “所以我认为，当我们说对技工征收另一项税时，我们真正担心的是，这实际上只是又一击。”

paras.en: Asset protection or 'economic injustice'?
paras.zh: 资产保护还是“经济不公正”？

paras.en: Dr Boccabella said other features promoted by accountants such as asset protection, flexibility and succession planning were not being changed as part of the government's plan, although he believed they probably should be overhauled.
paras.zh: 博卡贝拉博士表示，会计师提倡的其他功能，如资产保护、灵活性和继任计划，作为政府计划的一部分并没有改变，尽管他认为这些功能可能应该进行彻底改革。

paras.en: "The other thing with discretionary trusts is that you can set them up so that they have limited liability, a bit like a company," he said.
paras.zh: “全权信托的另一件事是，你可以设立它们，使它们承担有限责任，有点像公司，”他说。

paras.en: "If the small business and discretionary trust fails, you might actually end up with creditors not getting their payment.
paras.zh: “如果小企业和全权信托失败，实际上最终可能会导致债权人拿不到付款。

paras.en: "You can call that asset protection if you want, but a lot of people would turn around and say, 'Well, isn't that economic injustice, someone not getting paid for their services and goods supplied?'"
paras.zh: “如果你愿意的话，你可以称之为资产保护，但很多人会转而说，‘好吧，这不是经济不公正吗？有人因为提供的服务和商品而得不到报酬？’”

paras.en: Property Council executive director of capital markets, Torie Brown, said the government had ignored the legitimate concerns raised by industry during an expedited consultation process.
paras.zh: 房地产委员会资本市场执行董事托里·布朗(Torie Brown)表示，政府在快速咨询过程中忽视了行业提出的合理担忧。

paras.en: "Industry was given almost no time to consider how these radical changes will affect their businesses. Despite the warnings from industry, the government had decided to push ahead and introduce this legislation anyway," he said.
paras.zh: “业界几乎没有时间考虑这些根本性的变化将如何影响他们的业务。尽管业界发出警告，但政府还是决定推进并引入这项立法，”他说。

paras.en: "Changes to trusts is incredibly complex — pulling one thread unravels another. The government announced these changes without considering the impacts they would have on small business and housing supply."
paras.zh: “信托的改变非常复杂——牵一发而动全身。政府宣布这些改变时没有考虑它们对小企业和住房供应的影响。”

paras.en: There are also concerns that restructuring trusts would incur stamp duty at a state or territory level, something the New South Wales government has promised to waive if re-elected next year.
paras.zh: 还有人担心重组信托会在州或领地层面产生印花税，新南威尔士州政府已承诺如果明年连任将免除印花税。

paras.en: The Australian Council of Social Services (ACOSS) welcomed the changes, with CEO Cassandra Goldie saying the current system was being exploited.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚社会服务委员会（ACOSS）对这些变化表示欢迎，首席执行官卡桑德拉·戈尔迪（Cassandra Goldie）表示，当前的系统正在被利用。

paras.en: "It is not fair that someone earning $200,000 or more, who would usually pay 47 per cent tax on extra income, can bring that rate down to 30 per cent or less by passing income through a discretionary trust to their adult children or a private company, while an average worker pays tax at a rate of 30 per cent of the next dollar earned," Dr Goldie said.
paras.zh: 戈尔迪博士说：“收入在 20 万美元或以上的人通常要为额外收入缴纳 47% 的税，但通过全权信托将收入转移给成年子女或私人公司，可以将税率降至 30% 或更低，而普通工人则按下一美元收入的 30% 税率纳税，这是不公平的。”

paras.en: "This reform helps fix this severe unfairness in the system so people on higher incomes contribute according to their ability to pay."
paras.zh: “这项改革有助于解决系统中这种严重的不公平现象，因此收入较高的人可以根据自己的支付能力进行缴款。”

articles.title: Ferry fight heads to court as Kangaroo Island shutdown confirmed
articles.author: Caroline Horn

paras.en: Sealink has launched legal action to have the second of two Kangaroo Island ferries delivered to Australia.
paras.zh: Sealink 已采取法律行动，要求将两艘袋鼠岛渡轮中的第二艘交付澳大利亚。

paras.en: The chairman of the company contracted to deliver the ferry says he is surprised at the action.
paras.zh: 负责交付渡轮的公司董事长表示，他对这一行动感到惊讶。

paras.en: The first of the new ferries will start operating later this month in conjunction with one of the older boats.
paras.zh: 第一艘新渡轮将于本月晚些时候与其中一艘旧船一起开始运营。

paras.en: The operators of the Kangaroo Island Ferry have launched legal action to have the second of two new ferries delivered to Australia from a shipyard in Indonesia.
paras.zh: 袋鼠岛渡轮的运营商已采取法律行动，要求从印度尼西亚造船厂向澳大利亚交付两艘新渡轮中的第二艘。

paras.en: Sealink has a contract with the state government to provide ferry services to Kangaroo Island until at least 2039.
paras.zh: Sealink 与州政府签订了一份合同，至少在 2039 年之前提供前往袋鼠岛的渡轮服务。

paras.en: Two larger ferries providing 150 metres of additional vehicle space were contracted to be built in a shipyard in Batam, Indonesia and were initially expected to be in service by early 2025.
paras.zh: 两艘提供 150 米额外车辆空间的大型渡轮已签约在印度尼西亚巴淡岛的一家造船厂建造，最初预计将于 2025 年初投入使用。

paras.en: After a series of delays, the first of the new ferries arrived in Port Adelaide in April 2026.
paras.zh: 经过一系列延误后，第一批新渡轮于 2026 年 4 月抵达阿德莱德港。

paras.en: In a media statement published yesterday, Sealink said it had commenced proceedings in the Federal Court admiralty jurisdiction against Sea Transport SA Pty Ltd, the company contracted to supply the second ferry, seeking orders that it be delivered.
paras.zh: Sealink 在昨天发布的一份媒体声明中表示，它已在联邦法院海事管辖权中对 Sea Transport SA Pty Ltd（该公司承包供应第二艘渡轮）提起诉讼，寻求交付命令。

paras.en: Sea Transport founder and chairman Stuart Ballantyne said he was limited in what he could say.
paras.zh: Sea Transport 创始人兼董事长斯图尔特·巴兰坦 (Stuart Ballantyne) 表示，他能说的有限。

paras.en: "Sealink basically cancelled the contract when we were about 99 per cent of the point of getting it out of the shipyard and starting the delivery to Adelaide, which surprised us," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“当我们将其从造船厂运出并开始交付到阿德莱德的时间已完成约 99% 时，Sealink 基本上取消了合同，这让我们感到惊讶。”

paras.en: "But they've taken it legal and when you cancel a contract, we've just had to bow back and wait for the legal people to sort it out."
paras.zh: “但他们认为这是合法的，当你取消合同时，我们只能低头等待法律人员来解决。”

paras.en: Mr Ballantyne said his company was being as cooperative as possible.
paras.zh: 巴兰坦先生表示，他的公司正在尽可能地合作。

paras.en: "When somebody decides to sue you, that's their choice," he said.
paras.zh: “当有人决定起诉你时，那是他们的选择，”他说。

paras.en: The first of the ferries currently berthed in Port Adelaide will commence service later this month, although in conjunction with one of the old ferries.
paras.zh: 目前停泊在阿德莱德港的第一艘渡轮将于本月晚些时候开始服务，但与其中一艘旧渡轮结合使用。

paras.en: To allow this to happen, all ferry services will be halted for three days next week so new vehicle ramps can be installed at the terminals at Cape Jervis and Penneshaw.
paras.zh: 为了实现这一目标，所有渡轮服务将于下周暂停三天，以便在杰维斯角和彭尼肖的码头安装新的车辆坡道。

paras.en: One of the old ferries will then resume a limited service for the next three to four days while the new ferry undergoes testing and staff training is carried out.
paras.zh: 其中一艘旧渡轮将在接下来的三到四天内恢复有限的服务，同时新渡轮将接受测试并进行员工培训。

paras.en: The new and old ferry will then continue to run together until the second of the new ferries is delivered.
paras.zh: 新旧渡轮将继续一起运行，直到第二艘新渡轮交付为止。

paras.en: Agriculture Kangaroo Island chair Peter Cooper said the shutdown and changeover would be disruptive to the island's farmers but "had to happen at some time".
paras.zh: 袋鼠岛农业主席彼得·库珀表示，关闭和转换将对岛上的农民造成干扰，但“必须在某个时候发生”。

paras.en: Producers are currently moving large volumes of lambs, grain and other crops to the mainland for sale.
paras.zh: 生产商目前正在将大量羔羊肉、谷物和其他农作物运往大陆出售。

paras.en: Mr Cooper said discussions with Sealink had taken place and they had agreed to "additional freight runs" to clear any backlog after next week's shutdown.
paras.zh: 库珀表示，已经与 Sealink 进行了讨论，他们同意“增加货运量”，以清除下周停工后的积压货物。

paras.en: Kangaroo Island Mayor Michael Pengilly said the ferry was a lifeline for islanders and it was peak livestock season for farmers.
paras.zh: 袋鼠岛市长迈克尔·彭吉利 (Michael Pengilly) 表示，渡轮是岛民的生命线，现在正是农民的牲畜旺季。

paras.en: "If they end up only having one boat running for a while, I'd like to see it running 24 hours a day if necessary," he said.
paras.zh: “如果他们最终只有一艘船运行一段时间，如有必要，我希望看到它每天 24 小时运行，”他说。

paras.en: SA Transport Minister Joe Szakacs said Sealink had now failed to reach a number of deadlines and the company had "severely let down" islanders and the government.
paras.zh: 南澳交通部长 Joe Szakacs 表示，Sealink 目前未能在多个最后期限内完成任务，该公司“严重让”岛民和政府失望。

paras.en: He called on the company to "do better" and said it had agreed to immediately implement vehicle fare reductions for Kangaroo Islanders that had been promised once both ferries were in place.
paras.zh: 他呼吁该公司“做得更好”，并表示公司已同意立即为袋鼠岛居民实施车辆票价减免，这是在两艘渡轮到位后所承诺的。

paras.en: The matter between Sealink SA Ferry Services SA and Sea Transport SA Pty Ltd is due to return to the Federal Court on November 13.
paras.zh: Sealink SA Ferry Services SA 和 Sea Transport SA Pty Ltd 之间的纠纷将于 11 月 13 日返回联邦法院。

articles.title: What to know about the deadly U.K. tiger attack — and the 'offensive' video shared by Trump
articles.author: Natalie Stechyson

paras.en: What to know about the deadly U.K. tiger attack — and the 'offensive' video shared by Trump
paras.zh: 关于英国致命的老虎袭击事件以及特朗普分享的“攻击性”视频，您需要了解什么

paras.en: Family urges people to stop sharing clip of William Chapman's fatal encounter with Amur tiger at wildlife park
paras.zh: 家人敦促人们停止分享威廉·查普曼在野生动物园与东北虎遭遇致命事件的视频

paras.en: The family of a man mauled to death by a tiger at a U.K. wildlife park on Saturday is pleading with people to stop sharing footage of the attack online, calling it "deeply offensive" and painful.
paras.zh: 周六，一名在英国野生动物园被老虎咬死的男子的家人恳求人们停止在网上分享这次袭击的视频，称其“非常无礼”且令人痛苦。

paras.en: The statement from the family of 23-year-old William Chapman came after U.S. President Donald Trump shared a clip of the fatal attack on his Truth Social platform Tuesday, writing "don't ever mess with nature!"
paras.zh: 23 岁的威廉·查普曼 (William Chapman) 的家人发表声明之前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 周二在他的真相社交平台上分享了一段致命袭击的片段，并写道“永远不要扰乱自然！”

paras.en: The 41-second video shared by Trump shows a large tiger repeatedly biting and clawing at Chapman. Trump's post was then shared by the White House's Rapid Response account on X, where commenters called it "sick" and "disgusting."
paras.zh: 特朗普分享的这段41秒的视频显示，一只大老虎反复撕咬查普曼。特朗普的帖子随后被 X 上的白宫快速反应账户分享，评论者称其“恶心”和“恶心”。

paras.en: The U.S. president later posted an apparently AI-generated video depicting himself taming a tiger and then playing with it, accompanied by the song The Lion Sleeps Tonight.
paras.zh: 美国总统后来发布了一段显然是人工智能生成的视频，视频中他驯​​服了一只老虎，然后与它玩耍，并配上了歌曲《狮子今晚睡觉》。

paras.en: His social media posts have sparked outrage, but they have also raised questions about how the tragedy happened.
paras.zh: 他的社交媒体帖子引发了愤怒，但也引发了人们对悲剧如何发生的疑问。

paras.en: Here's what we know about the tiger attack and the man who died.
paras.zh: 以下是我们对老虎袭击事件和死者的了解。

paras.en: The attack happened on Saturday in a tiger enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park near Doncaster in northern England.
paras.zh: 这起袭击事件于周六发生在英格兰北部唐卡斯特附近的约克郡野生动物公园的一个老虎围栏内。

paras.en: The popular conservation and welfare park opened in 2009. The "Land of the Tigers" area opened in 2011, "where the majestic big cats can freely roaming their woodlands and grasslands or play in their very own waterfall pool," the park explains on its website.
paras.zh: 这个颇受欢迎的保护和福利公园于 2009 年开业。“老虎之地”区域于 2011 年开业，公园在其网站上解释道，“威严的大型猫科动物可以在这里自由地漫步在林地和草原上，或者在自己的瀑布池中玩耍。”

paras.en: It features a 300-metre-long raised walkway for spectators.
paras.zh: 它设有一条 300 米长的高架走道供观众使用。

paras.en: BBC News reports that emergency services were called to the park in the early afternoon Saturday for reports that a man had climbed into the tiger enclosure from a high walkway. Witnesses told multiple U.K. media outlets that the tiger had been lounging on a ledge until the man entered.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司新闻报道，周六下午早些时候，紧急服务人员接到报告称一名男子从高处的走道爬进了老虎的围栏。目击者告诉多家英国媒体，老虎一直懒洋洋地躺在壁架上，直到该男子进入。

paras.en: "The tiger got alerted. He went into stalk mode. The tiger came flying off the ledge and approached him," a witness told The Telegraph.
paras.zh: 一名目击者告诉《每日电讯报》：“老虎收到了警报。他进入了跟踪模式。老虎从窗台上飞下来并向他靠近。”

paras.en: Witnesses reportedly tried to distract the tiger, shouting at it and banging on the fence, as the animal pawed and nipped at the man. Videos posted online appear to show the man pointing at the tiger, yelling "stop" and "no."
paras.zh: 据报道，目击者试图分散老虎的注意力，对它大喊大叫，并敲打栅栏，而老虎则用爪子咬该男子。网上发布的视频似乎显示，该男子指着老虎，大喊“停止”和“不”。

paras.en: - Photos Image of mournful elephant mom wins 2026 Wildlife Photographer of the Year
paras.zh: - 悲伤的大象妈妈的照片荣获 2026 年度野生动物摄影师奖

paras.en: - 'He was fighting,' says mother of western Manitoba man killed in animal attack
paras.zh: - 在动物袭击中丧生的马尼托巴省西部男子的母亲说，“他在打架”

paras.en: Staff reportedly erected screens to block the view as emergency services responded.
paras.zh: 据报道，当紧急服务部门做出反应时，工作人员竖起了屏幕来阻挡视线。

paras.en: In a Facebook post, South Yorkshire Police confirmed that "despite the best efforts of medical personnel, the man was pronounced dead at the scene." The park was then evacuated, police said, adding there was no risk to the public.
paras.zh: 南约克郡警方在脸书上发帖证实，“尽管医务人员尽了最大努力，该男子还是在现场被宣布死亡。”警方表示，公园随后被疏散，并补充说，公众没有面临风险。

paras.en: Yorkshire Wildlife Park was closed and has yet to reopen to the public. The park is "working closely with the authorities," it notes on its website.
paras.zh: 约克郡野生动物园已关闭，尚未向公众重新开放。该公园在其网站上指出，正在“与当局密切合作”。

paras.en: A coroner's inquest is scheduled to begin Thursday, reports the Doncaster Free Press.
paras.zh: 据唐卡斯特自由报报道，验尸官定于周四开始调查。

paras.en: William Chapman in an undated photo posted to Facebook by South Yorkshire Police on Wednesday. (South Yorkshire Police/Facebook)
paras.zh: 周三，南约克郡警方在 Facebook 上发布了威廉·查普曼 (William Chapman) 的一张未注明日期的照片。 （南约克郡警方/脸书）

paras.en: Chapman, 23, was a former child actor, according to the BBC. The outlet notes he appeared in the 2009 ITV production May Contain Nuts and the 2012 BBC series True Stories.
paras.zh: 据 BBC 报道，23 岁的查普曼曾是一名儿童演员。该媒体指出，他出现在 2009 年 ITV 制作的 May Contain Nuts 和 2012 年 BBC 系列剧集 True Stories 中。

paras.en: The Jackie Palmer Stage School in High Wycombe shared a tribute to Chapman on Facebook Tuesday, noting he was a former student.
paras.zh: 海威科姆的杰基·帕尔默舞台学校周二在 Facebook 上向查普曼致敬，并指出他曾是一名学生。

paras.en: "We loved watching William grow, both as a person and as a performer, during his time with us," the school posted.
paras.zh: 学校发帖称：“我们喜欢看着威廉在我们身边成长，无论是作为一个人还是作为一个表演者。”

paras.en: "It was a privilege to be part of his journey, and he will be remembered with great fondness by everyone who had the pleasure of knowing him."
paras.zh: “能够成为他旅程的一部分是一种荣幸，每个有幸认识他的人都会怀念他。”

paras.en: Chapman's family described him as a "bright, warm and engaging young man whom his family dearly loved" in a statement shared by South Yorkshire Police.
paras.zh: 南约克郡警方分享的一份声明中，查普曼的家人形容他是一个“聪明、热情、迷人的年轻人，深受家人的喜爱”。

paras.en: "Sadly, William suffered from significant mental illness over a number of years and was consequently prescribed strong medication," the family added.
paras.zh: “可悲的是，威廉多年来患有严重的精神疾病，因此需要服用强效药物，”家人补充道。

paras.en: The statement said it was for the coroner to determine whether his medical history played a role in his death.
paras.zh: 声明称，验尸官将确定他的病史是否与他的死亡有关。

paras.en: "The family are hopeful that the relevant authorities will do their utmost to get to the bottom of why our amazing son did what he did."
paras.zh: “家人希望有关当局能够尽最大努力查明为什么我们了不起的儿子会做出这样的事。”

paras.en: A Facebook tribute to William Chapman posted by the Jackie Palmer Stage School and Agency on Tuesday. (Jackie Palmer Stage School and Agency/Facebook)
paras.zh: 周二，杰基·帕尔默舞台学校和机构在 Facebook 上发布了向威廉·查普曼致敬的内容。 （杰基·帕尔默舞台学校和机构/Facebook）

paras.en: A witness told the Daily Mail that Chapman had been "dancing his way up and down the bridge with his AirPods in" before asking her to take a photo of him. Witnesses told the Telegraph that, shortly after, another woman tried to stop Chapman from jumping in but he overpowered her.
paras.zh: 一名目击者告诉《每日邮报》，查普曼“戴着 AirPods 在桥上跳舞”，然后要求她给他拍张照片。目击者告诉《每日电讯报》，不久之后，另一名女子试图阻止查普曼跳入水中，但他制服了她。

paras.en: Witnesses described Chapman acting "in a trance" in the enclosure, sometimes dancing with his phone out.
paras.zh: 目击者称查普曼在围场内“神情恍惚”，有时会拿出手机跳舞。

paras.en: Several U.K. media outlets reported that he uploaded a video of himself approaching the tiger in the enclosure to his Instagram account moments before he was attacked. His account has since been made private.
paras.zh: 几家英国媒体报道称，在遭到袭击之前，他将一段自己接近围栏内老虎的视频上传到了自己的 Instagram 账户上。他的帐户此后已设为私人帐户。

paras.en: "He had arms wide open ready for the tiger to attack him. It was quite bad. We were just stood there, frozen… the last thing we saw was the tiger’s jaw on his neck," Scarlet Hogan, 21, told the Telegraph.
paras.zh: 21 岁的斯嘉丽·霍根 (Scarlet Hogan) 告诉《每日电讯报》：“他张开双臂，准备让老虎攻击他。这太糟糕了。我们呆呆地站在那里……我们最后看到的就是老虎的下巴压在他脖子上。”

paras.en: Observers online have pointed out that in the videos circulating online, Chapman appears to clench both fists with his little fingers pointing out. They suggest this may be the sign for "bad" in Makaton, an alternative form of sign language for people with limited speech.
paras.zh: 网上观察人士指出，在网上流传的视频中，查普曼似乎握紧了双拳，小指朝外。他们认为，这可能是 Makaton 语中“坏”的意思，Makaton 是言语能力有限的人的另一种手语形式。

paras.en: A photo of William Chapman posted by South Yorkshire Mayor Oliver Coppard on Wednesday. (Oliver Coppard/Facebook)
paras.zh: 周三，南约克郡市长奥利弗·科帕德发布了威廉·查普曼的照片。 （奥利弗·科帕德/脸书）

paras.en: The tiger involved in the attack, named Altai, is "safe and well" and will not be euthanized, the park said in a statement posted on Instagram on Sunday.
paras.zh: 该公园周日在 Instagram 上发布的一份声明中表示，参与此次袭击的老虎阿尔泰“安全且健康”，不会被安乐死。

paras.en: The tigers at Yorkshire Wildlife Park are all endangered Amur tigers, also known as Siberian tigers. They're the largest big cats in the world.
paras.zh: 约克郡野生动物园的老虎都是濒临灭绝的东北虎，又称西伯利亚虎。它们是世界上最大的大型猫科动物。

paras.en: An animal ranger at the park quoted by the Telegraph said it wasn't the tiger's fault, and that to the animal, Chapman was "just something else to play with."
paras.zh: 《每日电讯报》援引公园里的一名动物护林员的话说，这不是老虎的错，对于老虎来说，查普曼“只是别的玩物”。

paras.en: "The keepers are all distraught," she added.
paras.zh: “饲养员们都心烦意乱，”她补充道。

paras.en: The park welcomed Altai in a 2025 Instagram post, saying he had just arrived from a zoo in Norway.
paras.zh: 公园在 2025 年的 Instagram 帖子中欢迎阿尔泰，称他刚刚从挪威的动物园抵达。

paras.en: An Instagram post by Yorkshire Wildlife Park from 2025 shows Altai, the Amur tiger that mauled a man in an enclosure on Saturday. (Yorkshire Wildlife Park/Instagram)
paras.zh: 约克郡野生动物公园在 2025 年发布的 Instagram 帖子显示，周六，阿穆尔虎在围栏内咬伤了一名男子。 （约克郡野生动物园/Instagram）

paras.en: Trump has not offered an explanation for his posts about Chapman.
paras.zh: 特朗普没有对其有关查普曼的帖子做出解释。

paras.en: The U.S. president regularly uses social media to make commentary and share AI-generated images and videos. In April, for instance, Trump posted an image that appeared to depict himself as Jesus.
paras.zh: 美国总统经常使用社交媒体发表评论并分享人工智能生成的图像和视频。例如，四月份，特朗普发布了一张似乎将自己描绘成耶稣的图片。

paras.en: Chapman's family, in their statement, asked people to "please stop" sharing footage.
paras.zh: 查普曼的家人在声明中要求人们“请停止”分享视频。

paras.en: "The family are utterly devastated by their loss and are struggling to come to terms with what has happened," the family said.
paras.zh: 家人表示：“他们的家人因失去亲人而悲痛欲绝，正在努力接受所发生的事情。”

paras.en: "The publication and circulation of deeply offensive media content is causing them severe distress at an exceptionally vulnerable time."
paras.zh: “在极其脆弱的时期，极具攻击性的媒体内容的出版和传播给他们带来了严重的痛苦。”

paras.en: South Yorkshire Mayor Oliver Coppard was among those to condemn Trump's posts.
paras.zh: 南约克郡市长奥利弗·科帕德是谴责特朗普帖子的人之一。

paras.en: "The President of the United States now using AI to mock that incident and the pain felt by the family … for little more than a cheap laugh on social media, should be greeted with the contempt it deserves," Coppard wrote on Facebook on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 科帕德周三在 Facebook 上写道：“美国总统现在使用人工智能来嘲笑这一事件以及家人所感受到的痛苦......只不过是在社交媒体上进行廉价的嘲笑，应该受到应有的蔑视。”

paras.en: As of Wednesday, videos of the attack were still being shared across social media platforms including X, Threads and TikTok. The video shared on X by the White House had been viewed around 2.5 million times.
paras.zh: 截至周三，攻击视频仍在 X、Threads 和 TikTok 等社交媒体平台上分享。白宫在 X 上分享的视频浏览量约为 250 万次。

paras.en: CBC News has contacted X to ask whether it will be removing videos that show the attack, but has yet to hear back.
paras.zh: CBC News 已联系 X 询问是否会删除显示攻击的视频，但尚未收到回复。

articles.title: Police investigating report of sexual assault at University of Chicago frat party

paras.en: Police investigating report of sexual assault at University of Chicago frat party
paras.zh: 警方正在调查芝加哥大学兄弟会聚会上的性侵犯报告

paras.en: University says person of interest has been identified in alleged assault at Alpha Epsilon Pi fraternity
paras.zh: 大学表示，已确定涉嫌袭击 Alpha Epsilon Pi 兄弟会的嫌疑人

paras.en: Police are investigating a woman's report that she was sexually assaulted during a fraternity party near the University of Chicago campus, an allegation that comes at a time of heightened awareness of sexual violence on college campuses.
paras.zh: 警方正在调查一名妇女的报告，称她在芝加哥大学校园附近的兄弟会聚会上遭到性侵犯，这一指控是在大学校园对性暴力的认识不断提高之际提出的。

paras.en: Chicago police said no one had been charged Wednesday, a day after university officials posted an alert saying that a person of interest had been identified.
paras.zh: 芝加哥警方周三表示，没有人受到指控，一天前，大学官员发布警报称已发现一名感兴趣的人。

paras.en: The Chicago case comes amid an uproar over Cornell University 's handling of a woman's allegations that she was drugged and gang raped by fraternity members in 2024. A campus investigation led to internal disciplinary action by the university, but no criminal charges were ever filed.
paras.zh: 芝加哥案件发生之际，康奈尔大学对一名妇女指控她在 2024 年被兄弟会成员下药和轮奸的处理方式引起轩然大波。校园调查导致该大学采取内部纪律行动，但从未提出刑事指控。

paras.en: The University of Chicago, a top-ranked U.S. research school with an enrollment of 18,000 students, said in a statement that a woman reported being sexually assaulted early Sunday during a party at the Alpha Epsilon Pi fraternity house.
paras.zh: 拥有 18,000 名学生的美国顶级研究型大学芝加哥大学在一份声明中表示，周日早些时候，一名女子报告在 Alpha Epsilon Pi 兄弟会会所的一次聚会上遭到性侵犯。

paras.en: The university said the perpetrator fled the house after being confronted by another person.
paras.zh: 该大学表示，肇事者在与另一个人发生冲突后逃离了房子。

paras.en: The AEPi fraternity house near the University of Chicago campus, where an alleged sexual assault was reported at a weekend party. (Nam Y. Huh/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 芝加哥大学校园附近的 AEPi 兄弟会会所，据报道在周末聚会上发生了一起涉嫌性侵犯的事件。 （Nam Y. Huh/美联社）

paras.en: The 21-year-old woman reported the assault to police and went to a hospital for treatment, according to Chicago police. The university said she is not a student.
paras.zh: 据芝加哥警方称，这名 21 岁的女子向警方报案，并前往医院接受治疗。大学说她不是学生。

paras.en: Chicago police did not immediately provide a copy of the incident report on the alleged attack when The Associated Press requested it Wednesday.
paras.zh: 当美联社周三要求时，芝加哥警方没有立即提供有关涉嫌袭击的事件报告副本。

paras.en: The Chicago Sun-Times, citing the police report, said the woman told police she had been drinking and dancing at the party before she began feeling unwell. The Sun-Times said the report stated two of the woman's friends then found her "not fully conscious" in a bathroom with a man and that both were partially undressed.
paras.zh: 《芝加哥太阳报》援引警方的报告称，这名女子告诉警方，在她开始感到不适之前，她一直在聚会上喝酒跳舞。 《太阳时报》称，报道称，该女子的两名朋友随后发现她“意识不清醒”，与一名男子一起在浴室里，而且两人都半脱衣服。

paras.en: The friends told police that to get into the bathroom, they had to force their way through several men who were "cheering and appearing to encourage the activity inside," the Sun-Times reported.
paras.zh: 据《太阳时报》报道，朋友们告诉警方，要进入卫生间，他们必须挤过几名男子，这些男子“欢呼雀跃，似乎鼓励里面的活动”。

paras.en: Fraternity says no member involved in alleged assault
paras.zh: 兄弟会称没有成员参与涉嫌袭击

paras.en: Alpha Epsilon Pi said no fraternity members took part in the alleged attack or encouraged it. The fraternity's University of Chicago chapter said in a statement that its members rushed to help the woman after being alerted by one of her friends and ended the party immediately.
paras.zh: Alpha Epsilon Pi 表示，兄弟会成员没有参与或怂恿这起袭击事件。该兄弟会的芝加哥大学分会在一份声明中表示，该兄弟会的成员在接到这名女子的一位朋友的警报后赶忙去帮助她，并立即结束了聚会。

paras.en: "There is no evidence at all that any AEPi members participated in this assault or were aware of it while it was transpiring," Jonathan Pierce, a spokesperson for the fraternity's national organization, said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 该兄弟会全国组织发言人乔纳森·皮尔斯 (Jonathan Pierce) 在周三的一份声明中表示，“没有任何证据表明任何 AEPi 成员参与了这起袭击事件，或者在事件发生时知晓此事。”

paras.en: The fraternity said the perpetrator was chased out of the house and was recorded by cameras while fleeing.
paras.zh: 该兄弟会表示，肇事者被赶出家门，并在逃跑过程中被摄像机记录下来。

paras.en: University officials said the person of interest who has been identified is not a student or otherwise affiliated with the school.
paras.zh: 大学官员表示，已确定的相关人员不是学生或与学校有其他关联。

paras.en: The Cornell case came to light last month after a woman filed a lawsuit against the university and seven fraternity members, saying she was repeatedly assaulted at a fraternity house in October 2024. She went to campus police three weeks later and gave a detailed interview, but local prosecutors never pursued charges. The men she accused have denied wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学案件于上个月曝光，一名女子对大学和七名兄弟会成员提起诉讼，称她于 2024 年 10 月在兄弟会会所多次遭到袭击。三周后，她去找校园警察并进行了详细询问，但当地检察官从未提出指控。她指控的男子否认有不当行为。

paras.en: Cornell announced Tuesday it's banning parties at fraternity houses until next year. The university said it will include New York State Police in investigations of campus sexual assaults.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学周二宣布，明年之前禁止在兄弟会举办聚会。该大学表示，将让纽约州警方参与校园性侵犯事件的调查。

paras.en: Fraternities have also been under scrutiny at the University of Arizona, which suspended fraternity activities earlier this month following multiple reports of assault, hazing and other misconduct.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那大学的兄弟会也受到了审查，在多起袭击、欺凌和其他不当行为的报道后，该大学于本月早些时候暂停了兄弟会的活动。

articles.title: New White House press secretary Katie Zacharia faces mounting questions about resume

paras.en: New White House press secretary Katie Zacharia faces mounting questions about resume
paras.zh: 新任白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚面临着越来越多的关于简历的问题

paras.en: No evidence so far that self-described lawyer has passed any state's bar exam
paras.zh: 到目前为止，没有证据表明自称律师已通过任何州的律师考试

paras.en: The new White House press secretary is facing mounting questions about her background and resume as she transitions into her role as the public face of the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 随着新任白宫新闻秘书转变为特朗普政府的公众形象，她面临着越来越多的关于她的背景和简历的质疑。

paras.en: Katie Zacharia has long described herself as a lawyer as she has worked to establish herself as a commentator for conservative outlets like Fox News and Newsmax. But so far, she and the White House have offered no evidence that she passed the bar exam in any state or in China, where she worked for a large law firm years ago.
paras.zh: 凯蒂·扎卡里亚 (Katie Zacharia) 长期以来一直将自己描述为一名律师，因为她一直致力于将自己打造为福克斯新闻 (Fox News) 和 Newsmax 等保守派媒体的评论员。但到目前为止，她和白宫还没有提供任何证据证明她通过了任何州或中国的律师考试，她多年前曾在中国的一家大型律师事务所工作过。

paras.en: The questions add to the confusion surrounding U.S. President Donald Trump's decision to hire Zacharia, who had worked for his social media company for only a few months when he announced her appointment and whose debut at the podium on Tuesday has been widely panned.
paras.zh: 这些问题加剧了围绕美国总统唐纳德·特朗普聘用扎卡里亚的决定的混乱。在宣布任命时，扎卡里亚在他的社交媒体公司工作了几个月，周二在讲台上的首次亮相就受到了广泛的批评。

paras.en: Afterward, the president was asked by reporters where Zacharia had passed the bar exam, following a report by the independent outlet Popular Information that she did not appear to be licensed in any state.
paras.zh: 随后，总统被记者问到扎卡里亚在哪里通过了律师考试，独立媒体《大众信息》报道称她似乎没有在任何州获得律师资格考试。

paras.en: Trump stepped aside to allow Zacharia to answer.
paras.zh: 特朗普退到一边让扎卡利亚回答。

paras.en: "When I moved to China," she responded over the sound of Marine One whirring in the background. It is not clear what she had intended to say or whether she had finished the sentence.
paras.zh: “当我搬到中国时，”她在背景中海军陆战队一号的呼呼声中回答道。目前尚不清楚她想说什么，也不清楚她是否已经说完这句话。
