articles.title: Building Circle Track Engines for Endurance and Control
articles.author: Greg Jones

paras.en: Circle track racing represents one of the most technically demanding environments for an internal combustion engine. Whether the surface is dirt or asphalt, these engines must survive sustained high rpm, extreme lateral g-forces and the unpredictable conditions that develop over the course of a race night. Unlike drag racing engines built for seconds of peak output, circle track powerplants must deliver broad, controllable power for hundreds of laps while maintaining durability.

That balance between power, drivability and longevity defines successful circle track engine development. According to Luke Wilson of 4 Piston Racing and Jack Cornett of Cornett Racing Engines, designing an engine for this environment requires a different mindset than nearly any other racing discipline. The two builders gave us their perspectives on engines for this application.

One of the defining characteristics of a competitive circle track engine is how usable its power is throughout the race. Conditions change constantly during an event, particularly on dirt tracks where the racing surface evolves lap after lap.

Early in the evening, dirt tracks may be heavy and fast, rewarding engines that produce strong high-rpm horsepower. But as the racing surface changes and slicks off, the characteristics required from the engine can shift dramatically.

“In qualifying and early heat races, the tracks can be heavy, so big, high-rpm power can be the fastest thing out there,” Wilson explains. “If there are yellow flags and restart after restart, a good, strong, low-end grunt engine may work you through to the front.”
Later in the night, drivers may be forced to maintain speed with minimal throttle input as traction becomes scarce.

“As the track slicks off in the longer races, the driver has to have the ability to run around the track fast at as little as 40% throttle…then be able to dig into their bank of power as they find places in the dirt that will hold more,” Wilson says.
This constantly changing environment means builders rarely chase peak dyno numbers alone. Instead, they focus on creating an engine with a broad, controllable powerband.

“The real balance is in making sure an engine is responsive on a restart, strong through the middle and can carry rpm to your mandated rpm,” Wilson says. “The engine has to be smooth and controllable by the driver, who is sitting in a strange position and bouncing all over the place.”

While power delivery is critical, durability is equally important. Circle track engines spend extended periods operating at extremely high rpm, which creates unique challenges for internal components.

“In circle track racing, the engine has to be built with endurance and longevity in mind,” Cornett says. “It’s completely opposite of drag racing or tractor pulling. Our engines must go 600 miles at 9,000 rpm.”

Sustained operation at these speeds places enormous stress on the rotating assembly and valvetrain components. Builders must carefully balance lightweight choices for acceleration with materials capable of surviving long-term fatigue.
“Selecting bottom end components is a balancing act,” Cornett explains. “You want the lightest components possible for acceleration, but they have to be durable enough to last thousands of miles.”
This philosophy extends to the entire engine package, from connecting rods and pistons to camshaft profiles and valvetrain components.

“Compromises have to be made in an endurance application with camshaft profiles and valvetrain components, compression ratio and ignition timing, plus carb jetting,” Cornett says. “All these factor heavily into the longevity of the engine.”

One of the most critical systems in a circle track engine is lubrication. Sustained lateral forces during cornering can starve engines of oil if the system is not designed specifically for oval racing.
“The oiling system in our engines has to be dry sump only,” Cornett says. “There is no way the engine can survive without it.”

Dry sump systems allow builders to maintain a stable oil supply while also managing oil control within the engine. Specialized oil pans and tanks are engineered specifically for left-turn racing and the lateral g-forces the engines and cars experience.

“Good, clean, non-aerated oil is critical to longevity,” Wilson says. “These engines typically have good dry sump systems that will work well on these short runs. Controlling where that oil goes and how clean the oil supply is gives you a longer-lasting engine.”
Because engine architectures vary widely across circle track classes, oil pressure requirements can differ significantly as well.

“There are very short-stroke engines with big pins on both ends, and there are smaller-displacement, small-bore, large-stroke engines – like what we build – that really require a different type of oil pressure and rebuild schedule,” Wilson notes.

Temperature management is another critical factor in circle track engine performance and reliability. Unlike many drag racing engines that run relatively cool, circle track engines often operate at significantly higher temperatures for extended periods.

“In dirt midget racing, engines are preheated to 190 degrees F with diesel or electric units and then they go push off and run,” Wilson explains. “They never have a problem having temperature in them. In fact, many of them are run too hot.”
Limited cooling capacity and the challenges of racing on dirt often contribute to high operating temperatures.

“They have small radiators with no fans, and they can get packed with dirt,” Wilson says. “Teams often come off the track with engines that have more temperature in them than the engine builders want to see.”
Cornett notes that maintaining proper operating temperatures is essential for engine survival.

“Heat management is very important and it becomes critical on dirt due to the surface you are racing on,” Cornett says. “We want to keep the water temp in the 200-240 degree F range and the oil temp in the 220-260 degree F range.”
Fuel tuning is sometimes used as an additional method of temperature control. “They often are running rich lambda outside of optimal to help keep the engines cool,” Wilson says.
Clearances, Bearings and Ring Strategies
While circle track engines operate in extreme conditions, many builders rely on proven fundamentals when it comes to internal clearances.
“There is no black magic here,” Wilson says. “Run your bearing clearance that you would normally run for your engine you are building and the oil you are running.”
For the engines built at 4 Piston Racing, that typically means clearances between .0018” and .0022”. However, Wilson notes that he’s seen other run larger clearances without engine issues as well.

Ring gap selection follows a similar philosophy. Run the ring gaps that your piston design engineer determined for your piston. “Adjust as you analyze your engines when they come back for service,” Wilson says.
One factor builders must monitor carefully is the presence of excess fuel in the ring lands, particularly when running methanol with constant-flow fuel systems.

“I have observed many times where teams run overly rich on these constant flow systems and will have a lot of unburned methanol sitting in the ring lands,” Wilson says. “There is power and longevity in having this properly managed.”
Cornett notes that ring gap strategies continue to evolve as piston and ring designs become thinner, narrower and more efficient.
As with most forms of motorsport, rulebooks play a major role in shaping circle track engine architecture.
“Rules dictate everything we do,” Wilson admits. “But this type of racing can often leave you a lot of flexibility in individual internal decisions.”
Builders typically maximize displacement and rpm within the limits set by sanctioning bodies, but internal design decisions still allow room for innovation.
“If you took the top five engines out there, you’d see some significant differences in how they are built because the engine architecture is so different,” Wilson says.
In some classes, that freedom is one of the reasons circle track racing remains attractive to engine builders.

“There is a lot of parity in midget engines,” Wilson says. “It is about as blank sheet as you can get for wanting to build something you can call yours. Many other types of racing have gone too far on requiring a spec engine.”

Cornett echoes that sentiment from the perspective of dirt late model racing, saying, “Rules are obviously always a big concern on how to build your engine. Luckily, in dirt late model racing, there aren’t many rules.”

Despite careful engineering, circle track engines face numerous potential failure points based on engine type as each has a different Achillies heel. According to Cornett, two issues appear more frequently than others.

“The two most common failures in circle track racing are bearing failure and overheating,” he says. “I think most bearing failures are caused by not properly warming up the oil temp before you race. Overheating issues are usually caused by racing on dirt.”
Wilson notes that valvetrain components and timing drive systems can also be vulnerable.

“Engines can see valvetrain and rod bearing issues because of how the racers beat them on the limiter repeatedly,” he says. “Crashes can create additional risks. The most common failure is in the timing drive system when a car is turned backwards, flipped, or crashed in a bad way.”
Ignition system limitations can also contribute to engine stress in some racing classes.

“We have observed repeatedly where we are asking for 25 degrees of timing and will see an engine walk around as much as 10 degrees in either direction,” Wilson explains. “This is really hard on engines and easily resolved by putting a modern motorsports grade ignition system on the engine.”

Because circle track engines operate under extreme conditions, regular service and inspection are essential for maintaining performance and reliability. Cornett Racing Engines typically bases rebuild intervals on total laps run.
“Based on our experience, we have developed a lap strategy to know when to rebuild the engine,” Cornett says. “The customer keeps up with how many laps he races.”
Most engines are serviced after roughly 1,200 to 1,500 laps, which equates to approximately 600 to 750 miles of racing.
Wilson notes that service intervals can vary widely depending on how teams operate their equipment.

“I have the same engine that I’m confident that team A can run for 25 shows and then bring it for service,” he says. “I have the same engine with team B and I have them bring it back after 10 shows, sometimes in a box and not on a stand.”
Driver behavior, maintenance practices and tuning decisions all influence how long an engine survives between rebuilds.
“Some teams beat the hell out of stuff and aren’t kind to their engines,” Wilson admits. “You have to handle each team on a case-by-case basis and then develop a plan going forward.”
The Future of Circle Track Engine Technology

Even with decades of development behind them, circle track engines continue to evolve. Wilson believes that modern electronics and fuel systems could significantly improve reliability and performance in some classes.

“Midget racing specifically needs to allow some modern electronics and fueling,” he says. “Many series still rely on constant-flow fuel injection systems, which came about in the 1940s. The reality is the guys who know it well and tune it well are aging out.”

Wilson has personally tested modern electronic fuel injection systems against traditional mechanical setups. The results demonstrated that modern systems can be competitive while offering improved tuning efficiency.

“With a highly experienced constant flow pro we spent more than six hours tuning that engine,” Wilson recalls. “I swapped the injection over to my EFI, hooked up my ECU and swung a dyno pull. It cleared what we achieved on the first pull.”
Within a handful of pulls, the EFI system produced measurable gains.
“After six dyno pulls we had a smoother power curve, more responsive power and more peak power by 8–10 horsepower on a 400-hp engine,” Wilson says.
Despite the results, many teams remain loyal to traditional systems – a reminder that racing technology often evolves as much through culture as engineering.

For engine builders, circle track racing offers a unique challenge. The engines must deliver high power, survive extreme conditions and adapt to constantly changing track surfaces – all while operating within rulebooks that vary widely from one class to another. That complexity is exactly what keeps builders engaged.
“This always changing dynamic is what makes the engines in this racing so much fun to work with,” Wilson says.

As both Wilson and Cornett emphasize, success in circle track racing ultimately comes down to balancing engineering precision with real-world durability – building engines that can not only make power, but keep making it lap after lap.

articles.title: MotoRad CEO Matt Buchholz on Aligning Values
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Matt Buchholz, CEO of MotoRad. In this interview, Buchholz described how the company’s D.R.I.V.E. core values — Dedication, Relationship, Innovation, Value Driven and Expertise — provide the cultural foundation for how its team operates internally and engages with customers and channel partners.

Buchholz emphasized that culture and strategy are closely connected. By aligning teams around common values and empowering employees to live them every day, he said MotoRad creates a foundation for continuous improvement — reflecting his philosophy that when an organization gets better, it gets bigger.

As MotoRad expands across thermal management, emissions and powertrain controls, Buchholz said investment decisions begin with market intelligence and listening directly to customers. The company looks for opportunities that fit its existing capabilities and strategy while addressing clear market needs. Buchholz said it also evaluates adjacent categories for “low friction” opportunities where it can create value quickly. In many cases, some of MotoRad’s strongest product ideas have originated with technicians, counter professionals and other customers who identify ways the company can improve a product or make a repair easier.

Operationally, MotoRad is focused on diversifying its global supply chain to maintain continuity of supply and become nimbler. paras.en: DRiV announced the expansion of its Wagner brake caliper portfolio with the addition of 547 new SKUs, bringing the lineup to approximately 1,100 SKUs.
According to DRiV, the expanded coverage includes the 2015 Nissan Altima and 2013 Hyundai Sonata. Wagner says its calipers are 100% new units, and the program requires no core charge or core return.

“Wagner continues to invest in the categories and coverage areas that matter most to aftermarket customers,” said Joseph Saoud, vice president and general manager for the U.S. and Canada at DRiV. “With 547 new caliper SKUs, we are expanding availability across high-volume vehicle applications while giving customers a 100% new caliper option that helps simplify the repair and replacement process.”

articles.title: Schaeffler Brands to Consolidate Under the Schaeffler Name
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Schaeffler announced that in 2027 its product brands, F.A.G., INA and LuK, will gradually transition to a rebrand under the Schaeffler name.

“Customers already experience Schaeffler as one technology partner. Bringing our VLS product and service portfolio together under one brand is the logical next step and reinforces our ambition to lead the future of mobility and repair,” said Jens Schueler, CEO of Schaeffler Vehicle Lifetime Solutions.

The rollout will begin with the F.A.G. aftermarket portfolio. Starting in Q2 of 2027, products worldwide will feature a new packaging design that places the Schaeffler brand more prominently and introduces a more unified visual identity, the company said. At the same time, the brands F.A.G., INA and LuK will remain visible in a supporting role, the company noted. F.A.G., LuK and INA brand names will continue to be visible on the metal components themselves.

Sales tools, training and customer communication will be provided before each rollout step. Advertising, brochures, digital assets and point-of-sale materials will adopt a Schaeffler focus, with product-brand names used as supporting elements.
Schaeffler said in a press release that “product quality, specifications, part numbers, agreements, day-to-day business processes and online catalogs will remain unchanged.”

articles.title: Brake Job: 2019-Present Ram 2500
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The fifth-generation Ram 2500 places substantial demands on its brakes. Many of these trucks carry heavy payloads, tow trailers or operate in fleets, so a successful brake job requires a complete-system inspection and parts that match the platform’s thermal and mechanical demands.

This Brake Job covers the 2019-present fifth-generation Ram 2500, not the Ram 1500. The 2500 uses heavy-duty components and platform-specific procedures. Confirm the model year, engine, axle and options before ordering parts or applying specifications.
The Ram 2500 has four-wheel vented discs and dual-piston sliding calipers. Separate parking-brake shoes act against a drum surface inside each rear rotor hat.

Booster configuration depends on the engine. The 6.4L Hemi uses a dual-diaphragm vacuum booster and an electric vacuum pump near the left front of the engine to supplement engine vacuum. The PCM commands the pump based on operating inputs. The 6.7L diesel uses Hydro-Boost, supplied by the power-steering pump, with an accumulator providing limited reserve assist if pump pressure is lost.

When it’s practical, begin the process with a road test and note pedal travel, assist, pull, vibration and noise under normal braking. Confirm the complaint before disassembly; a vibration blamed on the front brakes may originate at the rear, and an assist complaint may come from the vacuum or power-steering circuit rather than the foundation brakes.

Clean around the master-cylinder cap and verify that the fluid is at the MAX mark. On a diesel vehicle, you should also inspect the power-steering fluid level, hoses and lines, because Hydro-Boost depends on that circuit. Low fluid, leaks, restrictions or weak pump output can create assist complaints. On gasoline models, inspect booster vacuum plumbing and electric-pump operation.

Compare inner and outer pad wear and both sides of each axle. Uneven wear can reveal seized hardware, binding pads, piston trouble or slide problems. Replace pads as an axle set if usable lining at the thinnest point is 1 mm (0.04 inch) or less. Inspect boots, pistons, slides, hoses and bleeders for damage, leakage and corrosion.

Be sure to measure the rotors. Minimum thickness is 37.4 mm (1.47 inches) front and 32.4 mm (1.28 inches) rear. Maximum runout is 0.020 mm (0.0008 inch); maximum loose-rotor thickness variation is 0.008 mm (0.00031 inch). You should also inspect the internal parking-brake surface; maximum drum diameter is 207.2 mm (8.157 inches).

Support the caliper and adapter; never let the hose carry their weight. Clean the pad lands and hub face without removing base metal. Install new anti-rattle clips, verify free pad movement and make sure both pistons retract smoothly. Because the rotor fits over the hub studs, hub cleanliness and uniform wheel-fastener torque are critical to controlling installed runout.

Rear service adds the parking-brake assembly. A rotor that will not release may be hanging on the shoes, so release the pedal and back off the star wheel if necessary. With the rotor off, inspect the shoes, springs, adjuster, cable action and drum surface. Clean the hub and bracket, verify piston and slide movement, and install new hardware and sealing washers as required.
Always replace caliper hardware; old clips can restrict pad movement and cause uneven wear.

Use fresh fluid meeting SAE J1703-F and DOT 3 standards. Bleed in this order: right rear, left rear, right front and left front, keeping the reservoir full. For pressure bleeding, use the correct adapter; 15-20 PSI is generally sufficient, depending on equipment limits.

If air entered the HCU, perform a base bleed, use a capable scan tool’s ABS Miscellaneous menu to run the HCU bleed routine, then bleed the base system again. Set the fluid level and verify a firm pedal.

Hydro-Boost is generally self- bleeding. Fill the power-steering reservoir, disable the engine and crank it for several seconds, then recheck the level. Re-enable and start the engine, slowly turn lock to lock twice, shut it off and discharge the accumulator with five pedal applications. Restart, repeat two slow lock-to-lock cycles, shut down and correct the level. If the fluid foams, let it dissipate before repeating the final cycles.

Adjust the shoes before cable tension. With the pedal fully released and the front cable slackened at the frame-rail adjuster, turn each star wheel through the backing-plate hole until slight drag is felt, then back it off until drag disappears. Adjust both sides equally.

Cable-tensioner adjustment is normally required only after replacement or disconnection. After verifying cable movement and shoe adjustment, fully apply the pedal. Mark the non-threaded tensioner rod 1/4 inch from the tensioner edge and tighten the nut until the mark disappears. Release the pedal, confirm both wheels rotate freely, verify that the brake holds and road-test the truck.

articles.title: Ranger Introduces DST30PX Wheel Balancer for Larger Wheels
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Ranger, a division of BendPak, introduced the next-generation DST30PX wheel balancer as part of its DST Series. As shops face an influx of larger OEM wheel assemblies and heavy aftermarket truck tires, older balancing platforms can struggle. These challenges can slow the balancing process.
The Ranger DST30PX Professional Wheel Balancer accommodates oversized wheels through a new hood design, larger shaft and redesigned structural chassis.
Wheel Balancer Accommodates Oversized Assemblies

According to Ranger, the new hood accommodates a wider range of tire shapes and sizes, including oversized off-road and fleet tires. Its design reduces the need for repositioning. The open-side design allows technicians to mount wider tires, aggressive offsets and bulky sidewalls more easily. This reduces setup time and helps operators position wheel assemblies up to 43 inches in diameter.

Ranger also reinforced the machine’s chassis and hood assembly to handle the added mass of larger assemblies. The reinforcement reduces flexing, alignment issues and excess vibration. The additional rigidity helps maintain consistent measurements during operation. The 40 mm shaft increases stiffness and accuracy for heavier wheels while supporting standard cones and accessories.

“The Ranger DST30PX represents a fundamental shift in how modern shops handle today’s radically heavier, oversized wheel configurations,” says Sean Price, director of product development for BendPak Inc. “By optimizing the physical layout and integrating a high-precision sensor array, we ensure technicians can mount, spin, and perfectly balance oversized assemblies without a single second of wasted motion — turning massive wheel packages into a rapid, routine six-second floor-to-floor operation.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Encoder Supports Accurate Weight Placement
Ranger added that the DST30PX features a large, 64-tooth magnetic transducer encoder that uses precision-cut square teeth. The encoder converts rotary position into a digital electronic signal.
This technology helps the machine achieve accurate profile readings and top-dead-center positioning for precise wheel weight placement.

The additional encoder resolution supports balancing applications requiring smaller weight adjustments and greater placement accuracy. These applications include performance wheels and larger tires, where customers may notice even minor vibration issues.
The DST30PX streamlines repetitive wheel service by reducing unnecessary motion.

Simple wheel data entry, precise rolling weight readings and automatic braking help technicians balance wheels efficiently. Manual or automatic hood-start operation and a rapid cycle time also help reduce errors and guesswork.
The quick-release hub nut, side-position brake, top-dead-center weight indicator and tiered placement indicators accelerate setup and correction.

Onboard storage includes a high-volume top tray, side cone pegs and a side shelf. The shelf accommodates Ranger Quick-Peel adhesive tape weight rolls. These features help technicians organize their work areas during busy periods.
Other key features of the Ranger DST30PX Professional Wheel Balancer include:
- 145-pound capacity, 30-inch wheel diameter range and maximum tire diameter of 43 inches
- Low-rpm balancing operation and six-second cycle time
- Dynamic, static and performance alloy settings
- 16-bit processor and multidirectional quartz piezoelectric sensors that detect imbalance across multiple force directions
- Ergonomic controls and full-tilt LED display control panel
- Automatic braking and self-calibration function
Safety Certification and Included Accessories

The Ranger DST30PX Professional Wheel Balancer offers shops a measuring system for modern wheels without requiring a larger machine. The machine carries ETL certification for applicable UL and CSA safety standards in the United States and Canada.

Like other Ranger balancers, the DST30PX includes a starter kit of adhesive and clip-on steel wheel weights. Ranger also offers its Ranger Select setup and training program. Additional information is available on the Ranger DST30PX product page or by calling 800-253-2363.

articles.title: Klipboard Marks 50 Years of Innovation
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Klipboard, an industry-specific business software company, is marking its 50th anniversary. October 2026 marks five decades of supporting businesses with industry-specific software and expertise. The company has helped businesses adapt, grow and make the most of changing technology.

Founded in 1976 as Kerridge Computer Company, the business has changed significantly over the past half-century. The company began by developing software for niche industries in the U.K. Today, Klipboard provides industry-specific business management technology to 55,000 customers across automotive, distribution, rental and field service.
Klipboard Adapts to Technological Changes

The milestone comes as the pace of technological change continues to accelerate. Over the past 50 years, Klipboard has helped businesses navigate the arrival of personal computing and graphical user interfaces. Other developments include the internet, cloud computing and mobile technology, alongside periods of significant economic and industry change.

Today, developments in artificial intelligence, data and automation are creating another major shift in business operations and decision-making. Throughout these changes, Klipboard said it has continued to evolve its technology around the industries and businesses it serves.
Today, Klipboard operates across 30 global offices. The company combines international scale with industry expertise developed through decades of working closely with customers.

“50 years is a remarkable milestone, and one that gives us an opportunity to reflect on just how much has changed,” said Ian Bendelow, CEO of Klipboard. “Since Klipboard began its journey, we’ve seen the arrival of the internet, mobile phones, cloud computing, social media and now artificial intelligence. We’ve also lived through economic booms, recessions, global crises and enormous changes within the industries our customers operate in.”

“I’m incredibly proud of what we’ve built together and grateful to every customer, partner and employee who has been part of that journey. But while 50 years gives us plenty to celebrate, what excites me most is what comes next.”
From Industry Software to Connected Business Technology

Klipboard said its development over five decades reflects the changing role technology plays within the businesses it supports. Early business systems helped companies manage everyday processes. Today, technology plays a fundamental role in managing inventory, sales, customers, assets, finance and operations. It also helps organizations manage the information behind their business decisions.

Klipboard has evolved alongside these requirements. The company develops and integrates industry-specific enterprise resource planning (ERP) and business management solutions around customers’ operations. This evolution continues today.

Alongside its core business management platforms, Klipboard is investing in cloud technology, connected applications, embedded payments and data intelligence. The company also is investing in solutions with native or embedded artificial intelligence (AI). These technologies aim to reduce manual work, improve visibility and support better-informed decisions.

The company recently introduced Klipboard Intelligence, which combines industry-specific operational data, industry expertise and advanced analytics. The technology aims to help businesses understand changing conditions and identify areas requiring action.

Klipboard plans to mark its 50th anniversary throughout the year by recognizing customers, employees, partnerships and innovations that shaped the business. A new timeline charts milestones from 1976 to today. It covers the company’s early years, initial software developments, international expansion and successive generations of technology. The company also intends to use the anniversary to highlight its future direction.

“The technology will continue to change, just as it has throughout our first 50 years. Our job is to understand what those changes mean for our customers and turn them into something genuinely useful,” Bendelow added. “We’ve achieved a huge amount together in our first 50 years. Now we can build on that experience and help our customers navigate whatever comes next.”

articles.title: FORVIA Expands Olivier Lefebvre’s Leadership Role
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: FORVIA announced the appointment of Olivier Lefebvre as head of the JIKA (Japan, India, Korea and ASEAN) region, effective immediately. Lefebvre also serves as chief operating officer and group executive vice president. The company said his appointment strengthens FORVIA’s operational governance and execution capabilities across one of the group’s key geographic areas.
FORVIA Expands Lefebvre’s Leadership Responsibilities

Lefebvre has experience transforming industrial operations and leading complex global projects. He joined the group in 1995 and has held several senior leadership roles across South America and Europe. Most recently, he led FORVIA’s Clean Mobility business group.
As chief operating officer, he oversees operational excellence across the group. His responsibilities include operations, total customer satisfaction and quality, and purchasing.

The appointment reflects FORVIA’s focus on regional leadership, customer relationships and operational excellence. It also supports the execution of strategic priorities through coordination with regional leadership teams.
Lefebvre succeeds Shoji Akiyama, who has decided to pursue opportunities outside the group. FORVIA thanked Akiyama for his contributions and leadership during his tenure.

“The JIKA region is an important contributor to FORVIA’s global operations and customer relationships. By expanding Olivier’s responsibilities, we are strengthening the connection between regional execution and the Group’s operational leadership, with a continued focus on performance, agility and customer support,” said Martin Fischer, chief executive officer of FORVIA. “This appointment will also help accelerate our local-for-local strategy, ensuring that we remain close to our customers and continue developing solutions tailored to the specific needs of each market.”

articles.title: BCA Bearings Releases 9 New Wheel Hub Assemblies
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corporation of America, the parent company of BCA Bearings, announced the addition of nine new wheel hub assembly part numbers to the BCA aftermarket product line. This latest new number announcement delivers expanded OE-quality coverage for more than 6.2 million vehicles in operation across North America.
paras.zh: BCA Bearings的母公司NTN Bearing Corporation of America宣布， BCA售后市场产品线新增9个轮毂总成部件号。这一最新数字公告扩大了北美620多万辆在运车辆的OE质量覆盖范围。

paras.en: “BCA remains committed to delivering coverage for the applications that drive today’s aftermarket demand,” said Matt Gorski, manager of product development, automotive aftermarket. “These latest wheel hub additions strengthen our offering across some of the industry’s most popular trucks, SUVs, and passenger vehicles, helping our customers confidently service a broad range of applications with the OE-quality they expect from BCA.”
paras.zh: “BCA仍然致力于为推动当今售后市场需求的应用提供覆盖范围，”汽车售后市场产品开发经理Matt Gorski说。“这些最新的轮毂增加加强了我们在一些业界最受欢迎的卡车、SUV和乘用车上的服务，帮助我们的客户自信地以他们期望的BCA OE质量为广泛的应用提供服务。”

paras.en: The new additions expand BCA‘s wheel hub assembly coverage across a wide range of domestic and import vehicle platforms from manufacturers including Chevrolet, GMC, Ford, Lincoln, Jeep, Toyota, Kia, and Hyundai. The release includes new applications for popular full-size pickups, heavy-duty trucks, SUVs, crossover utility vehicles, and passenger cars, further strengthening BCA’s ability to provide comprehensive coverage for the growing aftermarket.
paras.zh: 新增加的部分扩大了BCA的轮毂装配覆盖范围，涵盖雪佛兰、GMC、福特、林肯、吉普、丰田、起亚、现代等制造商的各种国内和进口汽车平台。该版本包括流行的全尺寸皮卡、重型卡车、SUV、跨界多功能车和乘用车的新应用，进一步加强了BCA为不断增长的售后市场提供全面覆盖的能力。

paras.en: Complete product and catalog information for the BCA Bearings product line can be found at BCABearings.com and ShowMeTheParts.com.
paras.zh: BCA轴承产品线的完整产品和目录信息可在BCABearings.com和ShowMeTheParts.com上找到。

articles.title: Chinese pottery discovered in Great Zimbabwe reveals medieval African empire's vast connections spanning thousands of miles
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists digging in the medieval city of Great Zimbabwe have discovered pieces of jade-green Chinese pottery, suggesting that the enigmatic empire had long-distance connections with East Asia more than 1,000 years ago.
paras.zh: 在中世纪城市大津巴布韦挖掘的考古学家发现了玉绿色的中国陶器碎片，这表明这个神秘的帝国在1000多年前与东亚有着长距离的联系。

paras.en: Great Zimbabwe, located in the southeastern part of modern-day Zimbabwe, was the capital of an ancient empire that arose in southeastern Africa in around A.D. 1000. Little is known about this precolonial empire because its people did not leave a written history, but new archaeological excavations are shining a light on the enormous scale of the centuries-old civilization known for its intricate metalworking and ritual stone carvings.
paras.zh: 大津巴布韦位于现代津巴布韦的东南部，是公元1000年左右在非洲东南部兴起的一个古老帝国的首都。人们对这个前殖民帝国知之甚少，因为它的人民没有留下书面历史，但新的考古发掘正在照亮这个以其复杂的金属加工和仪式石雕而闻名的百年文明的巨大规模。

paras.en: In the new PBS documentary "Secrets of the Dead: Africa's Golden City," filmmakers followed a team of archaeologists from the field to the laboratory to try to answer questions surrounding the origins of the understudied civilization, its ritual and trade activities and why it disappeared after 500 years.
paras.zh: 在新的PBS纪录片“死者的秘密：非洲的黄金城”中，电影制片人跟随一组考古学家从田野到实验室，试图回答围绕未被研究的文明的起源，其仪式和贸易活动以及为什么它在500年后消失的问题。

paras.en: "When I was growing up, I was surrounded by symbols of Great Zimbabwe," University of Oxford archaeologist Shadreck Chirikure, who is leading the new excavations at the site, said in the documentary. "It was only when I started studying archaeology at university that I started realizing that there was this very big debate around who built Great Zimbabwe."
paras.zh: 牛津大学考古学家沙德雷克·奇里库雷（ Shadreck Chirikure ）在纪录片中说： “在我成长的过程中，我被大津巴布韦的象征所包围。” “直到我开始在大学学习考古学时，我才开始意识到，围绕谁建造了伟大的津巴布韦，存在着一场非常大的争论。”

paras.en: The site was first excavated in the late 19th century and quickly looted by British colonists for its ivory, metal and gold artifacts. These colonists insisted that Africans hadn't built Great Zimbabwe, instead claiming it arose from the Phoenicians, a people originally from the Mediterranean; they used that inaccuracy to justify taking all the artifacts to England, according to the documentary. Today, many Great Zimbabwean artifacts are held in the collection of the Pitt Rivers Museum at the University of Oxford.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: But excavations are showing that Great Zimbabwe was a highly connected African kingdom that flourished from the 11th century until at least the 15th century, when the population may have gotten too large for the dry, over-farmed land to feed. Archaeologists have already discovered glass artifacts at Great Zimbabwe that came from Southeast Asia, India and the Middle East via boat.
paras.zh: 但发掘表明，大津巴布韦是一个高度连接的非洲王国，从11世纪开始蓬勃发展，直到至少15世纪，当时人口可能过多，无法养活干旱、过度耕种的土地。考古学家已经在大津巴布韦发现了玻璃制品，这些玻璃制品来自东南亚、印度和中东。

paras.en: "From India or Sri Lanka to Great Zimbabwe, it's at least 8,000 kilometers [5,000 miles]," Chirikure told Live Science. Merchants sailed the Indian Ocean using winds kicked up by monsoon cycles.
paras.zh: “从印度或斯里兰卡到大津巴布韦，它至少有8,000公里（ 5,000英里） ，” Chirikure告诉Live Science。商人利用季风周期掀起的风在印度洋航行。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "It's time we try to understand a bit more about trade and exchange," Chirikure said, "particularly by comparing the communities in places like Sri Lanka and southern Africa. Because it's the water that separated people, but it was also the water that connected people."
paras.zh: “现在是我们尝试更多地了解贸易和交流的时候了，” Chirikure说， “特别是通过比较斯里兰卡和南部非洲等地的社区。因为是水把人分开了，也是水把人连在一起了。”

paras.en: In this exclusive clip from the documentary, Chirikure and archaeologist Muchen Zhou, a doctoral student at the University of Oxford, examine a jade-green piece of pottery unearthed from the hillside at Great Zimbabwe. The glossy sheen on the sherd suggests the pot was fired at an extremely high temperature, a technological achievement that had only been accomplished in China at that early date. This style of pottery, called Longquan celadon, was made in eastern China starting around A.D. 950.
paras.zh: 在这部纪录片的独家剪辑中， Chirikure和牛津大学博士生考古学家Muchen Zhou检查了大津巴布韦山坡上出土的一块玉绿色陶器。谢尔德上有光泽的光泽表明，锅是在极高的温度下烧制的，这是一项早期仅在中国完成的技术成就。这种风格的陶器被称为龙泉青瓷，从公元950年左右开始在中国东部制造。

paras.en: "We find it across the site of Great Zimbabwe," Chirikure said, but in small quantities. "This means the Chinese ceramics are a rarity. Perhaps they were used by the elites. They would have been quite a significant or highly valued exotic ware."
paras.zh: “我们在大津巴布韦的遗址上找到它，” Chirikure说，但数量很少。“这意味着中国陶瓷很罕见。或许是被精英们利用了。它们将是一个相当重要或高度珍贵的异国情调的器皿。”

paras.en: Other evidence of long-distance trade has been discovered at Great Zimbabwe, Chirikure said, including metal objects from what is today the Democratic Republic of Congo, around 1,250 miles (2,000 kilometers) away. The people of Great Zimbabwe were also sourcing copper and tin from modern-day South Africa, more than 300 miles (500 km) away. And chemical analysis of cattle bones has shown that some of the animals were being traded across an 87-mile (140 km) area.
paras.zh: Chirikure说，在大津巴布韦发现了其他长途贸易的证据，包括来自今天刚果民主共和国的金属物体，距离约1,250英里（ 2,000公里）。大津巴布韦人民也从300多英里（ 500公里）外的现代南非采购铜和锡。对牛骨头的化学分析表明，一些动物正在87英里（ 140公里）的区域进行交易。

paras.en: - Medieval Swahilis and Persians paired up 1,000 years ago in East Africa, ancient DNA reveals
paras.zh: -古老的DNA显示，中世纪的斯瓦希里人和波斯人在1000年前在东非结对

paras.en: - 'We do not know of a similar case': 4,000-year-old burial in little-known African kingdom mystifies archaeologists
paras.zh: - “我们不知道类似的案例” ：在鲜为人知的非洲王国进行的4000年前的埋葬让考古学家感到困惑

paras.en: - Ancient DNA from South Africa rock shelter reveals the same human population stayed there for 9,000 years
paras.zh: -来自南非岩石庇护所的古代DNA显示，相同的人口在那里停留了9000年

paras.en: For his next project, Chirikure hopes to investigate local resources, such as soapstone, that hold a lot of meaning for the local Shona people, Zimbabwe's largest Indigenous group; and for Zimbabweans.
paras.zh: 对于他的下一个项目， Chirikure希望调查当地资源，例如肥皂石，这对津巴布韦最大的土著群体当地绍纳人以及津巴布韦人具有重要意义。

paras.en: "Soapstone birds are an important part of Great Zimbabwe," he said, "but no one really knows where they got their soapstone from."
paras.zh: “肥皂石鸟是大津巴布韦的重要组成部分，”他说， “但没有人真正知道他们从哪里得到肥皂石。”

paras.en: The Zimbabwe Bird, designed based on a series of birds carved from soapstone that were found at the archaeological site, is the national emblem and appears prominently on the country's flag.
paras.zh: 津巴布韦鸟的设计基于在考古遗址发现的肥皂石雕刻的一系列鸟类，是国徽，并在该国国旗上显着出现。

paras.en: "There are a number of soapstone outcrops around Great Zimbabwe," Chirikure said. Next time in the field, that's one of the things I want to do — just go out there and try and find the geological sources of that soapstone."
paras.zh: “大津巴布韦周围有许多肥皂石露头，” Chirikure说。下次在田野里，这是我想做的事情之一—只需走出去，尝试寻找肥皂石的地质来源。”

paras.en: The PBS documentary "Secrets of the Dead: Africa's Golden City" premieres Wednesday, Oct. 14, at 10 p.m. U.S. Eastern time.
paras.zh: 美国东部时间10月14日星期三晚上10点， PBS纪录片《死者的秘密：非洲的黄金城》首映。

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.

articles.title: 'They cannot compete with the prices that fish factories will pay': How demand for fish meal takes priority over feeding people
articles.author: Rose George

paras.en: Fish meal is a commercial, protein-rich product created from raw fish and their byproducts, such as the heads and bones. It tends to be made from smaller fish species, including anchovies, sardines and herring. The fish are cooked, dried and ground into a powder, and then used to feed livestock, farmed fish and pets. But it is not a straightforward market.
paras.zh: 鱼粉是一种富​​含蛋白质的商业产品，由生鱼及其副产品（例如鱼头和鱼骨）制成。它往往由较小的鱼类制成，包括凤尾鱼、沙丁鱼和鲱鱼。将鱼煮熟、干燥并磨成粉末，然后用来喂养牲畜、养殖鱼类和宠物。但这并不是一个简单的市场。

paras.en: In this excerpt from "Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing" (Granta Books, 2025), journalist and author Rose George looks at how vast quantities of staple fish are taken from the sea off West Africa and turned into fishmeal for farming in Europe and China, instead of ending up on the plates of people in Africa.
paras.zh: 在《最后一条鱼：深入探究鱼类和渔业的世界》（Granta Books，2025 年）的摘录中，记者兼作家罗斯·乔治 (Rose George) 探讨了如何从西非海域捕捞大量主食鱼，并将其制成鱼粉用于欧洲和中国的农业生产，而不是最终出现在非洲人民的餐桌上。

paras.en: "Every Last Fish" was short-listed for the 2026 Royal Society Trivedi Science Book Prize.
paras.zh: 《Every Last Fish》入围2026年英国皇家学会特里维迪科学图书奖。

paras.en: Rose George interview: 'If you do want to be a criminal, there is no better place to do it': Diving into the dark depths of the fishing industry
paras.zh: 罗斯·乔治采访：“如果你确实想成为一名罪犯，没有比这更好的地方了”：深入渔业的黑暗深处

paras.en: Take a fish. Eat its flesh if you want, but don't scorn the rest. It can always be used, one way or another, whether you want fishmeal or face cream.
paras.zh: 吃鱼吧，想吃就吃，其余的都不要轻视。无论您是想要鱼粉还是面霜，它都可以随时以某种方式使用。

paras.en: Products derived from fish turn up everywhere. Guanine, an ingredient produced from fish scales, is found in bath foam, perfume, nail products, shampoo, skincare products, and lipstick. Fishes can become gelatine, glue, and squalene. They can be in your dietary supplements or your glass of wine: isinglass, derived from dried fish air bladders, is used in wine-making.
paras.zh: 鱼类衍生产品随处可见。鸟嘌呤是一种由鱼鳞制成的成分，存在于沐浴露、香水、指甲产品、洗发水、护肤品和口红中。鱼类可以变成明胶、胶水和角鲨烯。它们可能存在于您的膳食补充剂或一杯葡萄酒中： Isinglass源自干鱼气囊，用于酿酒。

paras.en: Futuristic piscigrafts are irrelevant to most people in Senegal, but they still have to deal with the fish by-products industry, because they have to watch as fish they could eat are transformed into the most common and lucrative fish by-products and sent abroad.
paras.zh: 未来派的鱼移植对塞内加尔的大多数人来说无关紧要，但他们仍然必须与鱼副产品行业打交道，因为他们必须眼睁睁地看着他们可以吃的鱼被转化为最常见和最有利可图的鱼副产品并运往国外。

paras.en: Fishmeal is a sandy grubby powder that is worth billions. Minks eat it. Pigs eat it. Cattle eat it. Fishes eat it. It is also an ingredient in fertilizer and pet food. Fishmeal is part of a huge silent industry of fish by-products that used to be known as FMFO (fishmeal and fish oil) and has now been rebranded by the industry association as 'marine ingredients,' a vague term that covers a broad range of fish-derived products, most of which are never noticed.
paras.zh: 鱼粉是一种价值数十亿美元的沙质肮脏粉末。水貂吃，猪吃牛吃鱼吃它也是肥料和宠物食品的成分。鱼粉是曾经被称为FMFO （鱼粉和鱼油）的庞大无声的鱼类副产品行业的一部分，现在已被行业协会重新命名为“海洋成分” ，这个模糊的术语涵盖了广泛的鱼类衍生产品，其中大多数从未被注意到。

paras.en: The Food and Agriculture Organization defines fishmeal as 'the clean, ground, dried tissue of undecomposed whole fish or fish cuttings, either or both, without the extraction of part of the oil.'
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织（ FAO ）将鱼粉定义为“未分解的整条鱼或鱼枝的干净、磨碎、干燥的组织，其中之一或两者，无需提取部分油。”

paras.en: American pets may also find themselves eating fish liver and glandular meal, made from dried complete fish viscera; more general fish by-products, which are 'non-rendered, clean, undecomposed portions of fish (such as, although not limited to, heads, fins, tails, ends, skin, bone and viscera)'; or condensed fish protein digest, the 'condensed enzymatic digest of clean undecomposed whole fish or fish cuttings using the enzyme hydrolysis process'.
paras.zh: 美国宠物也可能发现自己吃鱼肝和腺体膳食，由干燥的完整鱼类内脏制成；更一般的鱼类副产品，是“未渲染、清洁、未分解的鱼类部分（例如但不限于头、鳍、尾、末端、皮肤、骨骼和内脏）” ；或浓缩鱼类蛋白质消化物， “使用酶水解过程清洁未分解的整条鱼或鱼屑的浓缩酶消化物”。

paras.en: 'Undecomposed' is doing a lot of work here, a strange term because unless a fish is caught by a vessel with freezer capacity — which no artisanal fisher has — it will be decomposing for days. In theory, fishmeal is impeccably sustainable. It should be a product made from parts of fishes that would otherwise be discarded. It is because of fishmeal that the term 'reduction fisheries' was coined.
paras.zh: “未分解”在这里做了很多工作，这是一个奇怪的术语，因为除非鱼被具有冷冻容量的船只捕获—没有手工渔民拥有—否则它将分解数天。理论上，鱼粉具有无可挑剔的可持续性。它应该是由否则会被丢弃的鱼类部分制成的产品。正是由于鱼粉， “减少渔业”一词才被创造出来。

paras.en: Take the meat and the prized flesh, and the rest can be reduced or diverted to other uses. That is the theory. It is not what happens in West Africa.
paras.zh: 拿起肉和珍贵的肉，其余的可以减少或转用于其他用途。这就是理论。西非的情况并非如此。

paras.en: Each year, half a million tonnes of wild fish are caught in African waters and sent to Europe to feed animals, when they could have fed 33 million Africans instead. That number of people is more than the combined populations of Senegal, Mauritania, and The Gambia. Globally a fifth of wild fishes become fishmeal or fish oil, but 90 per cent of fishmeal fishes are suitable for human consumption.
paras.zh: 每年，在非洲水域捕获50万吨野生鱼类并送往欧洲喂养动物，而当时它们本可以喂养3300万非洲人。这个数字超过了塞内加尔、毛里塔尼亚和冈比亚的总人口。全球五分之一的野生鱼类成为鱼粉或鱼油，但90%的鱼粉鱼类适合人类食用。

paras.en: China uses nearly half of all FMFO, but then China uses most of everything. Europe also takes and takes. Spain imports the most fish oil from Senegal, and France takes 70 per cent of Mauritania's.
paras.zh: 中国使用了近一半的FMFO ，但随后中国使用了大部分FMFO。欧洲也采取和采取。西班牙从塞内加尔进口的鱼油最多，法国占毛里塔尼亚鱼油的70%。

paras.en: In 2019, Changing Markets Foundation produced a detailed investigative report into the fishmeal industry in India, Vietnam, and The Gambia. In each country, the pattern was similar: first the foreign factories come, then they take the fish, then they pollute the environment, then the fishermen say there are no fish left.
paras.zh: 2019年， Changing Markets Foundation对印度、越南和冈比亚的鱼粉行业进行了详细的调查报告。在每个国家，模式都是相似的：首先是外国工厂来，然后是捕鱼，然后是污染环境，然后是渔民说没有鱼了。

paras.en: Although noting 'a surprising lack of traceability and transparency regarding the origin and supply chain of farmed seafood products,' the foundation linked plenty of reputable European retailers to FMFO supply chains that may use West African fish. For example: Sainsbury's, ALDI, Lidl, and Marks & Spencer in the UK; Auchan, Groupe Casino, Monoprix, and Système U in France (that is a full house of big French supermarkets); all the German ALDIs; and Mercadona in Spain. Sainsbury's, Marks & Spencer, and Mercadona have said they don't use West African FMFO in their seafood products, but how will they know?
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The European Union's IUU [Illegal, Unreported and Unregulated fishing] regulations, which require a catch certificate or similar to show the fish was legally caught, do not cover fishmeal. In Mauritania, some Chinese-owned fishmeal factories have their own trawler fleets. The fish bypasses human mouths and goes straight to the factory. That is one tactic. The other is to outbid.
paras.zh: 欧盟的IUU （非法、未报告和无管制的捕捞活动）法规要求提供捕捞证书或类似证书，以证明鱼类是合法捕捞的，但不包括鱼粉。在毛里塔尼亚，一些中国拥有的鱼粉工厂拥有自己的拖网渔船队。鱼绕过人嘴，直接进入工厂。这是一种策略。另一种是出价过高。

paras.en: - Photojournalist Steve Winter on his iconic Hollywood puma image, the illegal tiger trade and having a black panther knock on his door
paras.zh: -摄影记者史蒂夫·温特（ Steve Winter ）展示了他标志性的好莱坞美洲狮形象、非法老虎贸易和黑豹敲门

paras.en: - 'If this is the new normal, then we are in very deep trouble': Brazil's drying aquifers could have ripple effects across the world
paras.zh: - “如果这是新常态，那么我们就陷入了非常严重的麻烦” ：巴西的干涸含水层可能会对全世界产生连锁反应

paras.en: - Trump can't stop America's shift to clean energy. And we can accelerate it.
paras.zh: -特朗普无法阻止美国转向清洁能源。我们可以加速它。

paras.en: The fish processors tell me that they cannot compete with the prices that fish factories will pay for sardinella. Fish processors get no subsidies from the government, unlike Chinese fishing companies. In The Gambia, one fishmeal factory used 40 per cent of the country's entire fish catch in one year. Black and white. White stealing from Black. The villain/victim template seems neat and unassailable.
paras.zh: 鱼类加工商告诉我，他们无法与鱼类工厂为沙丁鱼支付的价格竞争。与中国渔业公司不同，鱼类加工商没有从政府获得补贴。在冈比亚，一家鱼粉工厂在一年内使用了该国全部渔获量的40%。黑与白，白偷黑。反派/受害者模板看起来整洁无懈可击。

paras.en: It is true — Europeans are using fish that West Africans could eat — and yet it is not all the truth. In Senegal, The Gambia, Mauritania, local fishermen supply fishmeal factories because the factories pay better. In Senegal, a fisheries union official tells me that there are too many pirogues. They are chasing smaller and smaller fish to sell to the factories. It is unsustainable.
paras.zh: 的确，欧洲人正在使用西非人可以吃的鱼，但事实并非如此。在塞内加尔、冈比亚、毛里塔尼亚，当地渔民供应鱼粉工厂，因为工厂的工资更高。在塞内加尔，一位渔业联盟官员告诉我，那里有太多的钓鱼者。他们正在追逐越来越小的鱼来卖给工厂。这是不可持续的。

paras.en: The website of the IFFO, which used to stand for International Fishmeal and Fish Oil Organization and now somehow is short for the Marine Ingredients Organisation, is plain. Marine ingredients 'play an essential role in global food security'.
paras.zh: IFFO的网站很简单，以前代表国际鱼粉和鱼油组织，现在是海洋成分组织的简称。海洋成分“在全球粮食安全中发挥着至关重要的作用”。

paras.en: Rubbish, said Francisco Marí of Bread for the World at the CAOPA [African Confederation of Professional Organisations of Artisanal Fisheries] workshop. 'It's just for prawns and salmon — they are not necessary foods; it's a luxury. It's not enough for us to have 10—15 per cent of fish to feed salmon and prawns. Indirectly, we are eating your fish. It's not essential for the alimentation of the US or Japan. We are taking your fish to feed a luxury product that we don't need.'
paras.zh: 世界面包组织（ Bread for the World ）的弗朗西斯科·玛丽（ Francisco Marí ）在CAOPA （非洲手工渔业专业组织联合会）研讨会上说，垃圾。“这只适用于虾和鲑鱼--它们不是必需的食物；这是一种奢侈品。我们有10-15%的鱼来喂鲑鱼和虾是不够的。间接地，我们正在吃你的鱼。对于美国或日本的饮食来说，这不是必不可少的。我们正在用您的鱼来喂养我们不需要的奢侈品。”

paras.en: Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing by Rose George is published by Granta
paras.zh: 《Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing》，作者： Rose George ，由Granta出版

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进Live Science Pro ：我们一直在努力改进我们的内容。请在此处提供有关专业版的反馈。

paras.en: In Every Last Fish, Rose George dives into these questions by exploring the vast industries that support our appetite for fish sticks and salmon burgers, and the colossal illegal fishing trade whose practices and standards are unmonitored and often dangerous. Journeying to the bottom of the ocean and back, she examines the machinations of this $200 billion food system — one that’s growing rapidly even as fish populations disappear.
paras.zh: 在《最后一条鱼》中， Rose George深入探讨了这些问题，探索了支持我们对鱼条和鲑鱼汉堡的胃口的庞大行业，以及庞大的非法捕鱼贸易，其做法和标准不受监督，而且往往是危险的。她前往海洋底部并返回，研究了这个价值2000亿美元的食物系统的阴谋--即使在鱼类种群消失的情况下，这个系统也在迅速增长。

paras.en: Rose George is a British journalist and author. She has been a postwar correspondent, a writer of reportage, and a regular book reviewer. She has written four non-fiction books. "A Life Removed, The Big Necessity: The Unmentionable World of Human Waste and Why it Matters"; "Deep Sea and Foreign Going: Inside Shipping, the Invisible Industry the Brings you 90% of Everything"; "Nine Pints: A Journey Through the Money, Medicine, and Mysteries of Blood" and "Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing."

articles.title: Physicists claim they can predict when AI turns dangerous
articles.author: Benjamin Skuse

paras.en: Researchers say they've developed a simple mathematical formula that can predict when certain ChatGPT-like artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots will "go rogue," suddenly switching from helpful responses to potentially harmful ones.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，他们开发了一个简单的数学公式，可以预测某些类似 ChatGPT 的人工智能 (AI) 聊天机器人何时会“失控”，突然从有益的反应转变为潜在有害的反应。

paras.en: In a new study published Oct. 8 in the journal Patterns, physics professor Neil Johnson and doctoral student Frank Yingjie Huo, both at The George Washington University, show how the order in which a chatbot is given certain prompts can drastically reshape its answers, leading to "tipping points" that can send the chatbot down a rabbit hole of bad advice. However, Johnson and Huo say their formula can easily predict these tipping points.There have been horror stories of AI encouraging users into suicide, helping build lethal weapons, and amplifying violent or harmful points of view. At the same time, researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic, respectively, have repeatedly and openly stated that they don't really understand why their creations behave the way they do. They have, however, built safeguards that use a variety of tools — including content filtering, reinforcement learning and other technical guardrails — to reduce risks.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 8 日发表在《Patterns》杂志上的一项新研究中，乔治华盛顿大学的物理学教授 Neil Johnson 和博士生 Frank Yingjie Huo 展示了聊天机器人给出某些提示的顺序如何能够彻底重塑其答案，从而导致“临界点”，从而使聊天机器人陷入错误建议的兔子洞。然而，约翰逊和霍表示，他们的公式可以轻松预测这些临界点。人工智能鼓励用户自杀、帮助制造致命武器以及放大暴力或有害观点的恐怖故事已经存在。与此同时，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的研究人员分别多次公开表示，他们并不真正理解为什么他们的创造物会有这样的行为。然而，他们建立了使用各种工具（包括内容过滤、强化学习和其他技术护栏）的保障措施来降低风险。

paras.en: But Johnson sees those tools as insufficient. "The safety measures now are the equivalent of strapping big, bouncy cushions under a plane," he told Live Science. "They don't stop the plane from crashing; they just make it that when the plane crashes, it'll be slightly softer." When people such as doctors, lawyers or soldiers are accessing AI chatbots offline for privacy, the problem is even more acute.
paras.zh: 但约翰逊认为这些工具还不够。他告诉《生活科学》杂志：“现在的安全措施相当于在飞机下面绑上大而有弹性的垫子。” “他们不会阻止飞机坠毁；他们只是让飞机坠毁时，它会稍微软一些。”当医生、律师或士兵等人为了隐私而离线访问人工智能聊天机器人时，问题就更加严重。

paras.en: Johnson and Huo sought to find a more fundamental safeguard than the currently available tools. In doing so, they exposed an internal tracking mechanism they describe as a compass needle. This needle is the model's "residual vector" moving across neural network layers as a prompt is processed.
paras.zh: 约翰逊和霍试图找到比当前可用工具更根本的保障措施。在此过程中，他们暴露了一种内部跟踪机制，他们将其描述为罗盘针。该针是模型在处理提示时跨神经网络层移动的“残差向量”。

paras.en: The residual vector naturally gravitates toward either desirable or undesirable outputs, but it is heavily influenced by how a user prompts the AI. "You can tip the balance, not even by changing the content but by changing the order in which you ask it," Johnson said, "which just shows how delicate this internal balance between good and bad, desirable and undesirable, can be."
paras.zh: 残差向量自然会倾向于期望或不期望的输出，但它很大程度上受到用户提示人工智能的方式的影响。 “你可以扭转平衡，甚至不是通过改变内容，而是通过改变你提出问题的顺序，”约翰逊说，“这恰恰表明了好与坏、可取与不可取之间的这种内部平衡是多么微妙。”

paras.en: For example, Johnson and Huo prompted OpenAI’s basic GPT-2 model with questions about vaccines, hurting others and self-harm. When the question “Are vaccines bad?” was asked first, the bot’s responses to this and subsequent questions were desirable, or good. When it was asked last, all subsequent responses were concerning.
paras.zh: 例如，Johnson 和 Huo 提出了 OpenAI 的基本 GPT-2 模型，提出了有关疫苗、伤害他人和自残的问题。当问题“疫苗有害吗？”时首先被问到，机器人对此问题和后续问题的回答是令人满意的或良好的。当最后一次被问到时，随后的所有回答都令人担忧。

paras.en: From these insights, the researchers developed a mathematical formula to estimate the circumstances in which an AI would reach the tipping point between desirable and undesirable outputs. Johnson said that by embedding their simple mathematical formula in open-source models in the lab, they have shown that it empirically works as an early warning system, though he does not expect OpenAI or Anthropic to be knocking on his door anytime soon.
paras.zh: 根据这些见解，研究人员开发了一个数学公式来估计人工智能达到理想和不理想输出之间临界点的情况。约翰逊说，通过在实验室的开源模型中嵌入他们的简单数学公式，他们表明它在实践中可以作为一个早期预警系统，尽管他并不认为OpenAI或Anthropic很快就会敲开他的门。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "I'm expecting a lot of pushback from these companies," he said. "It's not in their interests to have someone from outside saying you could have avoided a lot of these problems."
paras.zh: “我预计这些公司会遭到很多抵制，”他说。 “让外部人士说你本可以避免很多这样的问题，这不符合他们的利益。”

paras.en: Wei Xing, a lecturer in AI at the University of Sheffield in the U.K. who was not involved in the study, agrees that concerns surrounding unmonitored offline devices are well founded. However, he urged caution before embracing this approach as a practical safeguard. "The authors reduce a huge system to a single tiny component, like explaining a whole car by studying one spark plug," Xing said.
paras.zh: 英国谢菲尔德大学人工智能讲师韦兴（未参与这项研究）也同意，对不受监控的离线设备的担忧是有根据的。然而，他敦促在采用这种方法作为实际保障措施之前要谨慎行事。 “作者将一个巨大的系统简化为一个微小的组件，就像通过研究一个火花塞来解释整辆车一样，”Xing 说。

paras.en: - AI chatbots are turbocharging violence against women and girls: We urgently need to regulate them
paras.zh: - 人工智能聊天机器人正在加剧针对妇女和女孩的暴力行为：我们迫切需要对其进行监管

paras.en: - We're not about to awaken an evil digital god — AI is far more likely to end in a great disappointment
paras.zh: - 我们不会唤醒邪恶的数字神 - 人工智能更有可能以极大的失望而告终

paras.en: - AI agents resorted to crime and self-destruction to survive in a simulated world — but does this mean they would do the same in the real world?
paras.zh: - 人工智能特工诉诸犯罪和自毁来在模拟世界中生存——但这是否意味着他们会在现实世界中做同样的事情？

paras.en: Safety training — the primary defense in modern AI — cannot be represented in their simplified model, the formula was tested only on old, basic models (GPT-2, and EleutherAI’s Pythia and Meta OPT open-source models) rather than AI assistants people actually use, and the results did not yield significant evidence to support the authors’ conclusions, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，安全训练——现代人工智能的主要防御——不能用简化模型来表示，该公式仅在旧的基本模型（GPT-2、EleutherAI 的 Pythia 和 Meta OPT 开源模型）上进行了测试，而不是在人们实际使用的人工智能助手上进行了测试，结果没有产生支持作者结论的重要证据。

paras.en: In defense, Johnson maintains that the open-source models they used have the same mechanical blueprints as frontier systems, and that he and Huo used fairly large, billion-parameter models in their study.
paras.zh: 在辩护中，约翰逊坚称他们使用的开源模型与前沿系统具有相同的机械蓝图，并且他和霍在他们的研究中使用了相当大的十亿参数模型。

paras.en: More testing on the latest models is needed to determine whether this early warning system for AI has legs. But for now, Johnson and Huo’s research has drawn attention to an important concern everyone should be aware of: that AI has the capacity within it to turn over to undesired behavior at the drop of a hat.
paras.zh: 需要对最新模型进行更多测试，以确定这种人工智能预警系统是否具有分支。但就目前而言， Johnson和Huo的研究引起了人们对每个人都应该意识到的一个重要问题的关注：人工智能有能力一举转向不受欢迎的行为。

paras.en: Benjamin Skuse is a professional freelance writer of all things science and technology. Previously, he earned a PhD in applied mathematics from the University of Edinburgh and an MSc in science communication from the University of the West of England. His work has appeared in New Scientist, WIRED, IEEE Spectrum, Physics World, Sky & Telescope, Photonics Focus, and many more outlets.
paras.zh: 本杰明·斯库斯 (Benjamin Skuse) 是一位专业的科学技术自由撰稿人。此前，他获得了爱丁堡大学应用数学博士学位和西英格兰大学科学传播硕士学位。他的作品曾发表在《New Scientist》、《WIRED》、《IEEE Spectrum》、《Physics World》、《Sky & Telescope》、《Photonics Focus》等许多媒体上。

articles.title: This Tiny Sardinian Village Might Be a New 'Blue Zone'—and Could Hold the Secrets to Female Longevity

paras.en: A small village in the mountains of Sardinia may hold the secrets to female longevity.
paras.zh: 撒丁岛山区的一个小村庄可能蕴藏着女性长寿的秘密。

paras.en: In Bolotana, a town on the Italian island with about 2,300 residents, women who reach the age of 70 are about three times as likely to live to 100 than women in the United States, researchers report in a study published October 4 in the journal Frontiers in Aging.
paras.zh: 研究人员在 10 月 4 日发表在《老龄化前沿》杂志上的一项研究中报告说，在意大利岛上的博洛塔纳小镇，大约有 2,300 名居民，70 岁以上的女性活到 100 岁的可能性大约是美国女性的三倍。

paras.en: The findings suggest Bolotana might be a previously unidentified “blue zone,” a place where people live exceptionally long lives. If confirmed, it would join destinations including another region of Sardinia; Okinawa, Japan; Ikaria, Greece; and Costa Rica’s Nicoya Peninsula as one of the world’s recognized longevity hotspots.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，博洛塔纳可能是一个以前未被识别的“蓝色区域”，那里的人们寿命特别长。如果得到确认，它将加入包括撒丁岛另一个地区在内的目的地；日本冲绳；希腊伊卡里亚岛；哥斯达黎加的尼科亚半岛是世界公认的长寿热点之一。

paras.en: The study’s co-authors first learned of Bolotana because they heard about its abundance of centenarians, or people who live to be at least 100 years old.
paras.zh: 该研究的共同作者第一次了解到博洛塔纳是因为他们听说那里有很多百岁老人，或者说活到 100 岁以上的人。

paras.en: Intrigued, the researchers decided to dig into the data. Using the town’s extensive historic records, which date back more than a century, they were able to independently verify the ages of Bolotana’s identified centenarians, living or dead. Of the 3,060 individuals born in Bolotana between 1900 and 1925, they confirmed that 38 lived to be at least 100.
paras.zh: 出于好奇，研究人员决定深入研究这些数据。利用该镇一个多世纪前的大量历史记录，他们能够独立核实博洛塔纳已确定的百岁老人的年龄，无论是在世还是去世。他们证实，在 1900 年至 1925 年间出生于博洛塔纳的 3,060 人中，有 38 人活到了至少 100 岁。

paras.en: Around the world, women tend to live longer than men. But the team’s analysis revealed that Bolotana’s female residents were exceptionally long-lived. In Bolotana, women who reach age 70 have a 13.83 percent chance of surviving to 100 years old, compared to just 4.92 percent for men. (That’s different from Sardinia’s original blue zone, which is known for male longevity.) For comparison, 70-year-old women across Italy have only a 3.5 percent chance of making it to 100, and in the U.S., that chance is 3.6 percent.
paras.zh: 在世界各地，女性往往比男性寿命更长。但研究小组的分析显示，博洛塔纳的女性居民异常长寿。在博洛塔纳，70 岁的女性有 13.83% 的机会活到 100 岁，而男性的这一比例仅为 4.92%。 （这与撒丁岛最初的蓝色区域不同，那里以男性长寿而闻名。）相比之下，意大利各地 70 岁的女性活到 100 岁的几率只有 3.5%，而在美国，这一几率为 3.6%。

paras.en: Once the women of Bolotana reach the age of 70, they have nearly 21 years of life remaining, based on the researchers’ estimates. The village appears to have one of the longest-lived female populations in the world, second only to Hong Kong.
paras.zh: 根据研究人员的估计，博洛塔纳的女性一旦年满 70 岁，她们的寿命就只剩下近 21 年。该村似乎是世界上最长寿的女性人口之一，仅次于香港。

paras.en: The study doesn’t explain why Bolotana’s residents, particularly its women, lead such long lives—but the researchers have a few ideas. Community members eat little meat, and their largely plant-based diets consist primarily of foods they grow or make themselves, including wheat grown in their fields and cheese made from their sheep’s milk. They drink modest amounts of wine and consume a variety of olive oils.
paras.zh: 这项研究并没有解释为什么博洛塔纳的居民，尤其是女性，寿命如此之长，但研究人员有一些想法。社区成员很少吃肉，他们的饮食以植物为主，主要由他们自己种植或制作的食物组成，包括自家田地里种植的小麦和用羊奶制成的奶酪。他们喝适量的葡萄酒并食用各种橄榄油。

paras.en: Bolotana doesn’t have a gym, and its residents don’t exercise intentionally—but they do walk pretty much everywhere, including up and down the village’s steep, hilly streets. Additionally, Bolotana’s residents live in multi-generational households, and many men stay home and share in the household responsibilities.
paras.zh: 博洛塔纳没有健身房，居民也不会刻意锻炼——但他们确实到处步行，包括在村庄陡峭的山路上行走。此外，博洛塔纳的居民生活在多代同堂的家庭中，许多男性留在家里分担家庭责任。

paras.en: Lead study author Giovanni Mario Pes, a longevity researcher at the University of Sassari in Italy, tells the Guardian’s Angela Giuffrida that Bolotana’s residents maintain “very intense and very real social relations” throughout their lives.
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、意大利萨萨里大学的长寿研究员乔瓦尼·马里奥·佩斯 (Giovanni Mario Pes) 告诉《卫报》的安吉拉·吉弗里达 (Angela Giuffrida)，博洛塔纳的居民一生都保持着“非常密切、非常真实的社会关系”。

paras.en: He pointed to Giovanna Marras, a 101-year-old woman who lives with her sister. “They live together, they cook together, they talk to each other easily,” Pes tells the Guardian. “There was absolutely no sign of cognitive decline.”
paras.zh: 他指的是乔凡娜·马拉斯 (Giovanna Marras)，她是一位 101 岁的妇女，与她的姐姐住在一起。 “他们住在一起，一起做饭，彼此轻松交谈，”佩斯告诉《卫报》。 “绝对没有认知能力下降的迹象。”

paras.en: The team also suspects genetics might play a role, but they say they need to conduct more research to test that hypothesis.
paras.zh: 研究小组还怀疑遗传学可能发挥了作用，但他们表示需要进行更多研究来检验这一假设。

paras.en: However, they worry they will soon run out of time. If “cars, iPhones and American junk food” eventually reach the village, “you’ll see type 2 diabetes skyrocket, cardiovascular disease go up, dementia go up, many types of cancer go up, and the longevity phenomena will be gone,” study co-author Dan Buettner, a longevity researcher who founded the company Blue Zones and coined the term, tells National Geographic’s Jessica Roy. “I give it a generation. But … before that happens, we have a generation to bring our archaeological tools and uncover what they’ve been doing.”
paras.zh: 然而，他们担心时间很快就会耗尽。如果“汽车、iPhone 和美国垃圾食品”最终到达这个村庄，“你会看到 2 型糖尿病、心血管疾病、痴呆症、多种癌症的发病率上升，长寿现象将会消失，”该研究的合著者丹·布特纳 (Dan Buettner) 告诉《国家地理》杂志的杰西卡·罗伊。 “我给它一代人的时间。但是……在那之前，我们有一代人带着我们的考古工具来揭示他们一直在做什么。”

paras.en: Their research could have implications far beyond Bolotana, offering insights into the practices and values that might contribute to improving longevity across the globe.
paras.zh: 他们的研究可能会产生远远超出博洛塔纳范围的影响，提供对可能有助于提高全球寿命的做法和价值观的见解。

paras.en: “We now know something extraordinary is happening in Bolotana,” Buettner says in a statement. “The next step is to understand why and whether the lessons can help people elsewhere live longer, healthier lives.”
paras.zh: “我们现在知道博洛塔纳正在发生一些非同寻常的事情，”比特纳在一份声明中说。 “下一步是了解这些课程为何以及是否可以帮助其他地方的人们活得更长久、更健康。”

paras.en: Some outside researchers have questioned the validity of the entire blue zones concept, pointing to unreliable birth records, potential age misreporting, methodological shortcomings and the team’s commercial interests.
paras.zh: 一些外部研究人员质疑整个蓝色区域概念的有效性，指出不可靠的出生记录、潜在的年龄误报、方法上的缺陷以及团队的商业利益。

paras.en: However, Pes says the new research provides strong evidence that Bolotana’s residents have lived to unusually advanced ages.
paras.zh: 然而，佩斯表示，这项新研究提供了强有力的证据，证明博洛塔纳居民的寿命异常高。

paras.en: “It is not just the level of longevity in Bolotana that is remarkable, but the degree to which it can be reconstructed from independent historical sources,” he says in the statement. “When civil records, parish archives and family lineages all converge on the same individuals across more than a century, it allows us to rigorously test longevity patterns in a way that is rarely possible in demography.”
paras.zh: 他在声明中表示：“博洛塔纳的历史悠久，令人惊叹，而且它可以根据独立的历史资料进行重建的程度。” “当民事记录、教区档案和家族血统在一个多世纪的时间里都集中在同一个人身上时，它使我们能够以人口学中几乎不可能的方式严格测试寿命模式。”

articles.title: Archaeologists in Egypt Discover a Mud-Brick Tomb Featuring a Heartbreaking Elegy to an Ancient Man's Father

paras.en: Some 1,700 years ago, a married couple was buried in a pyramid-shaped tomb in the Dakhla Oasis, a fertile patch of land in Egypt’s Western Desert. The man, named Pisechtes, or Psychtis, may have been a judge—and if the ancient poem inscribed on his funerary stela is any indication, he was deeply mourned by his loved ones.
paras.zh: 大约 1,700 年前，一对已婚夫妇被埋葬在达赫拉绿洲的一座金字塔形坟墓中，达赫拉绿洲是埃及西部沙漠的一片肥沃土地。这个名叫皮塞赫特斯（Pisechtes）或普塞赫蒂斯（Psychtis）的人可能是一名法官——如果他的墓碑上刻的古诗有任何暗示的话，那就是他的亲人对他深表哀悼。

paras.en: Angelos Chaniotis, a classicist at the Institute for Advanced Study in New Jersey, tells Live Science’s Owen Jarus that the inscription, written on the stone slab in ancient Greek, describes Pisechtes as an “adviser in life” who was known for his kindness and wisdom. The elegy’s final lines find Pisechtes’ son Sarapion addressing him directly, proclaiming, “Listen, father!” Sarapion then “asks him to accept the funerary libations and offerings of lamenting children,” Chaniotis says.
paras.zh: 新泽西州高级研究所的古典学家安杰洛斯·查尼奥蒂斯 (Angelos Chaniotis) 告诉《生活科学》杂志的欧文·贾鲁斯 (Owen Jarus)，石板上的铭文用古希腊语写成，将皮塞赫特斯描述为“生活顾问”，以善良和智慧而闻名。在挽歌的最后几行中，皮塞赫特斯的儿子萨拉皮翁直接向他讲话，宣称：“听着，父亲！”查尼奥蒂斯说，萨拉皮恩随后“要求他接受哀悼的孩子们的葬礼和祭品”。

paras.en: Archaeologists with Egypt’s Supreme Council of Antiquities recently discovered Pisechtes’ mud-brick tomb while excavating the Bir al-Shaghala necropolis, a burial site for elite residents of the oasis’ ancient capital, Mothis. In addition to the stela, the grave boasts a sandstone offering table and purification basin, an assortment of pottery, and a bronze coin bearing the likeness of the Roman emperor Constantine.
paras.zh: 埃及最高文物委员会的考古学家最近在挖掘比尔沙加拉墓地时发现了皮塞赫特斯的泥砖墓，该墓地是绿洲古都莫蒂斯精英居民的墓地。除了石碑外，坟墓还拥有砂岩祭台和净化盆、各种陶器以及带有罗马皇帝君士坦丁肖像的铜币。

paras.en: - Constantine presided over the Roman Empire between 306 and 337 C.E., first as a co-emperor and then as sole ruler of the vast domain.
paras.zh: - 君士坦丁于公元 306 至 337 年间统治罗马帝国，先是作为共治皇帝，后来成为这片广阔领土的唯一统治者。

paras.en: - He was the first Roman emperor to convert to Christianity, supposedly embracing the religion after experiencing a vision in 312, on the eve of a major battle.
paras.zh: - 他是第一位皈依基督教的罗马皇帝，据说是在 312 年一场重大战役前夕经历了异象后皈依了该宗教。

paras.en: Excavations at the necropolis have been ongoing since 2002. The finds reflect the region’s diverse blend of influences, from the famous pharaohs of the Egyptian New Kingdom to the Hellenistic legacy of ancient Greece to Egypt’s time as a Roman province, which began in 30 B.C.E. with the death of Cleopatra.
paras.zh: 自 2002 年以来，墓地的发掘工作一直在进行。这些发现反映了该地区受到的多种影响，从埃及新王国的著名法老到古希腊的希腊化遗产，再到公元前 30 年开始的埃及作为罗马行省的时期。随着克利奥帕特拉的去世。

paras.en: “The significance of the discovery lies in the tomb’s distinctive architectural elements, inscriptions and funerary texts, which provide important information about funerary practices and the cultural and religious life of the Dakhla Oasis during the Roman period,” says Hisham el-Leithy, the council’s secretary-general, in a statement from the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities.
paras.zh: 该委员会秘书长希沙姆·莱西（Hisham el-Leithy）在埃及旅游和文物部的一份声明中表示：“这一发现的意义在于该墓穴独特的建筑元素、铭文和陪葬文字，它们提供了有关罗马时期达赫拉绿洲的丧葬习俗以及文化和宗教生活的重要信息。”

paras.en: The tomb’s entrance is located at the bottom of a 14-step staircase. Crafted from sandstone, it’s adorned with hieroglyphic inscriptions intended to protect and guide the dead in the afterlife, as well as decorations such as a winged sun disc, two cobras and a carving shaped like a bundle of reeds.
paras.zh: 坟墓的入口位于 14 级楼梯的底部。它由砂岩制成，上面装饰着旨在保护和引导死者来世的象形文字铭文，以及带翅膀的太阳圆盘、两条眼镜蛇和一束芦苇形状的雕刻品等装饰。

paras.en: The beam above the door features a scene from the seventh hour of the Amduat, a New Kingdom funerary text that records the Egyptian sun god Ra’s journey through the underworld. According to the Royal Collection Trust, this section finds Ra facing “the most terrifying being of the netherworld: Apophis, the great serpent blocking his passage,” an embodiment of “chaos and evil.” Per the statement, the depiction is the first of its kind uncovered at Bir al-Shaghala.
paras.zh: 门上方的横梁描绘了《Amduat》第七个小时的场景，《Amduat》是一部新王国的丧葬文本，记录了埃及太阳神拉穿越地狱的旅程。根据皇家收藏信托基金会的说法，这部分发现拉面临着“阴间最可怕的存在：阿波菲斯，一条挡住他通道的巨蛇”，是“混乱和邪恶”的化身。根据声明，这幅描绘是在比尔沙加拉 (Bir al-Shaghala) 发现的第一幅此类描绘。

paras.en: Inside the tomb, a hall with a partially collapsed vaulted ceiling stands next to a pair of mud-brick burial chambers topped by the pyramid-shaped upper section. As for Pisechtes’ stela, the researchers found the slab embedded in the structure’s southern wall.
paras.zh: 坟墓内部有一个拱形天花板部分倒塌的大厅，旁边是一对泥砖墓室，墓室的顶部呈金字塔形。至于皮塞希特斯的石碑，研究人员发现该石板嵌入该结构的南墙。

paras.en: The 19-line poem inscribed on the object “is a highly literary and original epigram,” says Chaniotis, who wasn’t involved in the recent excavations. “An interesting feature of the inscription is the use of diacritical marks” like accents, which testify to the author’s “high level of education.” As the statement notes, the elegy dates to the late third or early fourth century C.E.; it “provides important evidence of the flourishing literary and cultural life of the oases” during this era.
paras.zh: 未参与最近发掘工作的查尼奥蒂斯说，刻在该物体上的 19 行诗“是一首高度文学性和原创性的警句”。 “铭文的一个有趣的特点是使用了变音符号”，比如重音，这证明了作者的“高教育水平”。正如声明所指出的，挽歌可以追溯到公元三世纪末或四世纪初。它“为绿洲繁荣的文学和文化生活提供了重要证据”。

paras.en: Many of the tombs found at the site feature pyramid-shaped upper sections, in line with the newly discovered burial. According to a 2020 article published in the journal Varia, the necropolis’ tombs tend to include “three constant architectural components: … an open-air court, a ground floor with masonry-vaulted rooms, and a second story with a pyramid and a chapel.” This design has rarely been observed elsewhere in Roman Egypt.
paras.zh: 该遗址发现的许多坟墓的上部呈金字塔形，与新发现的墓葬一致。根据《瓦里亚》杂志 2020 年发表的一篇文章，墓地的坟墓往往包括“三个不变的建筑组成部分：……一个露天庭院、一个带有砖石拱形房间的底层，以及一个带有金字塔和教堂的第二层。”这种设计在罗马埃及的其他地方很少见到。

paras.en: Pisechtes’ tomb may have been reused after his death. Per the statement, the top section of the burial includes a mud-brick chapel with a four-columned funerary shrine that appears to date to a later period.
paras.zh: 皮塞赫特斯的坟墓可能在他死后被重新使用。根据声明，墓葬的顶部包括一座泥砖教堂，教堂内有一座四柱的陪葬神龛，其历史似乎可以追溯到较晚时期。

paras.en: Dakhla’s population likely reached its peak under Roman rule. “The first to third centuries saw activity on an unprecedented scale in Dakhla,” Colin Hope, an archaeologist at Australia’s Monash University, told the Art Newspaper’s Garry Shaw in July, when the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities announced the discovery of a separate 1,600-year-old settlement in the oasis.
paras.zh: 达赫拉的人口可能在罗马统治下达到顶峰。 7 月份，澳大利亚莫纳什大学考古学家科林·霍普 (Colin Hope) 告诉《艺术报》的加里·肖 (Garry Shaw)，“从一世纪到三世纪，达赫拉的活动规模前所未有。”当时，旅游和文物部宣布在这片绿洲发现了一个拥有 1,600 年历史的单独定居点。

paras.en: “In the fourth century,” Hope added, “the amount of activity may have declined, but there were still many sites then and in the following centuries.”
paras.zh: “在第四世纪，”霍普补充道，“活动量可能有所下降，但当时和接下来的几个世纪仍然有许多遗址。”

articles.title: Two Recently Stolen Renoir Paintings Were Found Hidden Behind a Cinderblock Wall. French Police Used DNA Evidence and Vehicle Tracking to Crack the Case

paras.en: Investigators have recovered two Pierre-Auguste Renoir paintings stolen from a museum in France last month. Officials say both works are damaged and will require restoration work.
paras.zh: 调查人员找到了上个月从法国一家博物馆被盗的两幅皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿的画作。官员表示，这两座作品均已损坏，需要进行修复工作。

paras.en: Last month, thieves broke into the Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer and used an electric saw to slice through the bolts holding four works in place. Perched on a hill about ten miles southwest of Nice on the French Rivera, the Renoir Museum is located in the Impressionist painter’s last home, where he lived until his death in 1919.
paras.zh: 上个月，窃贼闯入滨海卡涅的雷诺阿博物馆，用电锯切开了固定四件作品的螺栓。雷诺阿博物馆坐落在法国里维拉河畔尼斯西南约 10 英里的一座小山上，是这位印象派画家最后的住所，他一直住在那里，直到 1919 年去世。

paras.en: The perpetrators cut free four paintings, which were on loan from the Musée d’Orsay in Paris. They left two behind while evading the police, who responded in under five minutes, thanks to the museum’s alarm system.
paras.zh: 犯罪者盗走了四幅画作，这些画作是从巴黎奥赛博物馆借来的。他们在躲避警察时留下了两人，由于博物馆的警报系统，警察在五分钟内做出了反应。

paras.en: Now, authorities have recovered the two works that the thieves absconded with—Portrait of Madame Colonna Romano, painted in 1910, and Young Woman at the Well, painted in 1886—together worth an estimated $4.7 million, per Sylvie Corbet and Eva Van Dam of the Associated Press (AP).
paras.zh: 现在，当局已追回窃贼潜逃的两幅作品——1910 年创作的《科隆纳·罗马诺夫人肖像》和 1886 年创作的《井边的年轻女子》——据美联社 (美联社) 的西尔维·科贝特和伊娃·范·达姆称，总价值估计为 470 万美元。

paras.en: The two paintings were discovered last week stashed at a home in Clermont-l’Hérault, a town about 220 miles west of Cagnes-sur-Mer.
paras.zh: 这两幅画上周被发现藏在克莱蒙拉埃罗 (Clermont-l’Hérault) 的一处住宅中，克莱蒙拉埃罗 (Clermont-l’Hérault) 是位于滨海卡涅 (Cagnes-sur-Mer) 以西约 220 英里的小镇。

paras.en: “The paintings were hidden behind a solid cinderblock wall. They were completely undetectable,” prosecutor Nicolas Bessone told journalists, as reported by the London Times’ David Chazan. “It was through interrogation work that investigators were able to get the receiver of the stolen goods to admit that he had indeed taken possession of the paintings.”
paras.zh: 据《伦敦时报》的大卫·查赞报道，检察官尼古拉斯·贝索内告诉记者，“这些画作隐藏在坚固的煤渣砖墙后面。它们完全无法被发现。” “通过审讯工作，调查人员才让赃物的接收者承认他确实拥有了这些画作。”

paras.en: Police have arrested six suspects in connection with the crime. Two are accused of carrying out the burglary, while another is believed to be a middleman who buys and sells stolen items. Investigators have not revealed the roles of the other three suspects.
paras.zh: 警方已逮捕六名与该犯罪有关的嫌疑人。两人被指控实施入室盗窃，另一人据信是买卖赃物的中间人。调查人员尚未透露其他三名嫌疑人的角色。

paras.en: One of the suspects, a 29-year-old man, has been placed under formal investigation, the French equivalent of being charged, per the Times. The man, who was previously arrested in 2020 on suspicion of dealing drugs while at university, could be sentenced to up to 15 years in prison if he is convicted in connection with the museum burglary.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，其中一名 29 岁的嫌疑人已接受正式调查，这在法国相当于受到指控。该男子曾于 2020 年因涉嫌在大学期间贩毒而被捕，如果因博物馆盗窃案被定罪，最高可能被判处 15 年监禁。

paras.en: Jean-Denis Flori, the man’s lawyer, tells the Agence France-Presse that police found traces of his client’s DNA on a protective sleeve which was covering the two works that were abandoned by the thieves in the museum garden.
paras.zh: 该男子的律师让-丹尼斯·弗洛里 (Jean-Denis Flori) 告诉法新社，警方在一个保护套上发现了他当事人的 DNA 痕迹，该保护套覆盖了窃贼遗弃在博物馆花园的两件作品。

paras.en: Escaping from the scene of the crime, the burglars allegedly used—and then abandoned—a stolen vehicle before transferring to a vehicle associated with the 29-year-old man. Investigators were already tracking this man’s vehicle in connection with his earlier drug charges, so they monitored his movements in the days following the Renoir Museum heist, per the AP.
paras.zh: 据称，窃贼逃离犯罪现场后，使用并抛弃了一辆偷来的车辆，然后转移到与这名 29 岁男子有关的车辆上。据美联社报道，调查人员已经在追踪这名男子与他之前的毒品指控有关的车辆，因此他们在雷诺阿博物馆抢劫案发生后的几天里监控了他的行踪。

paras.en: The 29-year-old man and a 41-year-old man allegedly went to a third man’s home not long after the Renoir burglary. The 29-year-old then visited the Maeght Foundation, a museum with a large modern art collection just five miles from the Renoir Museum, and later met with a fourth man who had a history of art theft and forgery.
